name: Card spiral with a view toggle
description: A section pinned for two screens on the ink field (the ground on a dark page), built as a CSS 3D stage. About ten landscape cards (the dealt corner, tilted 10 to 25 degrees) trace a spiral in depth: small and at 60% opacity at the top right, one sharp centre card 410 by 242 near the middle, the last cards turning down and left; all stay inside the page margins and fade out before the edge. Scroll turns the spiral; hover lifts a card. One control only, centred at the foot: the dealt button, toggling between spiral and grid. Cards carry real pictures. Phone: cards at 60% size, scroll turns the spiral, the button 52 tall.
phone: Cards at 60% size, scroll turns the spiral, button 52 tall.
houseRuleCheck: The page curl, the blur on far cards, wheel and swipe capture, the WebGL canvas and the HUD cluster are dropped; cards stay inside the page margin and fade before the edge; the faint 40px grid (thin lines) is out; the toggle is the dealt button.

name: Turning object over a closing line
description: A closing section on the ink field (the ground on a dark page), as tall as its content (the object plus the close, about 80svh). A 3D object about 670 by 450 (a model, or a transparent turntable sequence) is centred in the upper half and turns with scroll. Below it, a 54px bold two-line close, centred, overlapping the object's foot by 40px; the second line ends with the dealt button. Accent only on that button. The designed footer follows as its own section; this stop never replaces it. Phone: object 260 tall, close 34px.
phone: Object 260 tall, close 34px; the designed footer follows.
houseRuleCheck: The side lines and the dashed rule are dropped (thin rules). Dragging the object is dropped (no drag controls; scroll turns it). The underlined link became the dealt button. The 12px legal row is dropped because the designed footer follows. The section is as tall as its content, never a 100vh floor.

name: 3D product onto a spec card
description: A one-screen scene on the flat ground, about 1.5 screens of scroll in all. A tall filled card is centred, about 250px wide and 61vh tall, in the surface tone with the dealt corner and padding: a product line in the lead step at weight 600, five spec rows (the label at the left and a value in weight 600 at the right, body step, 20px apart, no rules or borders) and the dealt button. Its top third stays empty. A 3D product (a live model, or a turntable frame sequence) spins in from the top and lands over that empty third. One key figure of the product's headline spec sits beside the card as plain type in the display step, with a short line in the body step saying what it counts. Later frames shift the card off centre and the product lands again.
phone: Card at 70vw wide centred, key figure above it, product landing on its top.
houseRuleCheck: One filled card on a flat ground: no border, no barcode strip, no table rules, no gradient. The key figure is plain type with its line, never a tile. Spec text 16px or more.

name: 3D walk with hotspot cards
description: A pinned scene about three screens long, driven by a pre-rendered camera path through a modelled 3D space, scrubbed by scroll. At one stop the camera faces a row of three to five statues or objects, each with a 20px round filled marker in the accent hovering above it. Clicking a marker dims the scene with a flat 60% ink scrim and opens one centred card 520 by 380 in the dealt card style and corner: a 240px picture on the left half, a 28px title and a two-line 16px paragraph on the right, and a close control in the dealt button's second-action style (Escape also closes it). Other markers swap the card. Phone: the camera walks the same path and the card becomes a bottom sheet at 70vh.
phone: The card becomes a bottom sheet at 70vh.
houseRuleCheck: The pin is cut from four screens to three. The angled gradient and the scanline overlay are replaced by a flat scrim; the card is a filled card, never outlined, and appears only on a click, so nothing lies over the scene at rest. It needs a rendered camera path, so the deal gives it only to a page that has 3D and video.

name: Artwork grid with caption on top
description: On the dealt ground. Three columns of cards about 410px wide with 24px gutters and 24px between rows, two rows, inside the page margins, on the surface tone with the dealt corner. Each card has a bold sentence-case caption at the body step at the top left (24px in) and the artwork beneath running to the card's side and bottom edges (ratio 1.12). No bracketed index, no mono, no black border. Hover: the picture zooms 1.05 inside its crop and the caption takes the accent. Cards are there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: two columns of 165px cards.
phone: Two columns of 165px cards.
houseRuleCheck: The bracketed mono index and the 5px black frame are out; four columns of many cards are cut to six; the artwork runs to the card's edges instead of an inset framed area.

name: Asymmetric two-portrait lookbook
description: A panel on the surface tone, inside the page margins, with the dealt section gap as its bottom padding. Two columns split 40/60 with a 168px gap: a 3:4 portrait (about 480x640) at the top left, and a taller 3:4 portrait (about 720x960) on the right that is taller than the screen, so scroll crosses it. Both pictures are in colour, in the dealt grade, with the dealt corner. Under the small portrait, 64px down, sit the section heading (head step, two lines at most) and a paragraph of three lines at most in the body step, 300px wide, ink on the panel. The sides flip when the section repeats. The pictures arrive with the dealt entrance.
phone: Stack: the small portrait first at 70% width and left aligned, the heading and paragraph, then the large portrait at full width.
houseRuleCheck: Both pictures keep the one dealt grade: never one in black and white. The photographs are designed or generated fashion or product imagery, not archive photographs.

name: Autoscroll camera, story lane
description: A 3D camera path (a live scene) over three chapters, about 70vh of scroll each (under three screens in all). The camera advances on its own while the section is in view and pauses when it is out of view; scroll nudges it. With reduced motion the scene holds still per chapter and steps by scroll. The story text sits in a right-aligned lane about 480px wide, vertically centred, inside the page margin: a chapter title in the head step in sentence case and a line of two lines at most in the lead step, in the palette's light tone on a calm part of the picture (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only). The text swaps with a crossfade at each chapter change. Ground is the scene itself; one accent hue lights the path. No pagination letters.
phone: The lane moves to the bottom, centred, inside the page margins, title in the sub step; the scene crops to the centre.
houseRuleCheck: The scene is a rendered 3D path, not a drawn illustration. No letter-by-letter blur, no pagination or numbering.

name: Bar-pattern mask wipe
description: A pinned picture swap about 90vh of scroll long. A mask of straight-edged vertical bars (26px wide, 150 to 225px tall, 65px pitch, three staggered rows) sweeps left to right across the screen; each bar is a window onto picture B and widens until B covers the screen (900ms ease-in-out), replacing picture A. Then the field changes to the page ground and picture B shrinks to a slab of about 420x600 in the dealt corner at the centre, with one h2 at the head step under it. No reticle, no brackets, no notches. Phone: bars 18px wide and 100 to 150px tall, slab 280x400.
phone: Bars 18px wide and 100 to 150px tall, slab 280x400.
houseRuleCheck: The reticle, the brackets and the notched slab are dropped; only the bar mask and a plain slab remain. Pictures are art-directed, never documentary. One heading names the section.

name: Blend-mode relay list over media
description: A pinned stage of about three screens on the page ground. One picture 1200 by 675 (the dealt corner) is centred. Over it and the ground, a list of six items (project or topic names, 1 to 3 words) in tight bold type at the display step, set in white with mix-blend-mode difference. The current item stands large at the left page margin; the others are right-aligned at the right page margin and step down in size (scale 0.9 to 0.35) along the list. Scroll relays the next item to the left while the centre picture swaps to that item's picture. No rules, counters or labels. Phone: two stacked lines (the current and the next item) at 44px, picture 4:5 centred, blend kept.
phone: Two stacked lines (current and next item) at 44px, picture 4:5 centred, blend kept.
houseRuleCheck: The items sit inside the page margin (nothing runs into an edge); the list is cut from eight to six; the centre is a picture, not a clip, so no video is needed; the picture takes the dealt corner (it was square); the blend is on the text only, with no tint over the picture.

name: Bottom-aligned headline and open signup
description: A section on the page ground as tall as its content, the content bottom-aligned in a 7/5 split. At the left a 52px two-line headline; at the right a 17px two-line invitation, a 56 tall email field filled in the surface tone (the dealt corner) beside the dealt button as its submit, and a 13px one-line consent note with a checkbox that works. The next section or the footer follows after the dealt section gap. A focused field shows a 2px accent ring. This is the page's one email form. Phone: headline 34px, field, button and note below at 24px margins.
phone: Headline 34px, field, button and note below at 24px margins.
houseRuleCheck: The paper grain (a decorative texture) and the 330px empty top (a blank stretch) are dropped. The outlined pill field is a filled field; the round arrow inside the field is the dealt button; the 11px consent text is 13px; it is the page's one form.

name: Bottom sheet over a scene
description: A picture section about 80svh tall inside the page margins (the dealt corner; a photograph or a rendered scene) with the dealt button, labelled with one or two words, at its bottom right. Clicking it raises a sheet from the bottom edge of the screen: at most 1280 wide inside 24px side margins, 56vh tall, top corners in the dealt corner, filled in the page ground, 48px padding, two columns with 40px between (a 36px title and a 17px paragraph at the left; one picture or a short list at the right). A click on the scrim (a flat 40% ink), the Escape key or a close control lowers it; it slides in over 400ms with ease-out. Phone: full-width sheet, 70vh, one column.
phone: Full-width sheet at 70vh, one column.
houseRuleCheck: The round info button is the dealt button. The full-screen scene is an 80svh picture, since a 100vh screen holding one button is a dead screen. Fill and content were not recorded and are designed here; the scrim is flat, never glass or a gradient.

name: Descent with title zoom and sheet wipe
description: A pinned scene of about 1.5 screens. A top-down rendered field fills the screen in one hue (a terrain, a fabric, a field of objects; a made image, in colour, not a documentary photograph) and scales from 1 to 1.5 as the camera descends. The headline, 2 to 4 words at the display step in the light ink on the field's calm part, scales from 1 to 1.5 over the same distance. Then a flat sheet in the next section's ground colour wipes in diagonally from the lower left (a rotated block translating across, straight edge) until it covers the screen and becomes the next ground. Phone: the headline at 44px scaling to 1.4, the sheet wipes vertically.
phone: Headline 44px scaling to 1.4, the sheet wipes vertically.
houseRuleCheck: The curled edge is dropped (no shadow, no gradient). The headline's 140 to 216px growth is a scale of the display step. The field is rendered or abstract, never documentary and never greyscale.

name: Camera fly-through of a panel tunnel
description: A pinned stage of about two screens on the ink field (the ground on a dark page). The camera flies forward through a tunnel of three clips and three pictures (CSS 3D planes) placed off-centre at different depths, each 420 to 640 wide with the dealt corner. Four or five panels show at once; they drift with the pointer (up to 40px) and fade out as they are passed (a depth fade only, not a gradient). A two-to-four word heading at the head step stands at the top while the first panels arrive and leaves with them. Phone: three panels at a time, no pointer drift.
phone: Three panels at a time, no pointer drift.
houseRuleCheck: The 3D object and the bend with scroll speed are dropped (flat CSS planes only). The section carries a short heading since every section has one. Panels fade by depth only; no drawn shapes.

name: Camera push through centred ring
description: Pinned, about 1.5 screens of scroll, on one flat dark stage (the ink field on a light page, the page ground on a dark one). A ring-shaped 3D object (a lens rim, or segments assembling into concentric rings about 530px across) sits at the centre. The camera pushes into it until the rim swells past the frame edges, then either dissolves to the page ground over 500ms (a fade, never a flash) or settles into a clean centred ring. A small bright core stays at the centre for the next scene. The section's heading, one line in the head step, settles in the lower third as the push ends. A rendered 3D or shader object in one hue family; the page ground and accent carry on to the next section.
phone: The ring at 70vw; same push; heading in the sub step.
houseRuleCheck: The ring is a rendered 3D object, not a drawn illustration; a white flash is replaced by a fade. The heading keeps the section from being a screen with nothing on it.

name: Rail stop with hotspots
description: A 3D camera rail (a live scene) that steps by native scroll through three waypoints, about 60vh of scroll each, facing a bank of screens or a table (an office, a studio). At each waypoint a two-line title in the sub step, in the palette's light tone, stands at bottom centre straight on a calm part of the scene (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), with no band and no blur, and crossfades to the next waypoint's title. Hotspot markers (filled 28px dots in the accent with a slow pulse) sit on the screens; two text links (Previous, Next) with typeset arrows, 44px targets, sit at mid-height on both sides inside the page margins. A marker opens a centred video overlay (70vw wide, muted autoplay, a filled close control). Ground is the scene; the accent only on the markers.
phone: Markers get 44px touch targets; previous and next move to the bottom corners; the overlay is full width.
houseRuleCheck: The title is sentence case at the sub step, the tint is flat and not blurred, and the controls are plain controls, not boxes on a photograph. The accent is on the markers only.

name: Camera travels to a second room
description: A closing scene, pinned about two screens. One rendered 3D scene holds two rooms side by side (the one shown first and a second, furnished one). Scroll moves the camera along a curve (a gentle bank) from room A to room B; the build is a pre-rendered camera-move clip scrubbed by scroll. A centred 56px two-line closing line and the dealt button stand on a calm part of room B once the camera settles (no tint, no box). Phone: the same path in a portrait render, headline 36px.
phone: Portrait render of the same path, headline 36px.
houseRuleCheck: The closing line arrives with the dealt entrance and the pill is the dealt button. The scene needs a rendered camera path, so it is dealt only to a page that has 3D and video. The line stands on a calm part of the render, with no tint over it.

name: Card row on a colour band
description: A full-width band on the surface tone with the dealt section gap above and below. At the top left a title in the head step and a two-line paragraph in the lead step in the muted tone (640px at most). 72px below, one row of four filled portrait cards that exactly fill the container with 24px gaps (about 322px wide each): a 3:4 picture inset 8px at the top, then a name in the lead step at weight 600 and a two-line description in the body step on the card fill (the ground tone, the dealt corner). The row is static: no arrows, no drag. Ink on the band; the accent unused. Variant: on the ground under a centred heading in the head step, five cards exactly fill the container (about 248px each), each a 3:4 portrait inset 8px over a centred name.
phone: Two columns by two rows of cards with 16px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: The cards sit straight on the band (no inner panel, no peeking next panel, no counter). Portraits are designed or generated, never archive photographs.

name: Card stack fanning into an arc
description: A centred 56px two-line title in one typeface (no glyph above, no second face). 72px below it, six tall cards 267 by 467 in the dealt card style on the surface tone with the dealt corner, each a picture over a 20px title, stacked at bottom centre in a tight deck. As the section scrolls the side cards slide outward up to 400px, drop 30px, shrink to 0.76 and rotate up to 23 degrees to form a fan around the upright centre card; all cards stay inside the page margins. Hover lifts a card 12px. Phone: five cards 150 by 262, a 14 degree fan, title 34px.
phone: Five cards 150 by 262, a 14 degree fan, title 34px.
houseRuleCheck: The heavy-sans-over-serif title mix and the animated glyph are dropped (one face for the title). Every card is the same filled card style, with no flat colour fills in several tints; the title sits under the picture, not on it; the fan stays inside the margins.

name: Object tumbling between text
description: The ink field (the ground on a dark page), flat with no vignette, pinned for two screens of scroll. One 3D object about 510 wide (a model or a transparent turntable sequence) sits at the centre and makes a full turn with scroll. At the left, mid-height, a two-line headline at the head step in sentence case, about 280 wide (x 120); at the right, a 20px four-line paragraph about 250 wide (x 1070). Both text blocks end the pin by fading out while the object settles; no blur. No accent in this section. Phone: object 280 tall centred, headline above, paragraph below, both at 24px margins.
phone: Object 280 tall centred, headline above, paragraph below, both at 24px margins.
houseRuleCheck: The warm vignette (a gradient) was already dropped for a flat ground; capitals became sentence case; the text blur is dropped; the pin is cut from about 2640px to two screens; the accent on the object's lit edge is a render detail and is not asked of the builder.

name: Centre-split name cloud
description: On the dealt ground. A centred one-line heading at the head step. 80px under it a list of 12-14 names (the client's real clients, projects or places), one per row on a 56px pitch, set at the head step in the display face and split on the vertical centre line: the left column is right-aligned so every name ends at the centre, the right column is left-aligned so every name starts there. Names run one to three words so row lengths vary and the block reads as a loose lozenge. Names only: no logos, no captions, no numbers. The section is as tall as its list. Hover: all other names dim to 55% and the hovered one takes the accent. The list arrives with the dealt entrance. Phone: one centred column of the same names at the sub step on a 44px pitch.
phone: One centred column, names at the sub step on a 44px pitch; the lozenge is kept by alternating short and long names.
houseRuleCheck: Heading added (every section has one) and logos dropped (a second asset type); no rules, labels or boxes. The names are the client's real ones, never invented.

name: Centred card row, click to advance
description: On the dealt ground, about one screen tall, laid out as three rows (header, cards, footer) with 50px padding top and bottom. Header: one centred statement at the sub step, two lines at most. Middle: a centred row of four to six cards 360x450 with 20px gaps, each a picture on top and a title at the lead step below, on the surface tone with the dealt corner, the active one at full size and the others at 85%; it advances by clicking the next card, by arrow keys or by swipe, with no drag handle and no rail. Footer: the dealt button, centred, and a one-line note at the body step. An 88px round pointer reading Next follows the cursor over the cards. Phone: no pointer, cards 70% wide, tap to advance.
phone: No pointer, cards 70% wide, tap or swipe to advance.
houseRuleCheck: The slider is a card row advanced by click, key or swipe (no handle or rail); the pill is the dealt button; the cursor circle is cut from 158px to 88px; the inset background panel is dropped (no boxes in boxes); nothing runs to the page edge.

name: Display CTA with docking button
description: A band on the darkest tone of the palette (the ground itself on a dark page), as tall as its content plus the dealt section gap, that closes the page. A centred headline at the display step, two lines at most, 9 words or fewer. 64px below it the dealt button, centred. Scroll: when the button reaches the top third of the screen it flies (transform, 500ms ease) into the navigation's own action item and hands over to it, so the action follows the reader; scrolling back up it flies out again. No second fixed button is ever added and nothing sits over the navigation. The headline arrives with the dealt entrance. Phone: the headline on two lines, the button full width less the margins; the same hand-over to the navigation's action.
phone: Headline two lines, the dealt button full width less the margins; the same hand-over to the navigation's action.
houseRuleCheck: The pill is now the dealt button and the docked copy is the navigation's own action, so there is one button shape and no second fixed element (a bottom dock would collide with a dock navigation); the letter rise is dropped (the dealt entrance).

name: Centred display title sheet
description: A section opener on the ground, as tall as its content plus the dealt section gap: a centred headline in the display step, two lines at most and 694-840px wide, sits at the top; 32px under it a centred paragraph in the lead step, two lines at most and 640px wide, and one plain text link. No label, no media. Ink on ground. The words arrive with the dealt entrance.
phone: Headline in the display step inside the page margins, paragraph in the body step.
houseRuleCheck: The grey label above the headline is dropped. The section is as tall as its content, never a held empty screen.

name: Centred header over UI collage
description: On the ground. A centred header: a headline in the head step, two lines at most, a one-line sub in the lead step (640px at most) and the dealt button. 150px lower, three or four cards, each a crop of the product's interface (a dialog, a file card, a search card) 280-520px wide, on the surface tone in the dealt corner, running to their edges with no frame of their own, staggered toward one side of the stage with 24px between them (never overlapping) and mirrored on the next instance. Photographs only as thumbnails inside the cards. Ink on card, the accent on the button.
phone: Three cards stacked with 16px gaps under the header.
houseRuleCheck: No icon chip above the headline, no shadows and no drawn cursor: a change in a card shows its action. A crop of the interface is one box, never a window inside a card. Do not deal it with the product replay.

name: Four rounded cut-out tiles under heading
description: On the dealt ground. A centred headline at the head step in sentence case, one or two lines. Below, four square tiles 299x299 with 28px gutters inside the page margins, each on the surface tone with the dealt corner, holding a cut-out photograph or render at about 87% of the tile, slightly off-centre. Under each tile a centred caption: a name at the sub step (one or two lines) and a one-line fact or price at the body step, so the bottoms are ragged. The section ends flat on the dealt section gap. Hover: the cut-out rises 12px and turns 3 degrees. Tiles are there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: 2x2 grid of 165px tiles, name at the lead step, fact at the body step.
phone: 2x2 grid, 165px tiles, 16px gutters, name at the lead step, fact at the body step.
houseRuleCheck: Four pale tints became one surface tone (no wall of tiles in several fills); caps, the wavy edge and the rise on scroll are dropped; the dealt corner replaces the 28px radius.

name: Three surface cards under heading
description: On the dealt ground. A centred heading at the head step, one line, sentence case, no coloured bar and no styled word. A row of three cards 384x455 with 24px gaps inside the page margins, on the surface tone with the dealt corner (the dealt card style's fill and corner; only the arrangement is this pattern's), no shadow. Card padding 32px: a title at the sub step (two lines) at the top, a four-line paragraph at the body step in the muted ink under it and, at the foot, one action: the dealt second action (a label with an arrow). No chip, no picture, no icon: each card is a short text with one action. Hover: the arrow moves 4px and the card fill moves one step lighter. Cards arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: one column, cards full width less the margins, 16px gaps, auto height.
phone: One column, cards full width less the margins, 16px gaps, auto height.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the chip above the title (eyebrow), the colour bar under a heading word, the rotated caps tag, the accent circle on every card (accent spread across cards; the action is the dealt second action), the own radius and white fill (the dealt corner and surface tone), the dark variant and the rise on scroll.

name: Card grid then banded title rows
description: On the dealt ground. A centred headline at the display step, two lines at most. 120px below, four cards in two columns inside the page margins with 24px gaps, each 628x418 on the surface tone with the dealt corner: a photograph filling the top 60% to the card's edges, then a title at the sub step and one line at the body step in the muted ink. About 160px lower, three full-width bands 120px tall with 12px gaps, on the surface tone with the dealt corner: a title at the head step (one line) at the left and a two-line description at the body step in the muted ink starting at mid-width. The hovered band takes the accent. Cards and bands arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: cards in one column, bands auto height with the description under the title.
phone: Cards in one column; bands auto height with the description under the title.
houseRuleCheck: Dotted rules replaced by filled bands, the small coloured squares dropped, the accent kept for the hovered band only, radius and fills set to the dealt corner and surface tone; four cards so none sits alone with an empty right half.

name: Headline in a scatter of cut-out objects
description: On the dealt ground, about one screen tall (content height). A centred headline at the display step, two lines, about 460px wide; 24px below it the dealt button. Around the text and below it a loose field of six cut-out objects (rendered 3D objects or cut-out photographs of the page's own things, never drawn illustration), each 160-280px, tilted 20-30 degrees, heavier at both sides; the area just under the button stays clear for 140px. Every object stays whole and inside the page margins. Scroll: each object drifts at its own rate (parallax 0.05-0.15) and rotates 4 degrees. Hover: the object lifts and straightens. Phone: headline at the head step, the button full width, the six objects in two rows below at 90-130px.
phone: Headline on two lines, the button full width, six objects in two loose rows at 90-130px.
houseRuleCheck: Two download buttons became the dealt button (one action once); the object count is cut from 9-15 to six (fewer, larger pictures); objects stay inside the page margins; the calmer variant is dropped.

name: Headline over standing figures
description: On the dealt ground. A centred headline at the display step, one or two lines, at the top. 40px under it a centred row: one fact line at the body step (a rating or a short fact, plain text, no chip) and the dealt button. Below, a stage inside the page margins, anchored to the bottom of the section, holds five tall standing cut-out figures shoulder to shoulder (rendered 3D characters, or cut-out photographs of people or products; never drawn shapes), 360-560px tall so their tops make a loose skyline, in their own colours. Hover: the figure under the cursor rises 24px while its neighbours lean away. The section is as tall as the headline row plus the tallest figure. The figures are there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: headline at the head step, the fact line and button stacked, three figures 240px tall.
phone: Headline at the head step, the fact line above the button, three figures 240px tall anchored to the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: The capsule is dropped (a chip) and the figures keep their own colours (no tints); the button is the dealt one; the figures are cut-outs or renders, never drawn shapes; the rise on scroll is dropped (the dealt entrance).

name: Headline over a tilted photo fan
description: On the dealt ground. A centred headline at the display step, two lines, in one colour. Below it a fan of five photographs on a shallow arc: a lead photograph 388x304 in the middle and four around it at 200px square, alternately tilted 8-15 degrees and overlapping by 20px, each with a one-line caption at the body step (a place or a title) beneath it. Scroll: the fan spreads from a stack to the arc over about 600px of scroll (native scroll, transform only; the finished arc for reduced motion). Hover: a photo lifts 16px and straightens. The section is as tall as the headline plus the fan. Phone: the five photos in a vertical stack with alternating tilt, 220px each, overlap 40px.
phone: Photos stack vertically with alternating tilt, 220px, overlapping 40px; headline at the head step.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the accent phrase in the headline (one colour), the small label, the faint curved shape, the pin glyphs and the line-by-line fade (the dealt entrance); the fan is cut from 7-9 photographs to five (three to six pictures a page). Photographs must be lifestyle or place pictures, never archive or documentary ones.

name: Headline, rounded video, three cards
description: On the dealt ground. A centred headline at the display step, two lines at most. 64px lower a muted looping video inside the page margins, 16:9, with the dealt corner, no controls and no play button. 80px under it three cards in a row on the surface tone with the dealt corner, 24px gaps, each about 400x240: a title at the sub step and a three-line paragraph at the body step in the muted ink; no icon and no picture. Scroll: the video widens from 85% of the content width to the full content width as it crosses the screen (scrubbed, transform only; the full width for reduced motion). Cards arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: the video 16:10, cards stacked with 16px gaps.
phone: Video 16:10 without controls, cards stacked, 16px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: The icon trio is three text cards (no icon, no picture inside them); the play button on a muted loop is dropped; the dealt corner and surface tone replace the 40px radius and pale tints; the rise on scroll is dropped (the dealt entrance).

name: Headline over two tilted choice cards
description: On the dealt ground, as tall as its content. A centred headline at the head step, one line, with one line at the body step under it. 40px below, two portrait cards 300x450 stand 26px apart, tilted -4 and +4 degrees, on the surface tone with the dealt corner. Each holds a title at the sub step, a rendered 3D object or cut-out (about 160px) at the centre, a three-line caption at the body step and the dealt button. Hover: the card straightens and lifts 16px while the other dims to 70%. Clicking a card scrolls to its matching following section. Cards arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: cards stack with a 24px overlap and plus or minus 2 degrees tilt, 300px wide, headline at the head step.
phone: Cards stack vertically with a 24px overlap and 2 degree tilt, 300px wide.
houseRuleCheck: Both cards on the surface tone (no accent-filled card; the accent stays on the button); the serif headline and the own button are dropped; the rise from below is dropped (the dealt entrance).

name: Centred line over logo marquee
description: A section on the ground, as tall as its content, with half the dealt section gap above and below. One centred short line in the sub step, eight words at most. 40px below, one single row of 12 to 16 logos or wordmarks (36-48px tall, 160px pitch, one colour in the ink at 80%, so they read as one set) drifts sideways endlessly at about 40px per second inside the container, hard-clipped at the container edge rather than the screen edge. Hover and focus pause it; with reduced motion it stands still. No boxes, no capsules, no pause button.
phone: The same drift at 32px tall logos inside the page margins.
houseRuleCheck: Real client marks supplied with the brief, never invented or drawn marks; one row, never a grid wall. The row is clipped at the container margins, so nothing runs into the screen edge.

name: Name rows on banded fills
description: On the dealt ground. A centred one-line heading at the head step. 64px under it five rows stacked inside the page margins with no gaps, each 112px tall, as one block with the dealt corner. Each row holds one centred name of one to three words (a project, a person or a place) at the head step in the display face. Rows alternate between the ground and the surface tone, so separation is by fill, never a line. The last row holds the all-work link as the dealt button, centred. Hover: the row wipes to the accent from the bottom in 300ms, the ink flips to the ground colour and the name nudges 12px right; one row at a time. Rows are there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: names at the sub step, rows 88px, a tap fills the row.
phone: Names at the sub step on 88px rows, same alternating fills, the button in the last row; a tap fills the row.
houseRuleCheck: Hairlines replaced by alternating fills; the 110px names come down to the head step (no giant names); the accent last row becomes the dealt button; the cursor picture is dropped (an asset the sheet may not deal); the slide-in is dropped (the dealt entrance).

name: Centred narrow caption-inside tile trio
description: On the ground. A centred headline of one short line in the head step sits above. 40px below, a centred row of three tiles (310x232 at 4:3, or 310x310 square) with 29px gutters, about 988px wide in all, so narrower than the container. Each tile is a photograph in the dealt corner with its words on the picture's calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only): a name in the lead step in the palette's light tone 20px in at the bottom left and a plain arrow glyph at the bottom right (no circle). Hover: the picture scales to 1.04 and the arrow slides 6px. Ink on ground for the headline. The dealt section gap above and below.
phone: Tiles stack at full width inside the page margins at 4:3 with a 20px gap.
houseRuleCheck: No circle round the arrow, and the tint is flat, never a gradient. Photographs are designed or generated.

name: Centred object slides aside for copy
description: On the darkest tone of the palette, pinned for 2 screens. State A: one rendered object (a cut-out render about 885x640, lit inside the render, no CSS glow) at the centre of the screen with nothing else. As scroll passes 40% the object eases to the left and scales to about 40% of the width while a right column fades in with the scroll: a headline at the head step (two lines at most), a two-line paragraph at the body step and three mini cards in a row on the surface tone with the dealt corner, each a bold title at the lead step and a one-line note at the body step, no icons. The pin releases once the column is complete. Phone: the object shrinks to the top 42% of the screen, the copy stacks beneath and the mini cards become a vertical list, no pin.
phone: Object at the top 42%, copy stacked beneath, mini cards as a list, no pin.
houseRuleCheck: Icon columns replaced by filled mini cards; the glow comes from the render, not CSS; the empty dark band at the foot is dropped; the pin is two screens.

name: Portrait window, thumb strip
description: On the ink as the section's ground (letters in the ground colour) or the page ground. One 557x720 portrait photograph window is centred in the dealt corner, no frame line. At the left, vertically centred inside the page margin, sits the section heading in the head step, two lines at most. A strip of four 148x192 thumbnails (the dealt corner, 14px apart) sits at mid-height to the right of the window inside the page margin; while the section holds, about 1.5 screens of scroll, the window crossfades to each thumbnail's picture in turn, and the active thumbnail is at full strength while the others sit at 50%. It cannot be dragged.
phone: The window at 80vw centred, the heading above it, a row of four 80px thumbnails below it.
houseRuleCheck: The thin frame (an outlined box) is dropped; the strip sits inside the margin, never bleeding off the screen. Photographs are designed or generated.

name: Centred title over three filled panels
description: On the dealt ground. A centred headline at the display step, two lines at most. 64px under it three cards 414x560 with 24px gaps inside the page margins, on the surface tone with the dealt corner. Each card: a photograph filling the top 40% to the card's edges (no frame of its own, clipped by the card corner), then inside 40px padding a title at the sub step, a four-line paragraph at the body step in the muted ink and the dealt button at the foot. No label. Hover: the photo zooms 1.05 inside its crop. Cards arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: stacked, 16px gaps, photo 16:10.
phone: Cards stacked, full width less the margins, photo 16:10, the dealt button at the foot.
houseRuleCheck: Removed the small label (eyebrow); the photo runs to the card's edge instead of an inset framed picture; the own button, radius and grey fill are the dealt ones; the rise on scroll is dropped (the dealt entrance). No boxes are placed on a photograph.

name: Centred video with caption row
description: On the dealt ground, as tall as its content plus the dealt section gap. A centred one-line heading at the head step. 48px under it one muted looping 16:9 video 900x506 with the dealt corner, centred and narrower than the container. 20px under it a row of three captions at the body step in sentence case: one aligned to the video's left edge, one centred, one aligned to its right edge. Nothing else. Scroll: the video scales from 0.88 to 1 as it crosses the screen (scrubbed, transform only; full size for reduced motion). Captions are there at once. Phone: the video full width less the margins, the first two captions stacked left-aligned, the third dropped.
phone: Video full width less the margins, two captions stacked below.
houseRuleCheck: A heading is added (every section has one); the dealt corner replaces the square video; mono and tiny caps stay out (plain sans captions); the caption fade is dropped (the dealt entrance).

name: Chapters alternating sides, stepping upward
description: Over a full-screen rendered sky scene (clouds, dusk), three chapters of about 60vh of scroll each (under three screens in all). Each is a text block 590-725px wide: a name in the lead step at weight 600, a statement in the head step in sentence case, two lines at most, and one plain text link, all in the palette's light tone on a calm part of the picture (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only). The chapters alternate between the left and right halves inside the page margins and each steps about 73px higher than the last, so the eye zigzags upward. The chapters arrive with the dealt entrance. No index, no rotated square, no numerals. The accent only on the link.
phone: The blocks stack at the left inside the page margins, the statement in the sub step; the scene stays pinned.
houseRuleCheck: No index or numerals; the name is sentence case at the lead step, never a tiny label.

name: Click to focus on a framed object
description: A 3D gallery scene on one flat ground colour, pinned for 2 screens, with a one-line heading at the head step above it. The camera runs along a scroll-driven path past five framed pictures on the walls. Clicking or tapping a picture takes the camera off the path: over 1s (ease-in-out) it glides to face the picture square-on while the field of view narrows from about 50 to 30 degrees so the picture fills about 70% of the height; the rest of the room dims to 50%. The dealt button labelled Close sits top right at the page margin; closing or scrolling returns the camera to the nearest point on the path over 800ms. Hover: the picture scales 1.03 and the pointer shows a plus. Needs WebGL; the fallback and the reduced-motion version is a plain grid of the same five pictures. Phone: tap to focus, the Close button at the bottom centre, the path driven by swipe.
phone: Tap to focus, Close at the bottom centre, swipe moves along the path; the grid of five pictures is the fallback.
houseRuleCheck: The round close button is the dealt button; the path is two screens and five pictures (the picture budget); the pictures are real, never drawn; no boxes on photographs.

name: Closing headline over live 3D scene
description: The last full-viewport stop over a fixed 3D scene (a live 3D landscape, or the products gathered into one object as the scene settles into a closing pose). One centred headline of two to four words in the display step, two lines at most, sits at mid-screen in the palette's light tone or the ink by contrast, with a one-line paragraph in the lead step and the dealt button under it. No cards and no link grid. The designed footer follows as its own section; this stop never replaces it. Scroll settles the scene over about 1.5 screens; the type arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: Headline inside the page margins in two lines, the paragraph in the body step, the button at full width; scene cropped to the centre.
houseRuleCheck: The footer is a designed section and follows this stop. The paragraph is one line, the headline two lines at most.

name: Closing band, cut-out left and logotype right
description: On the darkest tone of the palette (the ink field on a light page, the page ground on a dark one), as tall as its content plus the dealt section gap. The left third holds a 440x350 supplied cut-out (a render or photograph of the product with a clean transparent edge and no border, tilted 6 degrees, never a drawn illustration). On the right a 600px column, both groups centred on the same midline: a headline at the head step (one line), the brand's logotype about 56px tall and, 40px below, the dealt button. Hover: the cut-out turns 12 degrees and lifts. Phone: the cut-out 280px on top, the headline, logotype and button centred beneath.
phone: The cut-out 280px above, the headline, logotype and button centred below.
houseRuleCheck: A headline on the band (every section has one); the cut-out is a supplied image with no border or sticker outline; the button is the dealt one; content height.

name: Colour band with mark between phrases
description: A full-width band in one flat field colour of the palette, as tall as its content plus the dealt section gap, ink chosen for contrast. One sentence of about 10 words, set as the section's h2, is broken around a mark on the middle line: the left part at the sub step on the left, the brand's logomark at 160px at the centre, the right part at the sub step on the right, each side about 400px with the text aligned toward the mark. 64px below, the dealt button, centred. Scroll: the mark turns 90 degrees as the band crosses the screen (scrubbed, transform only); the phrases stay put. Phone: three centred lines (phrase, mark at 120px, phrase) and the button full width less the margins.
phone: Phrase, mark at 120px and phrase stacked and centred; the button full width less the margins.
houseRuleCheck: The sentence is the section's heading (h2); the dark pill is the dealt button; the slide-in of the phrases is dropped (the dealt entrance); the mark is the brand's own logomark, never a drawn illustration.

name: Colour flood with rising panel
description: A handover after the hero. As the reader leaves the hero the page ground tweens to one flat field colour of the palette over about 600px of scroll (a flat colour change, no gradient). A panel about 1150px wide with the dealt corner, in the colour of the next section's ground, sits at the page margin and holds one headline at the head step of 8-11 words on two lines at 50px inset. The next section starts 120px under the panel on that same ground, so panel and section read as one object. The panel is there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: the panel full width less the margins, the headline at the sub step, 8 words.
phone: Panel full width less the margins, headline at the sub step, 8 words.
houseRuleCheck: The flood uses a flat palette field colour, not the accent (the accent is never a text ground); the one-corner radius is the dealt corner on all corners; the 43px sentence is a two-line headline; the rise from the left is dropped (the dealt entrance); the panel keeps the page margin.

name: Colour panel, headline, cut-out
description: A panel on the ink field with ground-coloured text, straight edges and the dealt corner on all four corners, inside the page margins. Centred: a two-line headline at the display step in the heavy weight and, under it, a product cut-out about 560px tall. At the far left and far right, level with the middle of the cut-out, one fact each: a figure at the sub step over a body-size line saying what it measures. Phone: headline at the head step, the cut-out 300px, the facts side by side under it.
phone: Headline at the head step, cut-out 300px, facts side by side beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The panel has straight edges with the dealt corner, never wave edges. No pill above the headline. Facts are measurements with full-phrase captions, not numbered steps.

name: Stretched sentence, then columns
description: A panel on the surface tone rests inside the page margins and drifts sideways with the scroll (about 60px of translate, scrubbed, reaching its rest position as it crosses mid-screen), never sliding in from off-screen. It holds one statement of three to six short words in two lines in the display step, ink, leading 1, the panel as wide as its longer line plus the page-margin padding. 96px below, an editorial set of two columns in the text face, each three lines at most in the lead step, with a one-line credit under each in the small step. The dealt section gap of ground follows. Ink on the panel; the accent unused.
phone: Panel at full width inside the page margins, the statement in two lines, columns stacked.
houseRuleCheck: The panel keeps the page margin on both sides and never touches the screen edge. The statement stays at the dealt display size and two lines, never stretched to fill the panel. No mono type.

name: Colour band with text left and card row right
description: A full-width band in one flat palette colour (the section ground itself, edge to edge, ink on it at 4.5:1 or better), as tall as its content with the dealt section gap above and below. Left, vertically centred from x 80 and 350 wide: a 52px two-line headline and a three-line 18px paragraph. Right: exactly three cards in the dealt card style on the surface tone, each about 252 wide (a square picture over a text block with a 20px title and one 16px line, 16px inner padding, the dealt corner), 24px apart from x 540, the whole row set 60px lower than the headline so it hangs low. The cards lie on the band, never inside a box, and none is cut by the screen edge. Cards lift 8px on hover. The cards arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: headline and paragraph first, then the three cards one under another at full width, 16px apart, inside the 24px padding.
phone: Headline and paragraph first, then the three cards stacked at full width, 16px apart, inside the 24px padding.
houseRuleCheck: Nested boxes avoided: the band is the section ground, so the cards sit on a ground, not inside a panel. Stepping arrows (own buttons), the cut fourth card, the white card fill (a second fill) and the card rise are dropped: the cards take the dealt card style, the surface tone and the dealt entrance.

name: Colour panel, text left, media right
description: One panel in a single flat palette colour (ink on it at 4.5:1 or better), inset inside the page margins with the dealt corner, about 640 tall. Left, vertically centred from x 72 and 380 wide: a two-line bold headline at 56 to 64px, one 18px supporting line and the dealt button. Right: one picture 840 by 520 with the dealt corner, inset 90px from the panel top and 56px from its right edge, so it hangs a little below centre and never runs into the panel edge. The picture arrives with the dealt entrance. Phone: panel at the 24px margin, text first, the picture at full panel width 4:3 beneath it with 20px inner padding.
phone: Panel at the 24px margin, text first, the picture 4:3 under it.
houseRuleCheck: The small label above the headline is removed (eyebrow). The panel and picture take the dealt corner, the filled button is the dealt button, and the rise-and-scale on scroll is the dealt entrance.

name: Colour tiles gathering on a centre square
description: On the dealt ground, pinned for 1.5 screens. A centred one-line heading at the head step at the top. A centre square 360x360 on the surface tone with the dealt corner holds only the brand's mark at 96px. Four tiles 220x220 on the surface tone with the dealt corner, each carrying one short word at the sub step (no icons, no pictures), start 240px further out from the square on its four sides, inside the page margins; scroll drives them in until they land against the four sides of the centre square with a 16px gap, with a slight overshoot, and the centre square scales 1.06 when they arrive. The tile that holds the action takes the accent. Phone: tiles 130px around a 240px centre square, words at the body step, no pin, the finished composition at rest.
phone: Tiles 130px around a 240px centre square, words at the body step; the finished composition at rest, no pin.
houseRuleCheck: Grid lines, drawn glyphs and the edge entry are out (tiles start inside the margins); several tile fills became the surface tone with one accent tile; a heading is added.

name: Compact centred header band
description: A short centred opening for the section whose cards or list follow it, never a section of its own and never a heading alone on a screen. The dealt section gap lies above it and the content below sits 64px under it. Stack: a 32 to 36px two-line headline, 650 wide at most, in the display face at weight 500, then an optional 17px two-line paragraph (25 words at most), 600 wide at most, in the muted ink. No label above and no rule below; separation is air only. Ground is the page ground, ink the page ink. The band is as tall as its text. It gives the content under it a name without competing with hero scale. The text is simply there (the dealt entrance decides arrival). Phone: headline 26px, paragraph 16px, 24px side padding.
phone: Headline 26px, paragraph 16px, 24px sides, the content 48px below.
houseRuleCheck: The optional small label and the closing 1px rule are dropped (eyebrow, thin rule). It opens the section that follows, so it is never a heading alone on a screen; spacing follows the dealt section gap; the scroll rise and fade is the dealt entrance.

name: Pick-three builder filling a tray
description: On the dealt ground. Left, 640px wide: a headline at the display step (two lines), then four product cards 130x260 with 16px gaps, each on the surface tone with the dealt corner holding a cut-out of the item and a name at the body step; a card is picked by tapping it (no plus buttons) and a picked card dims. Right: a tray 580px wide on the surface tone with the dealt corner, vertically centred, with three dim filled slots (no outlines); each pick pops into the next free slot with a 300ms scale. Under the tray the dealt button stays disabled (muted fill) until three items are chosen, then takes the accent. This is the page's working tool. Phone: the tray on top with three slots, the cards in a 2x2 grid, the button below.
phone: Tray on top with three slots, cards 2x2, the dealt button below.
houseRuleCheck: The disc and ellipses became a tray with filled slots (no drawn shapes); the round plus buttons are gone (the card is the control); the button is the dealt one; the dashed border, outer panel and numeral chip stay out.

name: Copy left, dark form card right
description: A contact section as tall as its form card, on the page ground. Left half (x 80 to 640): a 44px two-line heading, one 18px lead line and one mail link (a text link, no button). Right half: one card 520 wide by about 540 tall with the dealt corner and 36px padding, filled with the ink on a light page and with the surface tone on a dark page, holding a name field and a company field side by side, an email field, a message field 110 tall and a full-width submit, which is the dealt button in the accent, at the foot. Fields are filled in the page ground colour with the page ink as letters, 52 tall, the dealt corner, no underlines and no outlines; a focused field shows a 2px accent ring and the submit lifts 2px on hover. Copy and card are vertically centred on one line. This is the page's one form. Phone: copy first, card full width with fields stacked, submit 56 tall.
phone: Copy first, card full width, fields stacked, submit 56 tall.
houseRuleCheck: Underline fields became filled fields; the dashed-outline coupon variant is not used. The left button would duplicate the form's action and is a mail link; corners and button are the dealt ones; dark follows the palette (the ink on a light page, the surface tone on a dark one); the band is as tall as its card, never a 100vh floor.

name: Ticket-style signup card
description: On the dealt ground, as tall as its content. Left column (page margin, 560px wide): a headline at the head step (two lines) and one line at the lead step, nothing else. Right column: a ticket card 520x360 on the surface tone with the dealt corner and a semicircle notch cut from both sides at mid-height (a CSS mask) like a coupon, no outline. Inside: a title at the sub step, one email field (filled, 56px tall, 430px wide) and the dealt button beneath it. Hover: the card tilts 2 degrees. On success the card turns to a one-line thank-you. This is the page's one email form. Phone: stacked, the headline above, the card full width less the margins.
phone: Headline above, the card full width less the margins, field and button stacked.
houseRuleCheck: The dashed outline and the scissors glyph are out (a filled notched card); the pin is dropped and the section is content height; the button is the dealt one; the long copy run and logo lockup stay out of the left column.

name: Copy left, layered collage right
description: On the dealt ground. Left, from the page margin: a headline at the display step (two lines), a two-line paragraph at the lead step and the dealt button; no label. Right, inside the page margin: a layered collage of a 525x692 photograph, a second picture about 300x400 rotated 6 degrees overlapping its lower right corner and a cut-out object about 280px overlapping the lower left, all with the dealt corner and one grade; nothing is clipped by a screen edge. Scroll: each layer moves at its own rate, 1-2px per scroll step in opposite directions, for gentle depth. Hover: the top layer lifts 12px. Phone: headline at the head step, the collage below as a two-layer overlap of the photograph and one cut-out, 300px tall.
phone: Headline at the head step, then a two-layer collage 300px tall below.
houseRuleCheck: The small caps label, the mixed faces in the title, the bleed past the right edge and the extra 180px tile are dropped; three layers keep the picture budget.

name: Copy panel beside a live canvas panel
description: A one-line h2 at the head step on the ground at the left margin, then two filled panels side by side, about 560px tall at 1440 inside the content width, 22px apart, in the dealt corner. Left, 517px wide, in the surface tone: one lead-step paragraph over two lines, a two-column list of four plain body-step benefits (20px row gap) and the dealt button at the bottom. Right, 713px wide, the ink field: a live canvas (WebGL) showing a corridor of three or four picture planes in palette tones that reacts to the pointer (parallax of 6 degrees); the camera starts drifting when 40% is in view. The panels arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: the panels stack, copy first, the canvas panel 420px tall with a slow auto drift in place of the pointer.
phone: Panels stack, copy first, canvas panel 420px tall with a slow auto drift.
houseRuleCheck: Panels are filled, never outlined; the heading stands on the ground, not in a panel. The corridor is built of picture planes, with no drawn lines or shapes.

name: Corner fan of halving squares
description: On the dealt ground, pinned for 2 screens, stepping a list of five items by native scroll (the wheel is not captured). A stage anchored bottom left, inside the page margins, shows squares that halve per step: the current item's picture 432px in the corner, the previous ones stacked upward (216, 108) and the next ones running right along the bottom (216, 108), each a picture of its item. At each step the squares animate to their new size over 600ms ease-in-out. A title of the current item at the head step sits at the top right with one line at the body step beneath. The fan stays visible. Phone: current square 220px, the neighbours 108px, scroll steps the list, no pin.
phone: Current square 220px, neighbours 108px, scroll steps the list, no pin.
houseRuleCheck: The tinted ground, the blurred video and the fading fan are replaced by the dealt ground and a fan that stays; the square count is cut to five (no 54px thumbnails) and the wheel is not hijacked; the edge anchoring keeps the page margin; no counter.

name: See-through gap, then three-third panel
description: Entered through a see-through gap: a full-screen picture stays held (sticky) with its one-line section heading in the head step on its calm part; after about 40vh of scroll a panel rises over it. The panel is a full-width band on the surface tone, about 620px tall at 1440, with the page-margin padding and 30px gutters, split into three equal thirds, all filled. Left: a paragraph in the sub step, three lines at most, and at the bottom the dealt button. Middle: a caption in the body step over a cover-fit portrait picture that fills the rest of the height, in the dealt corner. Right: two text links in the sub step, stacked and right-aligned at the bottom, ink with an arrow, each to a different place. Hover: a link slides 12px right.
phone: The thirds stack: paragraph and button, the portrait at 4:5, then the two links left aligned; the gap shrinks to 30vh.
houseRuleCheck: The held picture is never a dead screen: its heading stays on it and the gap is short. The panel is a section of the page rising over the picture, not a card laid on it. Photographs are designed, not documentary. Captions in sentence case at 16px or more.

name: Cover image with live type
description: On the dealt ground, as tall as the picture plus 40px above and below. One portrait 4:5 picture (about 640x800, centred, with the dealt corner) composed like a magazine or poster cover, with three live HTML text layers on its calm part: a title at the head step (two lines), a line at the lead step and a corner title at the body step, in one ink chosen to suit the picture (light on dark, dark on light), with no box, gradient or fog behind them. The cover needs its own composition and no mastheads. The layers are there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: the picture full width less the margins, the title at the sub step.
phone: Picture full width less the margins, title at the sub step.
houseRuleCheck: Text layers cut to three; text on the picture sits on its calm part with no box; the fade-and-scale entry is dropped (the dealt entrance).

name: Cursor-tilt cut-out between name and tag
description: A section on the dealt field (used once on the page) with a straight top edge. A one-word title at the display step, centred. 96px below, a name at the head step in two lines at the left margin, a role at the head step at the right page margin, and between them a cut-out portrait about 480px tall that tilts up to 8 degrees toward the cursor with spring easing. Under it a biography at the sub step of two or three lines (at most 30 words) with a 120px first-line indent. The cut-out drifts up 40px with scroll. Ink readable on the field, no second accent.
phone: Title at the display step; the name, the cut-out and the role stack centred; no tilt.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the notched top edge (a drawn shape) and the small label; the role is plain type, not a tag or chip; the device-tilt prompt is dropped (no permission pop-ups). The title is plain type. The cut-out needs a clean extraction, not a rough mask, and the page's one accent stays off it.

name: Curtain wipe to 3D object on photo
description: Pinned for 2 screens. The section's ground (the darkest tone of the palette) wipes in from the right over the previous scene as scroll enters it (a flat straight edge, no gradient, scrubbed by scroll). A fixed canvas turns one tall 3D object at the centre in front of an inset landscape or interior photograph about 740x405; the object makes one full turn through the scroll while the photograph moves at a slower rate. Left: a title of two words at the head step, a one-line blurb at the lead step and the dealt button. Right, in the lower half: one line at the body step. Phone: the object at 50% of the screen over the photograph, text beneath, no pin.
phone: Object at 50% of the screen over the photograph, title and button beneath, the right line dropped, no pin.
houseRuleCheck: The pin is cut from 3 to 2 screens; the outlined pill and the tiny labels are gone (the dealt button, one body line); the photograph must be atmospheric, not documentary.

name: Cut-out layered over background photo
description: A layered break about 85svh tall (760 at 1440 by 900) on the ink field. A background photograph fills the section at 110% height and drifts at 0.25 of scroll speed. Over it a cut-out image of one object or person (about 620 tall, transparent edges, a photograph, never a drawn graphic) sits centre-right and drifts at 0.5 so the layers separate. At the lower left, about 20 words at 20px in the light ink, 460 wide, stand on the photograph's calm dark part with the dealt button under them; no tint, no gradient and no box over the picture, so the photograph must have a calm dark lower left (crop or flip it to get one). Phone: the cut-out centred at 70% width over the photograph, the copy under the object on the ground.
phone: Cut-out centred at 70% width over the photograph, copy below it on the ground.
houseRuleCheck: The 30% legibility tint over the photograph is dropped (nothing laid over a picture): the copy sits on a calm part. The pill link is the dealt button. The layered item is a cut-out photograph, never a drawn graphic. The height follows the content, never a 100vh floor.

name: Object travelling a curved path beside headline
description: A colour block in the field tone, as tall as its pin (about 1.5 screens of scroll) plus one screen. A two-line headline at the display step sits at the left from the left page margin with a two-line paragraph at the sub step under it. A real product cut-out (a transparent photograph of an object) travels along an invisible curved path from the top right across to the left as you scroll, turning about 40 degrees over its travel, passing behind and in front of the paragraph without covering it. At the right, a lifestyle or rendered picture (about 360px wide, the dealt corner, inside the page margin) sits on the block. Phone: headline at the display step on two lines, the object follows a shorter S curve, the picture 55vw.
phone: Headline at the display step on two lines, the object follows a shorter S path, the picture 55vw wide.
houseRuleCheck: The visible dashed route, the tilted badge, the sticker and the outlined type are dropped; the path is invisible and the traveller is a real cut-out. The picture sits inside the page margin with no tag on it; the block is the field tone, not an accent ground for text.

name: Cutaway model with hotspots
description: On the dealt ground, pinned for 2 screens. A one-line heading at the head step above a canvas pulled back on one multi-storey cutaway model (about 860x690, centred), rendered from a 3D model and not drawn, its floors and rooms told apart by the model's own materials, not by added colours. Every room carries a 36px solid dot hotspot in the accent with a slow opacity pulse (no ring); hover shows a name tag at the body step and click or tap flies the camera into that room over 900ms. At the bottom right three text actions in the dealt second action style (Previous, Next, Overview) are the only controls; no pager dots and no other text on the stage. The overview is the entry state; close-ups follow. Phone: the model full width, hotspots 44px for touch, the controls at the bottom centre.
phone: Model full width, 44px hotspots, controls at the bottom centre.
houseRuleCheck: Ring hotspots are filled dots with an opacity pulse; the three square tiles are text actions in the dealt second action; the pin is two screens; floors are not colour-coded; the dots pager is dropped.

name: Cut-out sequence between text beats
description: A full-width canvas plays a scroll-scrubbed turntable frame sequence (about 90 frames) of one cut-out object on the page's flat ground, in three beats of about 60vh each (under three screens in all). In each beat the object travels diagonally and turns across the frame while a headline in the head step, two lines at most, with either a one-line paragraph in the body step or the dealt button (not both), appears in a different corner (right, lower left, upper right) inside the page margins; at the end the object lifts away (translate -120%). The text crossfades between beats. Ink on ground, the accent on the button.
phone: The object centred at 60vw, the text pinned at the bottom inside the page margins; the same sequence.
houseRuleCheck: Frames are rendered or photographed against a clean ground, never drawn. One action only.

name: Headline over diagonal UI windows
description: On the dealt ground. A headline at the display step (two lines) at the top left on the page margin, a two-line paragraph at the lead step and the dealt second action (a label with an arrow) under it. Two fragments of the product's own interface (data-ui) on a diagonal: a large one about 566x387 at the upper right inside the page margin and a small one about 330x226 at the lower left, overlapping the headline zone by 40px but never covering text. Each is a crop of the product's screen on the surface tone with the dealt corner, no title strip, no window chrome, no shadow, real labels and figures. Scroll: the two drift in opposite directions by 40px. Hover: one rises 12px. Phone: headline at the head step, the large fragment below at full width less the margins, the small one overlapping its lower left at 60%.
phone: Headline at the head step, the large fragment full width less the margins, the small one overlapping at 60%.
houseRuleCheck: Window title strips and chrome are out (at most one framed window on a page; these are fragments); the rotated ribbon, icon tile and shapes cut by the edge stay out; margins stay at the page margin.

name: Headline over an unboxed cut-out row
description: On the dealt ground. A centred headline at the display step, one line (two at most). 90px below it a row of six cut-out objects (cut-out photographs or renders of the page's own things, never icons), each 160px, on a 220px pitch inside the page margins, unboxed (no cards, no dividers), each over a one-line label at the body step in sentence case. Hover: the object lifts 10px and turns 6 degrees and its label takes the accent. The objects are there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: three columns by two rows, objects 96px.
phone: 3 columns by 2 rows, objects 96px, labels at the body step.
houseRuleCheck: Objects must be pictures, not icons; the 12-object grid of 96px boxes is cut to six at 160px (fewer, larger pictures); the row sits unboxed with no dividers; the pop-in is dropped (the dealt entrance).

name: Display line straddling a scene seam
description: One line of four words at the display step in the dealt display face, sentence case, centred over the seam between one section's field and the next section's ground (one straight seam, no gap of its own). The line has no ground of its own: the upper half of the glyphs sits on the field in the ground colour and the lower half on the ground in the ink (two clipped copies or a difference blend). It is the h2 of the section below, whose first sentence at the body step follows 48px under it; the section above keeps its last content within 200px of the seam. Scroll: the two halves shift 20px horizontally in opposite directions, a slight shear. Phone: the line on two lines at the head step, still on the seam.
phone: Two lines at the head step, still straddling the seam.
houseRuleCheck: Thin all-caps became the dealt face in sentence case; a sentence is added under the line so no heading stands alone on its screen; the line is the h2 of the next section.

name: Display word over portrait
description: A panel inset to the page margins, on the surface tone, scrolls up over the previous scene. One large word, the section's heading, in the display step in the dealt display face (no stencil or cut-letter face), ink on the panel, sits centred 120px below the panel top and fits the width on a phone. A two-line sentence-case subline in the lead step is centred 28px under it; then a portrait photograph of about 672x896 in the dealt corner is centred 72px below the subline. A caption in the body step sits beside the upper third of the photograph at its right and says what the picture shows. A variant adds two smaller photographs (240x320) in the outer columns at different heights. The word arrives with the dealt entrance; the portrait drifts at 0.9x scroll (translate only).
phone: The word fits the width (up to two lines), the portrait at 4:5 at full width under it, the caption below it.
houseRuleCheck: The word is a section title, never a footer name, and it stays at the dealt display size and face. No bracketed labels, no numbering, no mono. Photographs are designed or generated.

name: Display word then bare image scatter
description: Page ground, as tall as its content (about two and a half screens). At the left margin one one-word title at the display step. At x 940 a paragraph at the lead step of four lines (at most 28 words, 340px wide) ending in a text link with an arrow, underlined on hover. Then four bare portrait images (4:5, the dealt corner, no frame, no caption) step down the page in loose columns at alternating x positions (about 80px, 860px, 380px and 960px; widths 320 to 440px) with about 160px of vertical air between them, each drifting 40px with the scroll. The section ends on a second text link.
phone: Title at the display step, the paragraph under it, then the images at about 70% width alternating 15% to the left and right, 56px apart.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the small label (eyebrow) and the ring bullet on the link (a drawn mark). The images arrive with the dealt entrance; nothing rises on entry. The images must be authored editorial photographs, never archive or documentary pictures, and four of them spend much of the page's photograph budget.

name: Dive through a frame into the next scene
description: A pinned 3D room scene on a fixed ground with one large framed picture at its end and a one-line heading at the head step above it. Scrolling or clicking the frame sends the camera through it over about 3s (ease-in); a full-screen straight-edged curtain wipe in the accent colour (about 1.5s) covers the swap; the second scene is a different 3D space with its own explore state (drag or arrow keys to look around) and one line at the body step as a hint that fades after the first input. The dealt button labelled Back persists across both scenes. Fallback and reduced motion: a crossfade between two still renders. Phone: tap the frame to dive, swipe to look, the Back button at the bottom centre.
phone: Tap the frame to dive; swipe to look; the Back button at the bottom centre.
houseRuleCheck: The round back button is the dealt button; no tutorial overlay or corner frame mark; one hint line. A heavy build: two 3D spaces, so the fallback is two stills.

name: Document zoom spotlighting one row
description: On the dealt ground, pinned for 2 screens. A document fragment of the client's own kind (an invoice, a contract, a ledger, a recipe card or a spec sheet) built in HTML as a product fragment (data-ui), about 792x828, on the surface tone with the dealt corner, with real labels and figures. As scroll runs the fragment zooms from 1x to 2x onto one row; two bands close in from above and below until a single row about 82px high stays lit and the rest dims to 30%. At the left, a caption at the lead step and one beat at the sub step say what that row is. The pin releases with the row held. Phone: the fragment full width, zoom 1.6x, the caption beneath, no pin.
phone: Fragment full width, zoom 1.6x, caption beneath, no pin.
houseRuleCheck: The close button, the corner thumbnail and the slide-in are gone (nothing to close in a pin); the document is built in HTML on a flat ground, not a photograph; the pin is two screens; the fragment is the only box.

name: Echo type rows behind cut-outs
description: On the dealt ground, pinned for 1.5 screens. Four full-width rows inside the page margins repeat the same slogan of two or three words at the display step on a 1.2 line pitch, the rows alternating the ink and the muted ink (never the accent, never a single word coloured on its own). Rows slide horizontally in alternating directions with scroll (up to 160px each way), sized so no letter ever leaves the margins. Two large overlapping cut-out figures (about 620px tall, photographs or renders) stand in front of the rows, resting on the bottom of the section. The slogan in the first row is the section's h2. Hover: a figure leans toward the cursor. Phone: three rows at the head step, figures 380px, no pin.
phone: Three rows at the head step, figures 380px, no pin.
houseRuleCheck: The accent rows became ink and muted ink (the accent is never a second headline colour); the slogan is cut to two or three words so rows fit the margins while they slide; the pin is 1.5 screens. The repeated slogan is the idea and counts as one heading.

name: Edge-split title above wide media
description: A section on the page ground. Two words of the headline in the display face, sentence case, at the display step, on one baseline: one flush with the left page margin and one flush with the right margin, leaving a wide gap between them (each word 4 to 9 letters). 100px below, one wide picture across the page margins (about 1344 by 840 at 1440, the dealt corner) and under it two short 16px caption lines, one at each margin, in the muted ink, each saying a fact a visitor needs (what it is, where or when). Words and picture stay still; the picture arrives with the dealt entrance. The picture is a studio render, a product image or a made place, never a documentary photograph. Phone: the two words at about 44px on two rows (first left, second right), the picture 4:5 inside the margins, captions stacked.
phone: Words 44px on two rows, picture 4:5 inside the margins, captions stacked.
houseRuleCheck: The caption rule is dropped (thin rule); the serif capitals became the dealt display face in sentence case at the display step; the picture takes the dealt corner (it was square) and arrives with the dealt entrance (its scale-in on entering is dropped).

name: Equal three-column captioned grid
description: On the dealt ground. A one-line left-aligned heading at the head step. Six equal cards in 3 columns of 411px with 24px gutters inside the page margins, on the surface tone with the dealt corner; each a photograph filling the top of the card to its edges (387x258) and a two-line caption at the body step in 20px padding below. Hover: the picture scales 1.05 inside its crop and the card fill moves one step lighter. Cards are there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: one column, pictures 16:10.
phone: One column, 16:10 pictures, captions at the body step.
houseRuleCheck: Nine cards cut to six (fewer, larger pictures); the small label above is out; the picture runs to the card's edge instead of an inset frame; the dealt corner and entrance. Only one such grid per page.

name: Detail panel with metadata and reviews
description: A detail panel for one item (a film, a product, a place) that opens from a list of four to six items on the page: 640px wide, padding 48px, on the surface tone with the dealt corner. From the top: a title at the head step; a three-row list of label and value pairs (label at the body step in the muted ink at the left, value at the lead step at the right) with 16px gaps and no rules; the dealt button; two short reviews as plain text inside the panel (a one-line quote at the lead step, the name and a rating in words at the body step, no stars); the dealt second action as Close at the bottom. It opens with a 400ms rise and fade while the list behind dims to 40%. Phone: a bottom sheet at 85% height with the same order.
phone: Bottom sheet at 85% height, same order.
houseRuleCheck: The two review cards inside the panel would be cards in a card: now plain text lines; the separator lines and star graphics stay out; the button is the dealt one. The reviews must be real quotes, never invented.

name: Exploded model with part tags
description: On the dealt ground, pinned for 2 screens. A shaded 3D object rises upright at the centre (about 450x800), the ground flips from the dealt ground to the field colour with scroll (a flat tone change) and the object turns to a pale clay render; a headline at the head step and a one-line blurb at the lead step sit top left. Parts (rings, gears, plates) float out to both sides on scroll, each tagged with a solid dot in the accent and a part name at the body step in sentence case, then vanish one by one as the object closes up again. No meter, no progress card and no counting numbers. Phone: the object at 50% height, one part floating out at a time with its tag, no pin.
phone: Object at 50% of the height, one part with its tag at a time, no pin.
houseRuleCheck: The pin is cut from four to two screens; progress and meter cards, mono readouts and count-up numbers are out; a wireframe pass would be hairlines, so the object turns to a clay render.

name: Contact card beside heading and accordion
