description: On the dealt ground, a 4/8 split inside the page margins. Left column (400px): a sticky card on the surface tone with the dealt corner holding a portrait 4:3 running to the card's top edge (no frame), a two-line note at the body step in the muted ink and the dealt button; no label. Right column: a headline at the head step (two lines) and six accordion rows on the surface tone with the dealt corner, 56px tall, 8px apart: a one-line question at the body step at the left and a plus sign at the right that turns 45 degrees when open (a glyph, no circle). One row is open at a time; the answer is at the body step, up to 3 lines. Phone: the card on top, the rows full width.
phone: Card on top, headline at the head step, rows full width.
houseRuleCheck: The dotted rules and the small label are out; the contact card is a filled card; the round plus button is a plain glyph; the portrait runs to the card's edge instead of a framed picture inside a card.

name: Folder tabs over a one-question panel
description: On the dealt ground. A centred one-word title at the display step and one line at the lead step beneath. Five folder tabs, each 59px tall, labelled with a one or two word topic (not numbers) at the body step and overlapping the previous by 15px, sit on a panel 830px wide on the surface tone with the dealt corner (square top-left so the first tab joins it). The active tab and the panel share one fill; inactive tabs are a step darker. The panel shows one question at the sub step and its answer at the body step (3-4 lines) at a time with a 250ms cross-fade; no outline. Hover: an inactive tab lifts 4px. Phone: tabs wrap to two rows of 48px, the panel full width less the margins.
phone: Tabs wrap to two rows of 48px, panel full width less the margins.
houseRuleCheck: The outlined panel and numbered tabs stay out (filled, named by topic); the 98px title maps to the display step; the corner is the dealt one.

name: Heading over wide question bands with actions
description: On the dealt ground. A two-line heading at the head step aligned with the second column of the grid. 120px below it five bands 1200x200 on the surface tone with the dealt corner, 12px gaps; each holds a two-line question at the sub step in a 400px column 48px in from the band's left and, 580px in from the band's left, an action of two or three words at the body step with an arrow (the dealt second action) level with the first line. Hover: the band fill goes to the accent and the arrow slides 8px; one band at a time. Bands are there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: bands stacked with 16px gaps, the question at the lead step, the action beneath it.
phone: Bands stacked, question at the lead step, the action beneath it.
houseRuleCheck: Full-width rules became filled bands; the three-to-four line serif questions are cut to two lines; the rise on scroll is dropped; the action is the dealt second action.

name: Sticky word left, open answers right
description: On the dealt ground. One word at the display step (such as questions) sticks at the left page margin for the whole run of the section so the left side is never empty. The right column holds four Q&A cards on the surface tone with the dealt corner (24px gaps, 40px padding), each a two-line question at the sub step and its answer at the body step (two lines) printed open 24px beneath, never folded, no glyph. Hover deepens the fill. The section is as tall as the four cards. Cards are there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: the word at the head step on top, not sticky, the cards stacked.
phone: Word at the head step on top, cards stacked.
houseRuleCheck: Cards cut from six to four with short answers (60 words a section); the 1px rules are filled cards; the rise on scroll is dropped; the word is at the display step, never a giant name.

name: Title left, tabbed accordion right
description: On the dealt ground. Left (sticky): a one-word title at the head step and a two-line note at the body step. Right: a row of four category tabs 52px tall (the active one in the accent, the others on the surface tone) and five accordion rows 76px tall on the surface tone with the dealt corner, 8px gaps, each a question at the lead step and a plus sign at the right end. Picking a tab swaps the rows with a 250ms cross-fade. Phone: stacked, the tabs wrap two per row. Variant without tabs: the title at the display step, sticky for the run of the section, with the dealt button and two contact lines (a phone number and an email at the body step) beneath it.
phone: Stacked, the tabs wrap two per row.
houseRuleCheck: Outlined inactive tabs and the rule under each row are out (filled instead); the dark ground and the pill button of the variant are dropped for the dealt ground and button; the title grows to the head step so the left is not thin.

name: Contact overlay with filled field bars
description: A full-screen contact overlay (100vw x 100vh, ground tone) opened from the dealt button and closed by a close button in the dealt button's shape, 32px from the top right; Esc closes it too. At 1440 the left five columns hold a two-line heading at the display step and one lead-step line; the right six columns hold a choice of three enquiry types as three buttons in the dealt button's shape (the chosen one filled ink, the others on the surface tone), then four or five fields as filled bars 64px tall in the surface tone and the dealt corner, 12px apart, each with its label inside at the body step, a 160px message field, and the dealt button full width as the submit. The overlay and its fields arrive with the dealt entrance. This is the page's one form. Phone: the heading at the head step, one column, fields 56px, the three type buttons on one row.
phone: Heading at the head step, one column, fields 56px, the three type buttons on one row.
houseRuleCheck: No ruled lines and no line-style inputs: fields are filled bars. One button design, the dealt one, for the opener, the type choice, the close and the submit. One email form on the page.

name: Filled title rows with arrow chips
description: A section on the page ground with a heading at the head step. Below it five full-width filled rows (about 96px tall at 1440, 12px gaps) on the surface tone in the dealt corner, starting at the left page margin. Each holds a one-line title at the sub step at the left and, at the right end, a 64px round chip with an arrow glyph. No rules, no icon at the left, no pictures. On hover a row fills with the accent, its text inverts and the chip's arrow turns 45 degrees. It has no entrance of its own: it arrives with the dealt entrance. Phone: rows 72px tall, title at the lead step, chip 48px; a tap fills the row with the accent.
phone: Rows 72px tall at full width, title at the lead step, chip 48px; tap fills the row with the accent.
houseRuleCheck: Dotted rules are gaps between filled rows; line icons and the thumbnail chips are gone (arrow glyph only); the empty runway is dropped; rows start at the left margin, so none is empty on the left; the staggered reveal is gone. A stack of bars is a weak shape: use it for one short list only.

name: Film overlay with words lighting up
description: A click on the dealt button opens a full-screen overlay in the darkest tone of the palette (800ms fade). A film about 720x500 with the dealt corner plays at the right while a statement of 12 words or fewer, set as a headline at the head step in two lines in a 620px column at the left, lights up word by word in time with the film (unlit words at 35%, all lit at the end). Controls are the dealt button as Play and Pause, a text toggle for mute and the dealt second action as Close at the top right at the page margin; no scrubber or volume slider. Phone: the film full width 16:9 at the top, the statement beneath at the sub step.
phone: Film 16:9 on top, statement at the sub step beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Round buttons became the dealt button and text toggles; the 25-35 word paragraph at 44px is cut to a 12-word headline on two lines; the upward travel is dropped; no progress or volume sliders (drag rails).

name: Fixed stanza over gliding scenery layers
description: A pinned stage for 2 screens: a layered landscape of five scenery layers (trees, a building, hills, a ridge, a bridge) made as rendered or generated images with transparent edges, never drawn SVG, on three depth planes. A stanza of three short lines at the sub step stays fixed at the left page margin, a third of the way down, directly on the scene with no box or fill behind it (ink chosen for contrast on the calm part). Over about 600px of scroll per stanza the camera glides sideways at 0.3, 0.6 and 1.0 speed per plane; layers fade through opacity alone (no haze plane). The second stanza replaces the first with a 300ms cross-fade; two stanzas in all. Phone: the text in the lower third at the sub step, no pin.
phone: Text in the lower third at the sub step, the same plane speeds, no pin.
houseRuleCheck: The text box is plain type; the haze plane is dropped (no milky fog); two stanzas and a two-screen pin; the layers must be real images with transparent edges, never drawn.

name: Cut-outs closing on title columns
description: On the dealt ground, pinned for 1.5 screens. Two background-free cut-outs about 350x816 stand at the page margin on the left and right, facing each other, and slide inward 62px over the pin. Between them two 360px columns, each a title at the head step (two lines, one face), a two-line note at the body step and the dealt second action (a label with an arrow). The columns arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: one cut-out above (200px), the columns stacked, no pin.
phone: One cut-out above (200px), columns stacked, no pin.
houseRuleCheck: The 284px columns could not hold 97px titles: widened to 360px with head-step titles; the round arrow buttons became the dealt second action; the clip reveal is dropped (the dealt entrance); the cut-outs keep the page margin; one face only.

name: Flythrough with roaming title block
description: Pinned 3D flyover scenes (a landscape or city with the camera on a path), three of about 80vh each (under three screens in all). Each scene shows a one-word title in the display step and a paragraph of two lines at most in the body step at a different place per scene (centre, lower centre, lower left, right of centre), inside the page margins. The text crossfades between scenes as the camera follows the path. The scene is lit in one hue family; type is the palette's light tone or the ink by contrast on a calm part of the picture (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only). No icon, no kicker above the title.
phone: The block always sits at the bottom left inside the page margins, title in the head step.
houseRuleCheck: No outline diamond icon and no kicker at top centre. The title is a headline in the display step, not a tiny label.

name: Footage shrinks to an orb in a phone
description: On the darkest tone of the palette (the ink field on a light page, the page ground on a dark one), pinned for 2 screens; the ground holds as one flat tone. Full-frame footage loses its frame and is masked to a circle that shrinks from about 560px to 70px, while a phone cut-out render with the product's interface on its screen scales from 1 to 0.5 and drifts to the centre; the circle ends inside the phone's screen. One line at the display step in the muted ink sits in the bottom 260px for the whole pin (no blur, no low opacity). Phone: the phone at 60% width, the line at the head step, no pin.
phone: Phone at 60% width, the line at the head step, no pin.
houseRuleCheck: The 20% opacity blurred headline is now a muted-ink line (contrast, no glass); the pin is two screens; the phone is a supplied render with the interface on its screen.

name: Four-column shearing drift grid
description: On the dealt ground. A one-line heading at the head step at the left. Below it four columns of muted looping videos 296x220 with 32px gutters inside the page margins, two rows about 340px apart, with the dealt corner; under each video a title at the lead step at the left and a line at the body step (client and year) at the right. While scrolling the columns drift at different speeds (about -250, 200, -150 and 130px over the section) so the grid shears; the drift keeps every video inside the page margins. Hover: the video brightens. Phone: two columns, drift plus or minus 60px.
phone: Two columns, drift 60px.
houseRuleCheck: The fixed grid-or-list toggle is dropped (a switch that changes nothing, and it would collide with a dock navigation); a heading is added; the margins hold during the drift.

name: Name list beside a large swapping frame
description: Two columns on the page ground, as tall as the frame. At the left margin a frame about 520x640 (the dealt corner) holds one photograph; at the right, from the sixth column, a stacked list of four to six short names (one or two words each) at the head step in the display weight, leading 1. The active name is full ink and the others sit at 55% ink (never below 3:1 against the ground). Under the list a paragraph at the body step of at most 25 words (three or four lines, 340px wide) changes with the name, then the dealt button. Hover, focus or tap on a name swaps the frame's photograph with a 400ms crossfade and swaps the paragraph; the first name is active at rest. Variants: the frame grows to fill about 85% of its column; or scroll drives the list instead of hover (pinned for at most 1250px, the name crossing mid-screen is active, and the frame is a sticky 640x760 card that first shrinks from a full-width picture into place). Ink on the ground, the accent only on the dealt button.
phone: Frame on top at full width less the margins (4:3); the names follow as a list at the sub step; a tap swaps the photograph and opens the paragraph under the tapped name; the dealt button follows.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: a full-width hairline, a small number, a mono tag, a chamfered corner and a hard offset block (it reads as a hard shadow). The names stack as a list and are words, never numbers. The active state is ink against dimmer ink, not an accent word. The brand-mark variant is dropped (it needs logos), the section is as tall as its content with the dealt section gap, and the button is the dealt one.

name: Framed parallax photo rows with info column
description: Page ground. Four case rows stacked 120px apart (row pitch 500 to 560px). Each row has a 666x444 frame (the dealt corner) at the left page margin; its photograph is 25% taller than the frame and drifts about 100px up and down with scroll inside it. On the right a 420px info column is centred on the frame's height: a title at the sub step in semibold (at most three words), one line at the body step (at most eight words) and one stat as a plain line, the figure at the head step with a short caption beside it at the body step. Hover brings the photograph forward by 3% in 300ms. The photograph stays on the left in every row so the left side is never empty. Ink on the ground, no accent.
phone: Frame at full width less the margins (4:3) with the drift cut to 30px; the info stacks under it.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the index tag (numbering), the dotted rule under each frame (hairline), the stat chip (a badge: the stat is a plain line) and the hover video. Four rows of about 14 words keep the section near 60 words. Photographs must be authored work shots, never archive or documentary pictures.

name: Framed render between cut-out figures
description: Pinned scene of about 150vh on the page ground. One picture (a product render, an object or an interior) starts full-bleed and shrinks to a centred picture about 914x570 (the dealt corner) as scroll advances. Two cut-out photographs of a figure or an object, each about 420px tall in the dealt grade with no frame and no shadow, overlap it: one behind the picture at the upper right, one in front at the lower left, each drifting a few pixels against the scroll. The section's heading (two lines at most, the head step, centred) stands on the ground above the picture's final frame and is uncovered as the picture shrinks. Two tones only besides the pictures: the ground and the ink. It works as a breather between a statement and a grid.
phone: Picture at 90% width (4:3); the cut-outs shrink to 40% of the screen width and keep the behind and in-front overlap; the pin is cut to 120vh.
houseRuleCheck: The halftone bars are dropped: a canvas filter would break the one grade over every picture, so the two figures are plain cut-out photographs. A heading is added so the scene is not text-free. No shadow under the cut-outs. Absorbs 1 near-duplicate (ids in merged); its full-screen halftone variant is dropped with the halftone.

name: Image pan with text beats
description: Pinned stage of about 1800px of scroll (two screens). One tall dark full-bleed photograph, at least 160% of the screen height, pans upward about 640px and narrows 6% across the pin. Three beats of text in the lighter of the ground and the ink, each of at most 14 words at the sub step, sit in a 440px column at the left margin at mid-height on the picture's calm part and replace each other in place by opacity (320ms crossfade, one beat per 600px of scroll). The text sits straight on the picture with no box; the picture is dark and calm where the column sits, so contrast stays at 7:1 (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the column only, no gradient). The last beat ends with the dealt button. Ground is the photograph, type in the lighter of the ground and the ink, accent only on the button.
phone: The column becomes full width less the margins with the text at the lead step in the lower third; the pan is cut to 300px and the pin to about 1400px.
houseRuleCheck: The pin is about 1800px and three beats, under 60 words. No box and no tint over the picture: the words sit on its calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only). The beats are told by the text, never by a counter or progress mark. The picture is a crafted photograph, never an archive one, with a calm area at the left at every width.

name: Full-bleed intro film with skip
description: A film state that opens only when the visitor presses the dealt button (a watch action in the hero); it never starts by itself and the hero stays the finished first screen underneath. One film plays full-bleed with cover fit (a landscape file above 768px wide, a portrait file below). A plain text skip control sits centred 100px above the bottom (80px on phone), at the body step in sentence case, in the lighter of the ground and the ink straight on the film's calm lower part with no box, reachable by keyboard. When the film ends, or on skip or Escape, the film closes and the page rests on the hero. Keep the film under about ten seconds and skip it automatically under reduced motion. Ground is the film, type in the lighter of the ground and the ink, no accent.
phone: Portrait film file, skip 80px above the bottom, same behaviour; the film starts muted and sound is on tap.
houseRuleCheck: The film no longer replaces the first screen: the hero is already finished and the film opens on request, so nothing waits behind a loader. The skip control is body-size sentence case, not a tiny uppercase label. The film must be skippable by keyboard. Needs a real film.

name: Photo close overlapped by footer sheet
description: The last scene before the footer. A dark full-bleed photograph about 1440x1010 with the dealt corner on its top corners scales from 1.2 to 1 as it scrolls into view. Centred near the top: a heading of at most two lines and four words at the display step (about 450px wide, leading 1); 32px under it a paragraph at the lead step of two or three lines in a 330px column; 32px under that the dealt button. The footer sheet (the dealt footer on the ground colour, with the dealt corner on its top corners) rises over the photograph's lower 190px so the picture reads as the page's final stage, with no gap between and no text under the sheet. Heading and paragraph in the lighter of the ground and the ink on the picture's calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), no gradient.
phone: Photo fills 100svh, the heading at the display step in two lines, the paragraph at the body step, and the footer sheet overlaps the lower 140px.
houseRuleCheck: The four one-word lines at 112-128px are cut to two lines at the display step. No box on the photograph: the paragraph sits directly on the picture. The sheet covers under a fifth of the photograph and nothing is written under it. The footer under it must be the dealt designed footer (cards, links, a sign-up), never a giant name or a credit wall. Never two buttons to the same place on one screen.

name: Full-bleed picture shrinks into collage
description: Pinned scene of about 200vh that closes a full-bleed chapter. The full-bleed picture scales from 1 to 0.6 and gains the dealt corner while the page ground reappears around it at the sides. Three to five new pictures (portrait and landscape, 180 to 320px wide, the dealt corner) move in from the sides and from below with the scroll at different speeds and settle around it in a loose collage with 40 to 80px gaps. A flat tile in the surface tone stands behind two of the pictures for depth. The section's heading (two lines at most, the head step) sits centred under the finished collage. The scene ends as normal scroll returns on the finished collage. Page ground and page ink, no accent needed.
phone: The picture shrinks to 0.8; the collage is three pictures stacked on a diagonal; the pin is cut to 150vh.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the chapter rail dot (a progress mark) and the outlined ghost frames (outlined boxes); the tiles are one surface tone, not several fills. The pictures move with the scroll, not as a reveal. A heading is added so the scene is not text-free.

name: Tableau with notched exit
description: A pinned stage of three full-bleed painted or rendered pictures (designed, painterly or 3D pictures, not archive photographs), about 80vh of scroll each (under three screens in all). A caption of one or two lines in the lead step, about 396px wide, sits centred 64px from the bottom in the palette's light tone on a calm part of the picture (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only) and crossfades between pictures. On exit the picture shrinks to 0.85 with the dealt corner, tilts back 6 degrees and lifts away over the ground, while the next picture rises and flattens to full-bleed.
phone: The same stage without the tilt; caption in the body step at the bottom inside the page margins.
houseRuleCheck: No notch, folder-tab shape or outline: every edge stays straight. No index, no mono; the caption is sentence case at 16px or more.

name: Full-bleed video, caption bottom-left
description: One full-bleed block, 100vh tall, holding a photograph 125% of its height that drifts 12% as the page scrolls and settles from 1.06 to 1 scale as it crosses the viewport. At the bottom left, at the page margin and 48px above the bottom, sit a two-line headline at the head step in the lighter of the ground and the ink and, 20px under it, a three-line paragraph at the body step, 340px wide. At the bottom right, the dealt button. Text sits straight on the picture's calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), no gradient. Ground is the photograph, type in the lighter of the ground and the ink, accent only on the button. Variant: a muted looping video (with the photograph as its poster) in place of the still when the page has a clip.
phone: The photograph fills 100svh in a portrait crop; the headline at the sub step, the paragraph at the body step, and the dealt button moves under the paragraph at full width less the margins.
houseRuleCheck: The dealt button, a paragraph at the body step, and words on the picture's calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), never a tint over the whole picture or a gradient. The photograph is the main build and the video only a variant, so the pattern needs no video.

name: Photo shrinks to window over marquee
description: Pinned for about 720px of scroll. A full-screen portrait (or product) photograph shrinks to a centred window about 400x240 (the dealt corner) while the ground turns from the page ground to the dealt field (used once on the page). Behind the window a phrase of three to five words at the display step runs sideways as a 30s linear marquee wider than the screen, in the ground tone on the field. The window stays sharp in front. The phrase is the section's heading (an h2, shown still and centred under reduced motion). After the pin the next section returns to the page ground.
phone: The photograph shrinks to a window 70% wide by 120px tall; the phrase at the display step; the pin is cut to 500px.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the self-drawing signature stroke (a drawn shape). The marquee crosses both edges, a continuing row; the phrase is short, not a sentence, and doubles as the heading. The dark field is used once, then the page ground returns.

name: Full-screen single product slide
description: A full-screen overlay opened from a product row (the page lists three or four products): one slide per product, each filling the screen on the surface tone. One cut-out product photograph sits centred at about 60% of the screen height, with a title at the display step and one line at the body step in 65% ink below or beside it; the product's own colour comes from the photograph, never from the ground. Arrow keys, the dealt button for Previous and Next, or a swipe change the slide with a 450ms push. A Close action (the dealt button, or Escape) returns to the previous scene. No drag handle, no rail, no counter, no pagination dots.
phone: Slides fill the screen height with the product at 50% and the title at the head step; swipe horizontally; the dealt buttons stay.
houseRuleCheck: The per-variant ground colours are dropped (one accent hue, no several fills): every slide stands on the surface tone and the product photograph carries the colour. The two round 56px buttons become the dealt button, and closing on scroll is replaced by a Close action. The overlay is a dialog with focus kept inside and Escape to close. Needs three or more product photographs on clean cut-outs.

name: Wide lead picture then three-up cards
description: A band on the page ground. A 32px heading at the left margin (x 80); 56px below it, one picture 1280 by 853 (ratio 1.5, the dealt corner) with one 16px caption line under it that says what it shows. 96px below, one row of three cards 413 wide on 20px gutters in the dealt card style, on the surface tone: each a 4:3 picture over a 20px title and one 16px line. No arrow button. Heading, lead picture and cards are simply there (the dealt entrance decides arrival). Phone: lead picture 4:3 inside the margins, cards in one column at full width.
phone: Lead picture 4:3, cards in one column at full width.
houseRuleCheck: The small label and chip became a plain heading; the round down arrow (an own button) is dropped; the grid is cut from two rows to one row of three so the section is not a wall of cards; the per-row rise is the dealt entrance; the large open picture keeps the section from being only boxes.

name: Canvas chapters, fixed bottom caption
description: Full-screen 3D canvas chapters, three of about 70vh of scroll each (under three screens in all): the camera travels through changing abstract scenes (ribbons, strands, blocks, ridges) that belong to one live scene in one hue family. A caption block holds one fixed slot at bottom centre, 64px up from the bottom and 560px wide: a headline in the head step, a two-line paragraph in the lead step and the dealt button, all in the palette's light tone on a calm part of the picture (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only). The text swaps with a 300ms crossfade at each chapter change. No frame, no chapter markers, no rules, no progress, no readouts.
phone: The same bottom slot inside the page margins, headline in the sub step, button at full width; scene cropped to the centre.
houseRuleCheck: No HUD frame, chapter markers, rules or mono readouts. The idea (a caption locked to one slot over changing scenes) stays.

name: Looping full-screen video slides
description: A 100vh stage of four to six full-screen video slides in a loop. Each slide is footage in cover fit with one centred title at the display step (one to four words) in the lighter of the ground and the ink on its calm middle (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the title only). The five-second timer, the arrow keys or a swipe step one slide: the new clip fades in over 200ms while the old fades out over 300ms, and the slides wrap around; the timer pauses on hover. The page's own scroll is never captured: the wheel scrolls past the stage as normal. The dealt button at the bottom centre (a verb) scrolls on to the next section. No progress bar, no counter, no credits.
phone: A swipe steps a slide; titles at the head step; clips cropped to portrait.
houseRuleCheck: The wheel hijack is removed (native scroll stays and the dealt button scrolls on, so the loop never traps the visitor). Left out: the progress chrome, the index counter (numbering), the credit line and the hairlines at the edges. Needs four or more real clips.

name: Globe with projected labels
description: On the dark ground (the page's own on a dark page, the dealt field on a light one), pinned for about 1800px of scroll (two screens). A WebGL globe fills the frame with its horizon near the top of the screen and turns slowly with scroll. A two-line headline at the head step (at most 10 words, about 820px wide) travels up through the middle. Six place labels at the body step in sentence case, each beside a small accent point, are pinned to 3D points on the globe: they slide across the screen as it turns, fade from 40% to full as they face the camera and hide behind the limb. The labels are places the client really works in. The scene ends on the dark limb. Ink light, the accent only on the points.
phone: The globe is 120% of the screen width with four labels; the headline at the sub step; the pin is cut to 1200px.
houseRuleCheck: Twelve tiny uppercase labels became six sentence-case labels at body size, the label pills (chips) are dropped, and the six-line uppercase statement became a two-line headline. The globe is a WebGL render of real places, not a drawn illustration. Needs a 3D scene (WebGL) and real place data; without them do not deal this.

name: Ground sheet slides over previous scene
description: A solid ground-colour sheet, as tall as its content, slides up over the previous scene by about 360px at its first scroll, while the previous scene scales to 0.94 and dims 20% under a flat overlay. The sheet has the dealt corner on its top corners and carries, top to bottom: a centred headline of two lines at the display step (at most 10 words), then a trio of pictures (the centre one 440x560, the two sides 320x420 set 60px lower, 24px gaps) and, 64px under them, the dealt button, centred. The pictures arrive with the dealt entrance.
phone: The sheet slides 200px; the headline at the head step; the pictures stack as one centre picture at 70% width with two small ones offset.
houseRuleCheck: The geometry of this scene was not recorded; this is a designed spec. No shadow under the sheet: the overlap reads from the colour change and the dim of the scene below. The WebGL ripple on the headline is dropped (plain type), the three-line statement is a two-line headline, and the staggered rise of the pictures is the dealt entrance.

name: Grouped lists, labels left, filled rows right
description: A text-only index on the page ground. Top: a title at the display step at the left margin (x 80), two lines at most; at the right a 17px two-line intro and the dealt button, both top-aligned. 96px below, three or four groups stacked 88px apart. Each group: its name at the left in 28px medium (x 80); in the right half (x 720 to 1360) three to five rows 60 tall with 8px between, each a bar in the surface tone with the dealt corner, a 20px name at the left and an optional short note right-aligned in the muted ink. No counts, rules or icons. On hover a row fills with the accent, its ink flips for contrast and its name nudges 6px right. Rows are simply there (the dealt entrance decides arrival). Phone: group name above its rows, rows full width at 56 tall, intro under the title.
phone: Group name above its rows, rows full width at 56 tall, intro under the title.
houseRuleCheck: Ruled rows became filled rows with 8px gaps (thin rules out); the item counts are dropped; the 88px title is the display step; the pill is the dealt button; the stagger reveal is the dealt entrance. The left half carries group names, so no row sits empty on the left.

name: Half photo beside cut-out and centred text
description: Two halves as tall as the left photograph frame (about 720px at 1440). The left 47% is a photograph at the left page margin, 40px inside the section's top and bottom (the dealt corner); its image drifts 5% inside the frame on scroll. The right half is the surface tone. Centred in it: a cut-out object or product photograph about 320px tall that turns 6 degrees with scroll, a 60px gap, a centred paragraph at the lead step of three lines (at most 30 words, 420px wide) and the dealt button. The right half's content arrives with the dealt entrance. Ink on the surface tone, accent only on the dealt button.
phone: The photograph on top at 4:3 within the page margins; the cut-out and the paragraph centred below.
houseRuleCheck: The dashed sunburst, the dot ornament and the stripes are drawn shapes and hairlines; a photographed cut-out object replaces them (so the id's ornament is retired). The photograph stays inside the page margin. The two halves are as tall as the photograph, not a held screen.

name: Half-width row list beside a turning object
description: The ink field (the ground on a dark page). The list sits in the right 46% (x 760 to 1360) and one 3D object turns in the left half, beside the list and never under text. List: a 56px heading, then six to eight rows 52 tall, 6px apart, each a bar in the surface tone with the dealt corner, a name at the left in 17px, a short descriptor in the muted ink in the middle and a 16px arrow glyph at the end. Hovering a row fills it with the accent and flips its ink. The object (a 3D model or a transparent turntable sequence, about 560 wide) spins one full turn with scroll while the stage is pinned for two screens; the rows are there from the start. Phone: object 220 tall pinned small at the top, the list full width below.
phone: Object 220 tall pinned small at the top, list full width below.
houseRuleCheck: Ruled rows became filled rows (thin rules out), tiny caps columns became 16 to 17px sentence case, the bracketed count is dropped. The list is cut from twelve to sixteen rows to six to eight so it fits the pinned screen; the object recolour, the row rise and the mirrored instance are dropped. The object stands beside the list so no text lies over it.

name: Header with arrows, captioned card row
description: On the ground. A header row inside the page margins: a title in the head step at the left, an optional one-line sub in the lead step, and two text links with typeset arrows (Previous, Next; 44px targets) right-aligned on the same row. 48px below, one row of three visible cards of five, 440px wide with 20px gaps, so the row fills the container exactly. Each card has a 440x300 picture on top and, on the surface tone under it, a title of at most three words in the lead step and one line of at most eight words in the body step, in the dealt corner. The links page the row one card at a time (translate 460px over 500ms, ease); the row is clipped at the container margins, with no peeking card, no drag and no free scroll; a link dims at each end. Ink on card, the accent on the links' hover or none. Variant: portrait cards (a 3:4 picture over a short caption zone).
phone: Cards stack one per row with 16:10 pictures and 20px gaps; the links are hidden.
houseRuleCheck: Only the two links step the row: no pointer drag, no free scroll, nothing peeking at the screen edge, no second button shape. The cards carry a fill so each caption is grouped with its picture.

name: Header row over four portrait tiles
description: A page-ground section with two category blocks. Each block: a header row 40 tall inside the page margins, with a 24px category title in the display face at the left and, at the right, one 16px sentence-case link with an arrow, underlined on hover only; 16px below, four portrait tiles 339 by 424 (ratio 0.8, the dealt corner), 12px apart across the full width inside the page margins. Tiles carry no captions or controls, the picture is the content, and each tile is one link with an aria-label that names it. The two blocks sit 72px apart. Hover scales the image to 1.04 inside its crop. Phone: tiles in a two-column grid with 12px gutters, the header row stacked above.
phone: Two-column tile grid with 12px gutters, header row stacked above.
houseRuleCheck: The category title uses the display face, never a serif of its own; the link is 16px sentence case, not tiny caps; margins follow the page margin (24px was too narrow); two blocks, not three, so it is not a wall of tiles.

name: Heading, copy, overlapping photo strip
description: On the page ground: a two-line headline at the head step at the left margin and, top-aligned in the right column, a paragraph at the lead step of three lines (at most 30 words, 520px wide). 96px below, a strip of three overlapping landscape photographs (the dealt corner): the centre one 620x400, the two sides 480x320 tucked 80px under it with their tops offset 8 to 16px; each grows 4% as it passes the middle of the screen. The dealt button closes the section, centred under the strip.
phone: Headline, then paragraph, stacked; the photographs stack with a 40px overlap, the centre one first.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the row of partner logos and the round social buttons (credit wall and clutter), and the shader field behind the section (the ground is flat). Photographs must show real subjects, not archive documents.

name: Heading over drifting portrait columns
description: The page ground gives way to the surface tone with a hard straight edge. A centred heading of two lines at the display step. 160px below, three portrait cards spread across the container with 48px between them, each a photograph about 448x480 (the dealt corner on the card) over a name strip on the card's fill holding the person's name and role at the body step, one line each; the three cards drift at different scroll speeds (0.9, 1.0 and 1.1). A text link with an arrow sits centred under the heading.
phone: Heading at the head step on two lines; the portraits become a single column of three at 80% width with the speed split reduced.
houseRuleCheck: The heading is no longer a window onto a moving colour field (a picture or gradient inside a headline, and several fills): it is plain type. The small label and the bracketed link are dropped. The name strip is one card fill with body-size sentence-case text, and each portrait card is a photograph running to the card's edges.

name: Heading and text columns over a scene
description: One dark atmospheric still photograph (a made image or a calm landscape, never documentary) fills about a screen. The heading and the columns stand on its calm dark part, with no tint, no gradient and no box laid over it. A 50px two-line heading sits at the left (x 80); its second line takes the muted ink. 72px lower, three short text columns: one 445 wide at x 80 and two 260 wide at x 672 and x 1000, 17px, two lines each (about 14 words), each opening with a 20px bold lead-in in place of any label. No index mark and no rule. The text is simply there (the dealt entrance decides arrival). Phone: heading 34px, columns stacked at 24px margins with 32px between.
phone: Heading 34px, columns stacked at 24px margins with 32px between.
houseRuleCheck: The rotated-square index and the 1px line are dropped (numbering, thin rule). The dimmed second line takes the muted ink so it stays readable; the columns are cut from four lines to two (60 words a section); the stagger rise is the dealt entrance; a clip or shader backdrop became a still photograph so no video or shader is needed.

name: Heading with logo tiles
description: Page ground. At the top left a two-line heading at the head step and, under it, one sentence at the body step of up to 20 words (520px wide). 72px below, a grid of six to eight square tiles about 160x160 (the dealt corner, 16px gaps, up to four per row) in the surface tone, each holding a single-ink logo about 56px tall at 85% opacity that rises to 100% on hover. Real marks only. Variant: one row of five wider cells (about 262x88) under a heading at the left.
phone: Three tiles per row at 100px; heading at the head step.
houseRuleCheck: Tiles are fills in one tone with no outlines. The id said boxed and is now filled; the grid is cut from twelve tiles to eight at most (no wall of tiles), the 160px of empty ground below is dropped (the dealt section gap decides) and the trapezoid-notch sheet variant is dropped (a drawn shape). Do not invent logos: with fewer than six real marks, skip the pattern. A grid of tiles is fine as one section, never as the whole page.

name: Headline beside inset portrait
description: The ground changes from the page ground to the surface tone along a straight hard edge as the section enters. At the left margin a left-aligned headline of two lines at the display step (words of six letters or fewer), 40px under it a paragraph at the lead step of two lines, 440px wide, then the dealt button. At the right a 560x780 portrait photograph (the dealt corner) sits at the right page margin and 64px from the section top; the headline stays clear of the portrait. The portrait drifts up 40px with scroll. Ink on the ground, the accent only on the dealt button.
phone: Headline at the display step on top, the portrait at full width less the margins under it, the paragraph and button last.
houseRuleCheck: Edge contact fixed: the portrait stays inside the right page margin. The wavy ground edge (a drawn shape), the small badge (an eyebrow) and the headline overlap on the portrait (text over a photograph) are dropped. The headline is plain type with no accent word, and its size maps onto the display step.

name: Headline marquee row
description: A section as tall as its content on the page ground. A headline of four words at the display step, in the display weight and sentence case, is repeated three times in one row and slides sideways in a 20s linear loop, clipped symmetrically by both screen edges. 96px under it, at the left margin, one line at the sub step; at the right margin, the dealt button. The row pauses on hover; under reduced motion it stops with the first copy centred. The headline is the section's heading (the repeats are hidden from assistive tech). Ink on the ground, the accent only on the dealt button.
phone: Headline at the display step with a 28s loop; the sub line and the button stack at the left margin under it.
houseRuleCheck: The marquee is clipped by both edges, a continuing row, not a box stuck to one edge. The sub line and the button keep the page margins. The small captions around the row are dropped (less text), and so is the variant's share stack of round buttons (a second button shape) with its condensed serif phrase. Absorbs 1 near-duplicate (ids in merged).

name: Headline over drifting portrait strip
description: Page ground. A centred two-line headline at the display step. 96px below it, one row of six portrait photograph tiles (about 320x480, the dealt corner, 16px gaps, shown twice in the row for a seamless loop) running symmetrically past both screen edges and drifting left at a constant 40px per second; it pauses on hover. Nothing else in the scene.
phone: Headline at the head step; tiles 200x300; speed 30px per second.
houseRuleCheck: A strip clipped by both edges is a continuing row; no tile stops flush at one edge and there is no drag handle. Tiles are plain photographs with no tabs, and stills only (the video clips are dropped); twenty tiles are cut to six, each photograph once. The tiles must be authored pictures, not documentary photographs. The giant tonal word variant is dropped. Absorbs 1 near-duplicate (ids in merged).

name: Headline over tilted photo row
description: Page ground. A centred two-line headline at the display step in ink, 140px from the top; under it a paragraph at the lead step of two lines (at most 22 words, 580px wide) and the dealt button. 120px below, a row of five photo tiles, each 290x380 (the dealt corner) and rotated between -5 and +5 degrees, overlapping by 20px and centred, the first and last bleeding about 30% past the screen edges on both sides. Tiles straighten to 0 degrees on hover in 300ms. The row drifts 40px against the scroll.
phone: Headline at the head step; tiles 180x240 with three visible and centred.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the tilted badge at the top (an eyebrow label), the white outline on the headline and the accent colour on the headline (one accent, never a second headline colour). The tilt sits on photographs only. A centred headline, line and button over a photograph row is close to the template stack, so keep it a section and never the hero.

name: Headline over tilted product card row
description: Page ground. A two-line headline centred at the display step. 72px below it, four filled cards in a row, each about 330x520 (the dealt corner, 12px gaps) on the surface tone, centred; each holds a centred title at the sub step at the top and, below it, a cut-out product photograph tilted 4 to 8 degrees (alternating left and right, no shadow). Hover turns a card's fill to the accent, with the ink flipped, and straightens its product in 250ms. The cards arrive with the dealt entrance.
phone: The four cards form a 2x2 grid about 165x260 each.
houseRuleCheck: The giant tonal word (a 400px ghost word, a size and a contrast the dealt type lacks) and the overflowing card row are dropped. Four tones of one hue become one surface tone with the accent only on hover (no wall of tiles in several fills). The flourish above the headline (a drawn shape) stays out. The tilted product has no frame of its own and no card inside it.

name: Headline then scroll-driven mixed-width cards
description: Page ground, pinned for at most 1400px of scroll. A one-line headline of a few words at the display step across the container. 96px below it a row of three to five filled cards, 24px gaps, all about 520px tall: portrait picture cards about 392px wide with white text directly on the photograph's calm part, and one wide 783px split card (a picture on one half, a title and two lines of text on the other half on the surface tone). The first card starts at the left page margin; vertical scroll moves the row sideways, so cards pass behind the screen edges and the next one enters from the right, and the last card comes to rest at the right page margin. Each card carries at most 12 words.
phone: The pin is removed and the cards stack vertically at full width less the margins.
houseRuleCheck: The id and name no longer say rail: nothing is dragged and there is no handle or progress bar; the sideways move is driven by native scroll. The card cut by the right edge now ends at the right page margin; the split card's two text tabs are dropped (tabs hide content). Cards are fills; no box sits on a photograph, only text on its calm part.

name: Image-left card two-by-two grid
description: Page ground. A two-line headline at the head step at the left margin. 96px below, a grid of four filled cards in two columns and two rows (each about 596 wide and 250px tall, 24px gaps, the dealt corner, the surface tone). Each card has a 186px-wide photograph flush left inside it, running to the card's edges with no frame of its own, and, to its right, a title at the lead step in semibold (at most four words), one paragraph at the body step in 65% ink (one or two lines, at most 12 words) and a text link with an arrow at the bottom, underlined on hover. The cards arrive with the dealt entrance.
phone: One column; each card at full width less the margins with a 96px photograph at the left, or a 16:9 photograph on top when the text needs room.
houseRuleCheck: Filled cards are wanted. Six cards are cut to four (under 60 words), the rise-on-entry is dropped, and the grey paragraph is raised to a 4.5:1 ink. No icon on top of a card, no outline, no card inside a card; the grid is one section, never the whole page.

name: Inset band: heading, image, copy
description: A band on the dealt field (used once on the page; the surface tone on a dark page) inset to the page margins (about 1400x448, the dealt corner). Three zones across it: at the left, 120px in, a two-line heading at the head step; in the middle third a cut-out product or render about 360px tall, cropped by the band's top or bottom edge and moving 20px against the scroll; at the right a paragraph at the body step of three or four lines (at most 30 words, 340px wide) with the dealt button under it. Ink on the field, accent on the dealt button only.
phone: Heading, image and paragraph stack inside the band (full width less the margins), the image cropped by the band's bottom edge.
houseRuleCheck: The 'illustrated' id is retired: the flat illustration (a drawn picture) is replaced by a photograph or render, and the coloured rule (hairline) and the translucent chip (glass) are dropped. The band is as tall as its content.

name: Black panel with edge-crossing photo frames
description: On the page ground, a panel on the dealt field (used once on the page; the surface tone on a dark page) inset to the page margins (about 1368x560, the dealt corner) clips everything inside it. Centred in it: a two-line headline at the display step (short words) and the dealt button under it. Three portrait photographs (4:5, the dealt corner, each 260 to 300px wide) move through the panel: one crosses the top edge at the left, one crosses the bottom edge at the right, and one crosses the top edge at the far right, so the headline and the button stay on clear panel; at least two thirds of each photograph stays inside. They are cropped by the panel's edges and drift vertically about 80px at different speeds with scroll.
phone: Panel at full width less the margins and 480px tall; two photographs only, one crossing each edge; headline at the head step.
houseRuleCheck: The 2px outline on the photo frames is dropped (outlined boxes). The photographs are clipped by the panel and carry no box. The three-line uppercase title is a two-line headline at the display step, and the black panel is the dealt field, used once. The panel is as tall as its content.

name: Inset dark banner with one small row
description: A panel on the dealt field (used once on the page; the surface tone on a dark page) inset to the page margins, as tall as its row plus 72px of padding above and below (the dealt corner). One centred horizontal row: a phrase at the lead step (the section's heading), a second phrase at the lead step at 60% of the panel's ink (each at most six words) and the dealt button. Nothing else in the panel. It arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: The panel is full width less the margins; the row stacks as phrase, phrase, then the dealt button at full width.
houseRuleCheck: The panel was 450px tall around one small row, an empty pause, so it is now content height. The outlined pill becomes the dealt button (no arrow chip), the 14px text is raised to the lead step, and the second phrase is muted instead of accent-coloured so it is not a styled accent word. Two short phrases at most: a call, not a paragraph.

name: Inset full-screen photo with bottom caption
description: A pinned full-screen studio photograph inset to the page margins at the sides, 32px at the bottom and 24px below the top of the viewport (the dealt corner), held for about one and a half screens. A cut-out object photograph (the page's subject, 360px wide) moves in from a lower corner with the scroll and settles in the lower right third, clear of the caption. Caption at the bottom centre: a title at the head step in the display weight and sentence case, about 100px above the bottom, and, under it, a text link at the lead step, underlined, in the lighter of the ground and the ink on the photograph's calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the caption only).
phone: Inset at the page margins; the title at the sub step; the cut-out 160px; the pin is cut to 120vh.
houseRuleCheck: The 5px inset is widened to the page margin so nothing touches the edge. The motif band and the 3D letter shape are dropped (drawn shapes), and the uppercase title becomes sentence case. The caption sits straight on the photograph's calm part, no box, clear of the cut-out.

name: Inset image stack beside active text
description: Two columns on the page ground, as tall as the content (three or four items). Left half: a column of pictures 680 by 460 with the dealt corner, 20px apart, inside the page margin so none touches the screen edge; the current picture is at full opacity and the others at 70%. Right half (x 780 to 1360): text items paired one to one with the pictures on a 480 pitch, each a 36px title and one 17px line (12 words at most), vertically centred on its picture; the current item is in the full ink and the others in the muted ink (never lighter, so the text stays readable at 4.5:1). No icon chips, numerals or rules, and no mirrored second instance. Pictures and text scroll together; the current pair is the one nearest the viewport centre and the only change is the opacity and ink swap. Phone: each item becomes a picture (4:3, full width inside the margins) over its text, no dimming.
phone: Each item is a picture over its text at full width inside the margins, no dimming.
houseRuleCheck: Pictures sit inside the page margin and take the dealt corner (nothing runs into one edge); the icon chip is dropped; dimmed text became the muted ink so it stays readable; each item is a title and one line (60 words a section); the mirrored second instance is dropped (never two splits alike in a row).

name: Inset rounded video with caption
description: One video about 1408x792 at the page margins (the dealt corner), muted and autoplaying. At the bottom left, 32px in, a four-word caption at the lead step in the lighter of the ground and the ink sits straight on the footage's calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under it only; no gradient, no line). As scroll continues the clip dims to 40% brightness, a second caption of up to five words crossfades in at the centre at the head step, and the frame scales down to 0.92 as the next section rises over it. Variant: a three-line statement at the sub step in the top-left corner and a three-line paragraph at the body step in the bottom-left corner, 40px in, with the video parallaxing 8% inside the panel.
phone: The frame is full width less the margins in a 4:5 crop; the caption at the body step.
houseRuleCheck: No hairline above the caption and no gradient behind it: the footage's calm part carries the legibility. The second caption is part of the scroll film, not a reveal below the fold.

name: Inset shader panel with centred line
description: A framed WebGL panel about 1368x760 at the page margins (the dealt corner), running a slow shader of two hard-edged flat tone fields (the ground and the surface tone, posterised bands, no smooth blends) whose borders drift 20 to 40px per second. Centred on the panel: a headline of at most four words at the display step, then, 32px under it, one sentence at the body step and the dealt button. Nothing crosses the panel edge.
phone: The panel is full width less the margins by 70svh; the headline at the head step.
houseRuleCheck: The smooth three-colour gradient is replaced by hard-edged posterised fields in two palette tones; any smooth blend in the shader would break the gradient ban. Drifting discs and thin slivers are left out (drawn shapes, hairlines). The two-word line above the headline (an eyebrow) is dropped, and a sentence and the dealt button are added so the headline is not alone on its screen. It needs WebGL but no assets.

name: Inside-ring 3D photo gallery
description: A full-screen WebGL canvas, pinned for about 1800px of scroll, with the camera at the centre of a ring of eight bent photograph planes (each about 2.4 by 3 metres in scene space, ring radius 5 metres) at two alternating heights. The canvas is inset to the page margins with the dealt corner and the camera looks slightly down, so three planes show whole at rest: left low and large, centre high, right low; a plane crosses the canvas edge only while the ring turns. Scroll spins the ring and it eases to the nearest plane when idle; hovering a plane scales it 1.05. The section's heading (one line, the head step) stands at the top left on the stage's ground (the ink field on a light page, the page ground on a dark one), and a one-line caption at the lead step for the plane in focus sits at the bottom centre, both in the colour that reads on that ground.
phone: The same canvas; scroll spins the ring; four planes visible; caption at the body step.
houseRuleCheck: The dial-style menu with small uppercase labels and the back pill are dropped, and the spin runs on native scroll, never a wheel or swipe hijack. At rest every plane sits whole inside the margins; one crosses the canvas edge only while the ring turns. Authored photographs, never archive documents. Needs a WebGL scene and eight photographs.

name: Heading left, twin text columns right
description: Page ground. A two-line heading at the head step at the left margin (about 300px wide). To the right, two filled cards about 332px wide at x 700 and x 1060 (28px gap, the dealt corner, the surface tone, 24px padding), each holding a lead line at the lead step in semibold and a paragraph at the body step of three lines (at most 20 words).
phone: The heading, then the two cards stacked at full width less the margins.
houseRuleCheck: The id's rule is retired: the 1px rule is dropped (hairline). The 13.5px eight-line paragraphs are cut to body-size three-line paragraphs (less text) and set on filled cards for grouping; the three-line heading is two lines; the 240px of empty ground below is dropped (the dealt section gap decides). No card inside a card.

name: Left statement over reactive relief canvas
description: A full-screen WebGL relief lit from the upper left, built as hard-edged facets in two flat tones (the ground and the surface tone), no smooth shading blend. A two-line headline at the display step, 552px wide at x 135, just below centre, with the dealt button 32px under it. The relief fractures into tiles that tilt away with scroll and part around the cursor within a 200px radius, easing back in 600ms.
phone: The headline at the head step in the lower third; the relief tiles are about 120px and tilt with scroll only, no cursor.
houseRuleCheck: The embossed lighting is built from flat facet tones, not a smooth gradient and not a drop shadow, and the facets use two tones, not a wall of several fills. The four-line 52px statement paragraph is a two-line headline and its rise-in on first scroll is dropped. The 14px hint line is dropped. Text must stay readable over every tilting tile. Needs WebGL.

name: Narrow centred column with margin photos
description: A centred column 460px wide with 24px gaps: a heading of two lines at the display step (short words), a paragraph at the lead step of three or four lines (at most 24 words, left aligned) and the dealt button. Two photographs, 220x306 (the dealt corner), sit in the side margins, one at the left and one at the right page margin, and drift up at different speeds with the scroll (60px and 100px), so one trails lower. The ground is flat.
phone: The column at full width less the margins; the two photographs, 140x200, sit side by side above the column.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the small bracketed label and the one-line note. The side photographs sit at the page margins on both sides (equal margins). No box on a photograph, and none sits behind text. The three-line heading is two lines; the entrance rise and the column drift are dropped.

name: Offset title over stepped text columns
description: About two screens on the page ground. A two-line title at the display step at x 736. At the left, from the page margin, a tall portrait photograph or cut-out about 300x520 fills the left quarter. Two 320px text columns sit at x 376 and x 736, the second 40px lower so they step down from each other; each has a title at the sub step, a 20px gap and a paragraph at the body step of at most 22 words. A wide photograph follows below at the full container width.
phone: The portrait first, then the title, then the two columns stacked with the 40px step as a left indent alternating 0 and 24px; the wide photograph last.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the empty left quarter (a row empty at the left; a photograph fills it), the 48px rule (hairline), the byline, the halftone fragment and the small-caps paragraph; paragraphs are regular sentence-case body size. The 36-word paragraphs are cut to 22 words (less text), the vague media below is one wide photograph, and the id's wordmark is retired (a title, not a logo).

name: Offset title, side copy, cascading photos
description: About two screens on one flat ground. A one-word title at the display step at x 96 and, at x 954, a side block with a paragraph at the body step of three lines (420px wide, at most 18 words) and the dealt button. Below, four photographs cascade down and to the right: 640x560 near the left margin, 360x214 in the middle, 220x280 further right and a tall portrait (300x460) at the far right page margin, each drifting a little with the scroll at its own speed. Then three statement rows 160px apart, each a filled card (the dealt corner, the card fill): a label at the lead step of at most three words at x 90, a line at the body step of at most eight words at x 490 and a year range at the head step at the right.
phone: Title at the display step, paragraph, then the photographs as a staircase alternating 12% offsets; the statement rows stack with the year above the text.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the small label over the paragraph; the outlined pill becomes the dealt button; the rows are fills, not ruled; the fifth photograph and the rise-on-entry are dropped. The year range is a date, not a counter. Words are cut so the section stays near 60.

name: Photo band over left headline
description: A section as tall as its content on the page ground. A full-bleed photograph band, 1440x400, runs across the top, clipped by both edges and drifting 5% against the scroll. 96px below it, a left-aligned headline of two lines at the display step at the left margin and, in the right column from x 740, a paragraph at the lead step of four lines (at most 34 words, 560px wide) with a text link under it. Ink on the ground, accent on the link only.
phone: The band is full width by 240px tall; the headline at the head step; the paragraph stacked under it.
houseRuleCheck: Clear. The flat-grain ground is now the plain page ground, the headline is two lines at most, and a band clipped by both edges is a full-bleed band, not a box stopped flush at one edge.

name: Rounded panel rising over hero
description: A panel on the surface tone with the dealt corner on its top corners slides up over the hero as the page scrolls; its top edge settles about 90px below the top of the screen. 100px under that edge, a paragraph at the sub step of three lines (at most 24 words, 534px wide) at x 108 and, 28px under it, the dealt button. A cut-out figure photograph of the subject (the one the hero shows when it has one) stands in front of the panel at the lower right, about 520px wide, its bottom cropped by the panel's bottom edge. Ink on the surface tone, accent on the dealt button only.
phone: The panel's top edge at 60px; the paragraph at the lead step; the figure 260px at the bottom right.
houseRuleCheck: The hero still fills the first screen alone on load; the panel appears only on scroll. No shadow under the panel: the overlap reads from the colour change. The cream is the surface tone and the 192x62 pill is the dealt button. The figure is a cut-out that must exist.

name: Text tile beside a live map tile
description: A one-line h2 at the head step on the ground at the left margin, then a pair of filled tiles 12px apart across the content width, 480px tall at 1440, in the dealt corner. Left tile (surface tone, about 40% wide): one lead-step sentence at the top with 32px padding and, at the bottom, the visit facts as two plain body-step lines (for example open today, next free slot) and the dealt button. Right tile (about 60%): a real interactive map of the real place, styled muted to match the palette, with plus and minus buttons in the dealt button's shape at the lower right and one marker in the accent on the place. The map takes scroll only after a click, so the page never sticks. The tiles arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: stack the tiles 12px apart, text tile first at its content height, map tile 360px tall with a tap-to-activate layer.
phone: Tiles stack, text tile first at its content height, map tile 360px tall with tap to activate, 12px apart.
houseRuleCheck: Filled tiles only: no outlines, no chips. The map is a real embed in the page palette, never a drawn illustration. The heading stands on the ground, not in a tile.

name: Tilted sheet rising over the video
description: A cover-up that carries the page out of a full-screen footage scene. A flat sheet in the page ground, tilted 2 degrees so its top edge rises from left to right, slides up over the footage as you scroll and levels to 0 degrees as it fills the screen (about 80vh of scroll, ease-out); the footage behind stays untouched, with no tint. On the sheet, in ink: a heading of one to three words at the display step with the dealt tracking, whole and inside the page margin, then one lead-step line and the dealt button. The sheet is as tall as its content and no taller. Phone: tilt 1.5 degrees, the dealt button full width under the line.
phone: Tilt 1.5 degrees, the dealt button full width under the line.
houseRuleCheck: The heading sits whole inside the page margin, never cut by an edge. No counts. One button design, the dealt one.

name: Title over the held hero photo, copy and links
description: The hero's photograph stays full bleed and pinned for about one more screen of scroll (the first screen itself is unchanged) while two title lines of one or two words each, at the display step in one light tone, cross the upper half sliding 120px left against the scroll. Low left at the page margin: one lead-step paragraph of 22 words at most, 440px wide, and one text link with an arrow. Low right: four links at the sub step, stacked, and one body-step contact column beside them. Hover: a link's ink goes to the accent over 250ms. Words sit on the photograph's calm part, in one tone, and are read at 1440, 768 and 390. Phone: the title at the head step over two lines at the top, paragraph and links stacked at the bottom, contact lines last.
phone: Title at the head step over two lines at the top, paragraph, links and contact lines stacked at the bottom over the photograph.
houseRuleCheck: The paragraph is held to 22 words; no tint over the photograph: the words sit on its calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only). Links and contact lines are plain text and nothing is framed on the photograph. The photograph is art-directed, never documentary.

name: Title, tilted photo pair, copy and lists
description: Page ground. A two-word title in two lines at the display step at the left margin. Under it, the left half (about 640px wide) holds two overlapping portraits (about 520x700 and 480x660, the dealt corner), the second rotated about 5 degrees and overlapping the first by 80px. The right half, from x 780, has a paragraph at the lead step of four lines (at most 32 words, 540px wide) and one column of five text links at the body step, underlined, 24px apart. The photographs arrive with the dealt entrance.
phone: Title at the display step; the photographs stacked with the same overlap; the paragraph; then the column of links.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the small label; two columns of seven and fourteen 10px links are cut to one column of five at body size (clutter); the title margin is raised from 8px to the page margin; the rise-on-entry is dropped.

name: Two-line statement over tile and link column
description: Page ground. A two-line statement of at most 12 words across the container at the display step, plain with no inline marks, set as the section's heading. 56px under it, at the left margin, a 440px tile on the surface tone (the dealt corner) holding a cut-out figure or product photograph that drifts up 30px with scroll, with a two-line caption at the body step under the tile (its second line indented 24px). At x 560 a 640px column holds a paragraph at the lead step of two or three lines (at most 24 words) and two stacked filled link rows (62px tall, the dealt corner, the card fill), each with a title at the lead step and an arrow at the right.
phone: The statement at the head step; the tile at full width; the column stacked under it with the link rows at full width.
houseRuleCheck: The three-line 64px statement paragraph is now a two-line headline at the display step (a paragraph is 36px at most), so the id's glyph and paragraph are retired. The 2px rule, the ruled link rows and the inline glyph tags are dropped (hairlines and drawn marks). The tile and the column start at the left so no row is empty at the left. Link rows are fills, not outlined boxes, and no box is nested inside the tile.

name: Display statement with a word-by-word lift
description: A statement section that is one headline and nothing else: no label, no date, no body text. One h2 of 5 to 8 words in the display face at the display step, two lines at most at every width, left aligned at the page margin across the content width. It says plainly who the page is for or what it believes, in this client's words. Each word starts in muted ink and turns to full ink in reading order as the block crosses the screen (about 120ms per word, driven by scroll, done when the block centre passes 40% of the screen height); every word gets the same treatment, none is coloured or set apart. The section is as tall as its text plus the dealt section padding. Phone: the sub step, full width inside the margins, two lines, the same word-by-word turn driven by scroll. Reduced motion or no JavaScript: every word in full ink.
phone: Sub step, two lines inside the margins, the word-by-word turn driven by scroll; full ink when motion is reduced.
houseRuleCheck: A statement is a short headline at display size, two lines at most (a paragraph over 36px is banned). The top rule and the small label are dropped. Inactive words are muted ink at full contrast, never faded.

name: Table rows that invert, with a cursor image
description: A project or catalogue index as filled rows. Above the list: an h2 at the head step at the left and, at the right margin, the dealt button. Then four to six rows across the content width, each 88px tall, 8px apart, in the surface tone and the dealt corner: the title at the lead step in medium weight (about five columns), the client or category at the body step (three columns), one short tag at the body step (two columns) and a plain arrow at the right end. Hover (fine pointers only): the row fill swaps to ink, the text to the ground colour and the arrow to the accent over 200ms, and a 300x380 picture of that row follows the cursor with a 0.15 lerp, scaling 0.9 to 1 and tilting up to 4 degrees with velocity; it hides when the pointer leaves the list. Each row has its own picture. The rows arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: no cursor picture; each row is a filled row with its title and one tag line, and a tap opens the page.
phone: Rows keep the title and one tag line, the cursor picture is dropped, a tap opens the page.
houseRuleCheck: No rules and no numbering: rows are filled bars separated by space. One button design, the dealt one. Pictures are art-directed, one per row, each used once.

name: Iris opening over a cursor-reactive portrait
description: A stage in the darkest tone of the palette, one screen tall, with no copy until the title. A circular clip centred at 50% x, 40% y opens from nothing to about 25% of the viewport diagonal, driven by scroll as the stage arrives (about one screen of scroll, ease-out), and stays there. Inside the iris a portrait fills the viewport, built from three stacked cut-out layers of one photographed or rendered subject (back, head, features); on a fine pointer the layers follow it by 6, 14 and 28px and the eyes track it, moving 10px up, down, left or right at most. Over the lower third a one-word title of 5 to 9 letters at the display step in the lighter of the ground and the ink, in the display face, arrives with the dealt entrance. Two text links at body size sit in the bottom corners on the page margins and lead to real choices. Phone: iris 40% of the height, a slow idle sway of 8px in place of the pointer, the word at the head step, links stacked at the bottom centre.
phone: Iris 40% of the height, idle sway instead of pointer tracking, the word at the head step, links stacked at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: The title is one display-step word in sentence case. The portrait is photographed or rendered cut-outs, never a drawn face. The stage is filled by the portrait, not an empty screen.

name: Photo left, copy and one button right
description: A calm half-and-half row on the page ground. Left: a 585x390 photograph in the dealt corner whose top 40px tucks up into the previous section's bottom padding so the two sections interlock (the dealt gap between their contents holds), with 6% inner parallax. Right, 510px wide, starting 100px after the photograph and centred on its height: an h2 at the head step in plain ink, one lead-step paragraph of 24 words at most, 32px of space, then the dealt button with one text link with an arrow beside it. Phone: the photograph first at full width inside the margins (4:3) with its overlap, the copy under it, the button full width, the link under the button.
phone: Photograph first at 4:3 with its overlap kept, copy below, the dealt button full width and the link under it.
houseRuleCheck: No heading underbar and no rule above the buttons: space separates them. The two store badges become the one dealt button and a text link (one button design, never two buttons to the same place).

name: Object opens on scroll
description: A flat ground in the field tone or the surface tone, about one screen tall, pinned for about 1.5 screens of scroll. A large 3D object (a pack, can or box, about 70% of the screen height) fills the middle while two or three product cut-outs sit around it and a title at the display step on two lines stands above it. Scroll drives the object open: its lid or flap lifts and the product's contents (cut-outs, not drawn particles) rise out of it over the pinned length, then the pin releases. A click, tap or Enter on the object opens it at once, so nothing is ever locked and there is no drag handle. Place it below the hero, never as the first screen. Phone: object 85vw wide, tap the object to open it, title at the display step.
phone: Object 85vw wide; tap it to open or scroll; title at the display step.
houseRuleCheck: The scroll lock and the drag-and-pull tab are dropped (a trap and a drag device): scroll drives the opening and a click or Enter opens it at once; the sticker is real product cut-outs; the title no longer builds letter by letter (the dealt entrance decides). Below the hero only.

name: Colour-echo title around a rolling object
description: A pinned scene about 220vh long. The ground starts on the page ground and swaps to the surface tone at 55% of the pin (a flat swap over 400ms). A two-word title at the display step, centred, is stacked three times at different depths: two copies behind a 3D object and one in front, the front copy in ink, the one behind it in muted ink and the farthest in the surface tone (no new hues), offset 0, 14 and 28px down so they read as an echo; the extra copies are decoration, hidden from screen readers. A rendered 3D object (a model in three.js or a pre-rendered turntable) turns a full 360 degrees while it travels from lower left to upper right across the pin. Four short claims of up to five words at the lead step, in sentence case, fade in at the corners of a 900x500 area at 20, 40, 60 and 80% of the pin. Phone: the title at the display step over two lines with two echo copies, the object 60% of the width, one claim at a time at the bottom.
phone: Title at the display step over two lines with two echoes, object 60% of the width, one claim at a time at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: Echo copies use palette tones only: no new hues, no outlines. The object is a render or a model, never a drawn illustration. The pin is about 220vh with something new at every step.

name: Layered photo close with a product rise
description: A pinned closing scene about 200vh long. Three stacked picture layers (sky, middle ground and foreground, three separate files cut for depth from one art-directed scene) move at 0.2, 0.5 and 0.9 of scroll speed, none blurred. Centred over them: a two-line headline at the display step that slides down 80px against the scroll, one lead-step paragraph of 30 words at most and the dealt button. Words sit on the calm part, in one tone, with a flat dark band under them only where contrast needs it. After about one screen of scroll a cut-out product image (520px tall) rises from below the fold to the centre. Nothing else is on the stage: no rulers, counters or progress marks. Phone: the headline at the head step, layers at half the travel, the button full width, the product rises to 320px.
phone: Headline at the head step, layers at half the travel, the dealt button full width, product rises to 320px.
houseRuleCheck: Depth comes from speed alone: no blurred layers. The ruler with counters is dropped. Words sit on the calm part with no box on the pictures. Pictures are art-directed, never documentary.

name: Colour lead tile and a photo tile row
description: An h2 of two to four words at the head step on the ground at the left margin, then a row of five equal portrait tiles (3:4, about 248x330 at 1440) 16px apart inside the page margins, in the dealt corner: nothing is cut by an edge and nothing drags. Tile one is a filled tile in ink with ground-coloured letters, carrying one lead-step sentence of 8 to 12 words at the bottom left with 20px padding and one text link with an arrow. Tiles two to five are portrait photographs, each with a one-line caption at the small step under it, 16px below (no chips on the photographs). Hover: a photograph zooms 1.06 inside its crop over 500ms and its caption shifts 4px. The tiles arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: a two-column grid, tile one spanning both columns at 200px tall, the four photographs below in two rows.
