phone: Two-column grid with the ink tile spanning both columns at 200px tall, the four photographs in two rows below.
houseRuleCheck: All five tiles sit inside the margins and nothing drags. Captions sit under the photographs, never on them. The one colour tile is ink, not an accent fill, and the heading stands on the ground.

name: Text columns, then centred title
description: A panel on the ground inside the page margins. At the top two text columns, each about 420px wide with a 120px gap: a lead line in the lead step at weight 600 over a paragraph of three lines at most in the body step. About half the dealt section gap below, a centred block: the section's heading in the display step, sentence case, two lines at most, with a caption in the body step under it. Ink on ground; the accent only on one text link, if the section needs an action.
phone: The columns stack with 32px between them; the heading sets at the display step inside the page margins.
houseRuleCheck: The bracketed mono labels became lead lines, the caption is sentence case, and no chip follows the pointer. Running text stays at 16px or more, never tiny labels.

name: Centred four-column link group
description: A quiet directory as the last beat before the footer, never the footer itself. One filled panel in the surface tone and the dealt corner, 56px padding, about 1010px wide and centred, holds four equal columns on a 232px pitch: each an h3 at the lead step in medium weight over four links at the body step in muted ink, 40px apart, left aligned in its column. The links go to real pages the footer does not repeat (guides, programmes, help). No rules, no icons. Hover: a link turns to full ink and slides 4px right over 200ms. The panel is as tall as its content. Phone: the panel spans the width inside the margins and the columns fall two by two with 28px between rows. Variant: no panel, the four columns stand open on the ground on a 320px pitch from the left margin.
phone: Panel at the width inside the margins, columns in a two by two grid.
houseRuleCheck: The links sit on one filled panel so the group reads as one unit, never loose text without a container. Link text is body size or larger.

name: Echoed headline over 3D signposts
description: A closing destination scene one screen tall at 1440 (80svh on a phone), on the ink field, with nothing else around it. Centred: a two-line headline at the display step in ground-coloured letters, echoed twice below it, first in a muted tone and then in the surface tone, same face and size, no outlines; the echoes are decoration, hidden from screen readers. Above the headline one large extruded 3D letter (a rendered model or pre-rendered frames) floats and turns slowly. At the bottom one centred pole carries two 3D signboards pointing opposite ways, each about 360x110 with a destination label at the lead step, built from rendered geometry; each board is a real link, with a plain text link under it for keyboard and phone. Hover: a board swings 8 degrees towards the pointer. Phone: the headline at the head step with two echoes, the pole shorter, labels at the body step.
phone: Headline at the head step with two echoes, shorter pole, labels at the body step.
houseRuleCheck: The top edge is straight with the dealt corner, not a drawn wave. Echoes are tones of the ink, never outlines. The letter and the signboards are rendered 3D geometry, never a drawn illustration.

name: Four image link columns
description: Four equal image-led link columns across the content width with 16px gaps (about 319px each at 1440). Per column from the top: a title at the lead step in the display face; 12px below it a portrait picture of 319x394 in the dealt corner; 12px under that a caption of one or two lines at the small step in muted ink. No buttons or arrows: the whole column is the link. Hover: the picture zooms 1.05 inside its crop over 500ms and the title goes to the accent. The columns arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: two columns by two rows with 4:5 pictures and one-line captions.
phone: Two by two grid, 4:5 pictures, one-line captions.
houseRuleCheck: Captions are sentence case at the small step; titles sit above the picture, never on it. The picture keeps each column together; no outlines or rules.

name: Heading left, picture link cards right
description: A section on the ink field. Left, from the page margin and about 340px wide: an h2 at the head step over two lines and one lead-step paragraph in a muted tone, both in ground-coloured letters, no ornament. Right, from x 550: four link cards 20px apart, each 190x260 in the dealt corner; the upper 60% is a cover photograph and the lower 40% a surface-tone strip holding one body-step label at the left and a plain arrow at the right. The whole card is the link. Hover: the card lifts 8px over 250ms and the photograph zooms 1.06. The cards arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: the heading on top, the cards in a two by two grid, 200px tall.
phone: Heading on top, cards in a two by two grid, 200px tall.
houseRuleCheck: Each card shows a photograph, never an icon (no icon-topped cards). No ornament; labels are body size.

name: One-word title, figure column and topic cards
description: A topic hub. Top: a one-word h2 at the display step at the page margin, no counts. Below, a 3 / 9 split on the 12-column grid. The left column (columns 1 to 3, about 320px) holds one 320x300 photograph in the dealt corner, no frame, and one body-step sentence, and stays sticky while the right side scrolls. The right side (columns 4 to 12) holds three filled topic cards 12px apart, each about 200px tall, in the surface tone and the dealt corner, 28px padding: in its left half an h3 at the lead step and one body-step line; in its right half three link rows 40px tall at the body step with an arrow at the right end, plain text with no rules or bullets. Hover: the card follows the dealt card hover and the arrows move 4px. The cards arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: the photograph becomes a 16:9 picture under the title and the topic cards stack, link rows under the line.
phone: The left photograph becomes a 16:9 picture under the title, topic cards stack with the link rows under the line.
houseRuleCheck: Filled cards replace ruled rows; no counts, slash labels or numbering. The framed figure is a plain photograph. The left column is never empty. No button inside the cards: the link rows are the actions.

name: Perspective chapter picker
description: A full-height chooser laid over a rendered 3D scene or a looped render (never a photograph), whose lower band stays calm and dark under the buttons (no tint over the scene). A one-line h2 at the lead step, centred, about 11% from the top. At 16% above the bottom a row of five chapter buttons, each 310x72 and built on the dealt button (its corner, fill and label style): a title at the body step and the duration at the right end, with a plain arrow at the far end. The row sits in a 500px perspective box so the outer buttons turn about 18 degrees inward and scale to 0.85. Locked chapters show the word Locked in place of the arrow and take no hover; the hovered button scales 1.05 and lifts 6px. On selection the buttons scale to 0 in 300ms, 40ms apart, and the scene moves to that chapter. Phone: the buttons stack vertically at 56px, full width inside the margins, no perspective.
phone: Buttons stack vertically at 56px, full width inside the margins, no perspective, one tap picks a chapter.
houseRuleCheck: Controls only, built on the dealt button. They never sit on a photograph: the scene is a render or a model under a flat tint. No icons; a locked chapter is told by a word, not by fading.

name: Single link bar as the whole section
description: One filled bar is the whole section: the content width, 88px tall, in the surface tone and the dealt corner, on the dealt section padding. Inside, a verb phrase of two to five words in sentence case at the sub step, set as an h2, at the left and a plain arrow at the right. The whole bar is the one link. Hover: a flat ink wipe floods the bar from the left over 350ms, the text turns to the ground colour and the arrow turns 45 degrees. It is the quiet hand-off to the next page or the footer, with nothing else around it and no second button to the same place. Phone: bar 72px tall, text at the lead step.
phone: Bar 72px tall with the text at the lead step and the same hover wipe on tap.
houseRuleCheck: A full-width filled bar replaces the ruled row that sat in the right half only; sentence case at the sub step. The bar is a link in the card style, not a second button design.

name: Display word over rising picture cards
description: A pinned closing scene about 160vh long on the page ground. One display-step word or two-word phrase in ink, an invitation or a verb and never the brand name or an email, centred, rises 80px into place. Three picture cards 8px apart in the dealt corner rise from below the fold and settle beneath it without covering a letter: a 412x385 picture, a 183x360 portrait strip and a 330x155 close-up, each with a one-line caption at the small step under it. A two-line question at the lead step sits low left at the page margin. After the stage the page scrolls into the footer. Phone: the word at the head step over two lines, the cards as an overlapped two-up pair, the question below.
phone: Word at the head step over two lines, cards overlap as a two-up pair, question underneath.
houseRuleCheck: The cards never cover the word (no picture inside a headline). The word is an invitation or a verb, not the brand name or an email. Captions sit under the cards, not on the photographs. All edges are straight: no notches.

name: Index list over full-screen environment pictures
description: A CMS-fed index laid over a full-screen picture. A fixed one-screen stack of four to six wide environment pictures (art-directed or rendered) cross-fades to the matching one when a list row is hovered or reaches the middle of the viewport (700ms). Over it a left-aligned list of four to six rows at the sub step in medium weight, 24px apart, starting at the page margin, each with a one-line meta at the body step at the right end. The words sit on a calm part of each picture, in one light tone (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the list only): the active row in full light ink, the others in a muted light tone at full contrast. Each row opens its own detail page. The section is one screen tall and the pictures fill it. Phone: the same pictures cross-fade as rows pass the centre, rows at the lead step.
phone: Pictures cross-fade as rows pass the centre, rows at the lead step.
houseRuleCheck: List text only, no boxes on the picture. Pictures are art-directed or rendered, never documentary. Rows start at the left margin, so no row is empty on the left. No particle layer and no drawn weather.

name: Live calculator beside a result panel
description: A quote or planning tool as the page's working piece. Two halves of 630px with a 52px gap inside the content width, each as tall as its content (about 640px). Left half: an h2 at the head step, one body-step sentence and six inputs as filled bars (56px tall, surface tone, the dealt corner, a label above a value at the lead step inside each): two rows of two, then two full width; for a quantity use a stepper (minus, value, plus) in the dealt button's shape, never a slider. Right half: one flat ink panel as tall as the left half, in the dealt corner, holding the result as sentences, each with its figure set large inside the line (the main result at the display step, two secondary ones at the sub step), all counting to their new value over 400ms on every input change, and one body-step note. Real figures from a real formula. Phone: inputs in one column (two-up when short), the result panel directly under them.
phone: Inputs in one column (two-up when short), the result panel directly under them.
houseRuleCheck: Fields are filled bars on the plain ground (no box inside a box) and the result is one flat card; no line-style inputs, no slider, no drawn notch. Figures stand in the line that says what they count.

name: Logo grid flanked by cut-out figures
description: One section on the page ground. A centred h2 at the head step and a two-line lead-step blurb 640px wide. 48px below, a centred 3x2 grid of six logos in 195x131 cells at a 195px pitch (about 600px wide), each in one flat muted ink, no rules or boxes. To the left and right of the grid two seated cut-out figures, each about 280px tall, face inwards and point at the grid; they are rendered or studio-shot cut-outs on transparent backgrounds. The figures float 8px on a 5s sine; on hover a logo takes its real colour. The logos are real clients or partners the brief names, and they arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: heading, blurb, a 3x2 grid, and the two figures at 120px overlapping the top corners of the grid.
phone: 3x2 grid, figures shrink to 120px and sit on the grid's top corners.
houseRuleCheck: Six logos only (a wall of twelve reads as a credit wall). Logos are the real marks, never drawn. Figures are rendered or studio cut-outs, never a drawn illustration and never documentary photographs.

name: Logo grows into a media frame
description: A pinned intro-to-work transition (about 120vh of pin) on the ink field. At rest the brand mark (the supplied logo, about 120px tall) stands at the top left of this section inside the page margin, never in the navigation's place. On scroll it travels to the centre and grows into a 1203x485 landscape frame in the dealt corner filled with a picture (or footage, if the sheet deals it), the mark acting as the mask while it grows; the frame then drifts up 60px and scales from 1 to 1.2. Two chunks of a short title (about two words each, at the display step in ground-coloured letters) slide across the frame in opposite directions, roughly 200px each way, one over its top half and one over its bottom half. The mark is the brand's own, supplied. Phone: the frame is the width inside the margins at 4:5, the title chunks at the head step crossing 80px each way.
phone: Frame at the width inside the margins at 4:5, title chunks at the head step crossing 80px each way.
houseRuleCheck: The mark is the brand's own supplied logo, set inside this section (the navigation keeps its wordmark), never a picture in a headline; the title crosses the frame as plain text in one tone, on the calm part of the picture.

name: Character holding a content board
description: A flat stage on the page ground, as tall as the character (about 600px). A 3D or studio cut-out character about 500x600 stands centred with both hands holding an ink board 920x231 in the dealt corner in front of its body; the hands are a second cut-out layer drawn over the board's side edges so the board reads as held. On the board, in ground-coloured letters: one short title at the sub step and one body-step line, nothing else. Under the stage, the dealt button. On hover the board tilts 3 degrees. Phone: character 280x340, board the width inside the margins by 160px.
phone: Character 280x340, board full width inside the margins at 160px.
houseRuleCheck: The board carries one title and one line (no credit wall, no row of figures). The chip bar is dropped: one button design only. The character is a render or studio cut-out, never a drawn illustration.

name: Mask-opening video with column text
description: A pinned opening, about 220vh tall. The ground is the page ground at first. A picture (or footage when the sheet deals it) sits inside a mask in the dealt corner (560x315 at the start, centred) that grows with scroll to a full-bleed 100vw x 100vh with square corners. Over the opened picture, on a three-column grid (columns at the margin, 520 and 976px), two paragraphs at the lead step about 448px wide and about 20 words each, in one light tone: one in column one near the lower left and one in column three near the upper right, fading in at 70% and 85% of the pin. Words sit on the calm part, with a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only if contrast needs it. Phone: the mask grows to 100vw x 100svh and the two paragraphs show one after the other at the bottom at the body step.
phone: Mask grows to full screen, the paragraphs show one after the other at the bottom at the body step.
houseRuleCheck: Text sits straight on the picture with no box; paragraphs are held to about 20 words each. The pin is about 220vh with something new at every step.

name: Circular mask sweeps out to uncover a world
description: A click-started reveal into a large world. Start: a one-screen stage in the darkest tone of the palette with a small island (a lit model or picture about 320px wide) at the centre, held in a circular mask about 360px across (the mask edge is the picture's own crop, no ring) with the dealt button below it. On click the mask first pulls in 6% (300ms), then the circle widens past every screen edge in 2s with a back-in ease and uncovers the full world behind it (a wide art-directed picture, or the page's 3D scene if it has one); the button fades out and the picture pulls back 20%. After the reveal, three buttons in the dealt button's shape slide in from the right and settle 24px inside the page margin, each switching the view. Phone: the same sweep from a 200px mask, the three buttons slide up from the bottom and rest in a row 16px above it.
phone: 200px mask, the buttons rise from the bottom into a row 16px above it.
houseRuleCheck: No stroke ring and no halo: the mask edge is the picture's own crop. The buttons stop inside the page margin so nothing runs into one edge.

name: Media halves with a top caption strip
description: On the dealt ground. Two media halves inside the page margins with an 8px gap, each about 690px wide and 80svh tall with the dealt corner: a still photograph on the left and a muted looping video on the right. All text sits in a strip at the top inside the media, 48px down, on the media's calm part with no box, in one ink chosen for contrast: one headline line at the head step (the h2) at the left and the dealt second action (a label with an arrow) at the right. Scroll: both halves scale from 0.92 to 1 as they cross the screen (scrubbed, transform only). Hover: the video scales 1.03 inside its crop. Phone: two stacked halves 60svh each, the text on the top one.
phone: Two stacked halves 60svh each, the text on the top one.
houseRuleCheck: Edge touch stays out (the page margin all round); the darkening layer is dropped (choose media with a calm top); one headline line and one link only; the serif line is the dealt display face.

name: Media shrinks into a side panel
description: A pinned scene about 200vh long. A full-screen picture shrinks into a panel that settles at the right, about 414x721 at 1440, one page margin from the right edge and centred on the height, in the dealt corner. At the left a heading band: an h2 over two lines at the head step on one left edge, and two more pictures (240x320) drifting up 80px at different rates beside it. The ground flips from the ink field to the page ground during the shrink (a flat swap over 300ms) and the navigation ink flips with it. Phone: the panel settles at the width inside the margins by 420px under the heading, with one supporting picture.
phone: Panel settles at the width inside the margins by 420px under the heading, one supporting picture.
houseRuleCheck: No notches, frame lines or small index: the panel is a plain picture in the dealt corner. Heading lines share one left edge, in sentence case. The pin is about 200vh.

name: Model stop with solid panel
description: A pinned section of three stops, about 70vh of scroll each (under three screens in all), over a 3D model that fills the right 60% of the screen (a live canvas, or a set of rendered stills crossfaded). The camera glides to a different part of the model at each stop. At the left sits a filled card about 400px wide, in the surface tone with the dealt corner and padding, 40px from the left and the bottom: a two-word title in the sub step, one sentence of at most ten words in the body step, two fact rows (a lead word in weight 600 and one phrase of at most three words, 20px apart, no icons, no lines) and the dealt button at full card width. At each stop the key light of the model and the camera change and the text swaps with a 300ms crossfade; the card keeps its one fill. Ink on card, the accent on the button.
phone: Canvas on top at 60vh and pinned; the card under it at full width inside the page margins swaps per stop.
houseRuleCheck: The card is a solid fill beside the model on the ground, never over a photograph, with no blur and no outline; it does not retint, the model carries the colour. No divider lines, icons or small labels.

name: Name marquee rows under a picture grid
description: A section on one flat palette field colour (ink on it at 4.5:1 or better), as tall as its content. Top: a 64px title at the left margin (x 80); 96px below, a grid of six pictures in two rows of three, each 413 by 200 with the dealt corner, on 20px gaps. 120px below that, three full-width marquee rows 32px apart: names at the display step in heavy tight type (real client, artist or project names), separated by space only, never by pictures. Rows alternate direction, drift at different speeds and slow on hover. The rows run across the full width (both edges, so nothing touches one edge only); everything else keeps the page margins. Phone: names at the display step, two rows, pictures in a two-column grid.
phone: Names at the display step, two rows, pictures in a two-column grid.
houseRuleCheck: The marquee is full-bleed on both edges while the grid and title keep margins. The rule under the title is dropped; the round thumbnails between names are dropped (a picture inside a line is out); the 148px names are the display step (a giant name fails); the 60px entry slide is the dealt entrance.

name: Narrow column over a tile grid
description: One narrow column on the page ground, 480px wide, always centred. From the top: an h2 at the head step over two lines, one two-line body-step paragraph (20 words), 28px of space, then a 3x3 grid of nine 120px square tiles with 16px gaps (392px wide) in the surface tone and the dealt corner. Each tile holds a real partner logo or a crop of a photograph; no drawn icons, no letters. On hover a tile turns over (rotateY to 180 degrees) to show its name. The tiles arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: the column at the width inside the margins, the tiles at 92px.
phone: Column at the width inside the margins, nine tiles at 92px.
houseRuleCheck: One fill for every tile (the surface tone), never a wall of tiles in several fills. Tile contents are real logos or photograph crops, never drawn icons. The column is always centred, so the open space falls evenly on both sides.

name: Asymmetric photo columns with captions
description: An editorial photo section on the page ground. Inside the content width, two columns with a 20px gutter. Left: one tall 601x863 photograph in the dealt corner with a two-line caption at the lead step under it. Right: one 601x515 photograph with a caption at the lead step under it, then 20px lower two 291x249 photographs side by side 20px apart, each with a one-line caption at the small step. Captions sit in one plain line under their photograph, never on it. No boxes, no tiles: the photographs stand on the ground. Hover: the photograph zooms 1.04 inside its crop and the caption's ink goes to the accent. The photographs arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: a single column, the tall photograph at 4:5, the two small ones side by side at 4:3.
phone: Single column, tall photograph at 4:5, the two small photographs side by side at 4:3.
houseRuleCheck: No tags and no boxes on the photographs: each has one caption under it. Pictures are art-directed, never documentary.

name: One-word title, filter buttons and a filtered list
description: A filterable archive. A one-word h2 at the display step at the page margin, no count. Below it a 3 / 9 split. Left column (about 320px): a group of five filter buttons in the dealt button's shape, 40px tall (the active one filled ink), that filter the list at once, and under them one 320x300 picture in the dealt corner. Right side: a list of six filled rows, 64px tall, 8px apart, in the surface tone and the dealt corner, each with a date at the body step at the left, a name at the lead step with an ellipsis, a plain type tag at the body step near the right and a plain arrow at the right end that opens the entry. Filtering fades rows out over 200ms and shifts the layout over 250ms. The real list, with real dates and names. Phone: the filter buttons wrap on one row above the list, rows 56px, the picture dropped.
phone: Filter buttons wrap on one row above the list, rows 56px, picture dropped.
houseRuleCheck: Filled rows, never ruled rows; no numbering or counts. Filters are buttons in the dealt shape. The left column holds a picture, so the left is never empty.

name: One-word title over a card pair
description: A feature pair under a one-word title on the page ground. An h2 of one word at the display step at the page margin; 72px below its baseline one text link with an arrow aligned to the right margin. Then two cards of 650x440 inside the content width, 12px apart, in the dealt corner: one a photograph, one a surface-tone card carrying one short line at the sub step; under each card, 16px down, a caption at the lead step in sentence case. Static, no carousel. Hover: the caption moves 6px and the photograph zooms 1.04. The cards arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: the title at the head step, cards stacked at 4:3, captions at the body step.
phone: Title at the head step, cards stacked at 4:3, captions at the body step.
houseRuleCheck: The cards sit inside the margins, never edge to edge. No label or count on the link. The text card carries one line, not a heading.

name: Overlapping mixed-media pinboard
description: About two screens tall on the page ground. Upper cluster on three 379px columns with 106px gutters: a tall 374x639 photograph in the middle column; a 380x213 muted looping video overlapping its left edge by 78px, 120px below its top; a 174x247 photograph overlapping its right edge by 78px, 60px below its top. They move at different rates (photograph 1.0, video 1.15, small photograph 0.85) so they slide over one another. 120px lower a second pair with aligned tops: a 379x254 photograph at the left and a 379x379 video at the right, the pair centred as a group; 60px under them a centred lead-step paragraph (22 words at most) and one text link with an arrow. Overlaps are plain stacking, with no boxes or labels on the media. Phone: one column of media with 24px overlaps and alternating left-right offsets, videos as stills if autoplay is blocked.
phone: One column of media with 24px overlaps and alternating offsets; stills where autoplay is blocked.
houseRuleCheck: Media only, no boxes on the pictures; pictures are art-directed, never documentary. No label between the lower pair.

name: Three article cards with a centred link
description: Three filled cards across the content width, 24px apart, each about 389px wide and 520px tall, in the surface tone and the dealt corner, in the dealt card style. Each holds a 16:9 picture (389x219) running to the card's top edges, 24px padding, a title at the lead step over two lines, a body-step paragraph of 10 words at most in muted ink and one text link with an arrow pinned to the bottom (margin-top auto) so the three links share a baseline. About 100px below, one centred text link to see all. Hover: the picture zooms 1.04 and the card lifts 6px. The cards arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: the cards stack with 16:10 pictures and the centred link stays last.
phone: Cards stack with 16:10 pictures; the centred link follows.
houseRuleCheck: Filled cards with no outline; no tag above the title. The picture runs to the card's edges, with no frame inside the card.

name: Three story columns with dated lists
description: A news section on the ink field. Three equal columns across the content width, 24px apart (about 421px each), each a filled panel in the surface tone and the dealt corner with 24px padding, so every story reads as a group: a 421x260 lead photograph running to the panel's top edges, a title at the sub step in the display face over two lines, a list of two dated posts (the date at the small step above a title of five words at most at the body step, 16px between items) and one text link with an arrow. Hover: the title goes to the accent and the photograph zooms 1.04. The panels arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: the columns stack and each list keeps its two items.
phone: Columns stack, each list keeps two items.
houseRuleCheck: Each column is a filled panel (no outline) holding photograph, title and list together; nothing sits on the photograph. Dates are the only small text.

name: Scene object floods into new ground
description: Pinned for 1.5 screens. A rendered scene or photograph fills the screen with one small, clear object near the centre (a lamp, a lens, a sun-like disc, a dial; a real object in the picture, never a drawn shape) taking about 6% of the width. Scroll scales the picture around that object's centre (transform-origin set on it, up to 3x from a picture at least 3000px wide) while a flat circle clip-path in a palette field colour grows from the object's centre until it fills every edge and becomes the next ground. On that ground a 56px two-line title and a one-line 18px sentence stand in the ink for it, there from the moment the ground fills the screen (no fade or blur), then the pin releases into the next section. Phone: same path over 1.2 screens, title 36px.
phone: Same path over 1.2 screens, title 36px.
houseRuleCheck: An 18x zoom of a photograph cannot stay sharp, so the picture scales to 3x at most and a flat circle wipe in a palette colour finishes the flood. The fade-and-blur of the title is dropped (dealt entrance). The object must be a real thing in the picture, never a drawn SVG.

name: Object panel left, detail rows right
description: A product detail row, one screen tall minus 190px at 1440 (about 710px), on the section's ground. Left: a 462px-wide full-height panel in the surface tone and the dealt corner holding a centred square sleeve or pack shot about 320px wide, with a disc or second part behind it that turns (rotateY on an 8s loop, slowing on hover). Right, from x 622 and 560px wide: four detail rows, each a filled bar in the surface tone and the dealt corner, 8px apart, all open: a title at the lead step and one line of body-step text under it. Real product facts, not filler. Phone: the panel on top at the width inside the margins by 360px, the rows below at full width.
phone: Panel on top at the width inside the margins by 360px, detail rows full width below.
houseRuleCheck: Panel and rows are filled surfaces, with no border and no ruled rows. The rows stand open, so every fact is readable without a click.

name: Collage object zooms to full bleed, then a text beat
description: Pinned for about 160vh. A floating collage of five or six art-directed pictures (200 to 380px; each drifts 12px up and down) sits on the page ground; one featured picture (about 380x450, near the centre) grows with scroll into a cover picture larger than the screen, scaling from 1 to about 4.5 until it covers the others, while the ground flips to the ink field (a flat swap) and the picture settles from 1.2 to 1. Then a statement of 12 to 18 words at the sub step over three lines at most, about 560px wide, rises into place at the left and holds. The featured picture is a very large file (2600px or more) so the zoom stays sharp. Phone: four collage pictures, the featured one grows to 100vw x 100svh, the statement at the lead step at the bottom left.
phone: Four collage pictures, the featured one grows to 100vw x 100svh, the statement at the lead step at the bottom left.
houseRuleCheck: Pictures are art-directed, never documentary. The statement is held to 12 to 18 words at the sub step over three lines, not a long paragraph. The pin is about 160vh.

name: Logo cells with the heading in the left third
description: A partner or customer section with the grid in the right eight columns. Left, columns 1 to 4 (about 420px): an h2 at the head step over two lines and one body-step sentence, top aligned. Right, columns 5 to 12 (about 860px): two rows of three logo cells, each 270x200 in the surface tone and the dealt corner, 12px gaps, the logo centred in one flat muted ink up to 120px wide and a caption at the small step (the customer's use or place) at the bottom of the cell. Six logos at most. Hover: the logo takes its real colour and the cell follows the dealt card hover. The cells arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: the heading on top, the cells in a two by three grid of 160x120, captions hidden.
phone: Heading on top, cells in a two by three grid of 160x120, captions hidden.
houseRuleCheck: Dotted rules become filled cells; captions stay at the small step in sentence case. The heading fills the left third so no column is empty. Six cells, not eight, keep it a logo set, not a credit wall.

name: Frame rising past offset caption
description: Three blocks, one per project or story, on the ground in ink; the accent only on one text link. In each block a 16:9 picture frame, about 696x392 at 1440, in the dealt corner, sits on a 12-column grid at a different x each time (left in one, centred in the next, right in a third) and always inside the page margins. A caption of at most eight words in the sub step, three lines at most and 340px wide, sits beside the frame or 120-150px under it at a different x, so the pair never lines up twice; it is the block's heading (h3). Scroll: the frame travels faster than the caption and the ground (about 1.25x, translate only), passes the caption and leaves through the top, so the two cross. The dealt section gap lies between blocks. The captions arrive with the dealt entrance.
phone: Frame at full width inside the page margins, caption under it in the sub step; the speed difference shrinks to 1.1x or none; one block per screen.
houseRuleCheck: The frame stays inside the page margins (no edge touch). Pictures are designed or generated, never archive photographs. No wordless interlude: every block carries its caption.

name: Offset statement and paragraph over a sky
description: One still photograph of a sky (clouds, or a calm atmospheric surface such as water, smoke or dust) fills about 85svh and drifts 6% against the scroll; no gradient and no tint over it. A two-line headline at the head step (8 to 10 words, sentence case), 740 wide, sits offset to one side (x 80, y 200); a 17px three-line paragraph, 400 wide, with the dealt button under it, sits on the opposite side and lower (x 880, y 560). Both stand on the picture's calm part, in the light or the dark ink of the palette at 4.5:1 or better. The lines are simply there (the dealt entrance decides arrival). Used once, not mirrored. Phone: headline 30px over the paragraph, both at 24px margins, the offset kept as a 24px indent.
phone: Headline 30px over the paragraph at 24px margins, 24px indent.
houseRuleCheck: The live sky (a clip or shader) became a still photograph so no video asset is needed. The four-or-five-line 50px capitals statement is a two-line sentence-case headline; the round-to-pill button is the dealt button; the stagger rise is the dealt entrance; the mirrored repeat is dropped.

name: Orbit camera around a character
description: A pinned scene about 160vh long. A rendered 3D character (a model in three.js, or a pre-rendered turntable of about 90 frames scrubbed by scroll) starts as a face close-up while the camera orbits around the head to the character's back; the character fills the lower 60% of the frame while the ground darkens from a mid tone to the darkest tone of the palette in flat steps. One h2 at the head step over two lines sits at the lower left at the page margin, in one light tone. There is no HUD and no second menu: the dealt navigation is the only chrome. Phone: the orbit covers 70% of the range, the h2 at the lead step.
phone: Orbit covers 70% of the range, the h2 at the lead step.
houseRuleCheck: The HUD, the menu control and the dust motes are dropped: one navigation only and no particle layer. The character is rendered, never a drawn illustration. The pin is about 160vh with something new at every step.

name: Oversized photo scales over the previous scene
description: A handover between two scenes. An art-directed photograph larger than the viewport (about 1480x1110 at 1440x900, bleeding off both sides equally) scrolls up over the previous scene for about 720px of scroll while scaling from 1 to 1.1; the previous scene stays pinned behind it and dims to 70% under a flat black veil. At the end of the pass the next section's h2 at the display step lands directly under the photograph's bottom edge with 96px of space. Phone: the photograph 100vw x 70svh, scale 1 to 1.06, the h2 at the head step.
phone: Photograph 100vw x 70svh, scale 1 to 1.06, the h2 at the head step.
houseRuleCheck: The photograph bleeds off both sides equally and is art-directed, never documentary. The veil is flat, only dims the previous scene and carries no words.

name: Pack shot left, buy box right
description: A purchase block on the page ground. Left (columns 1 to 6): a 468x396 cut-out pack shot centred on a flat surface-tone panel 620x600 in the dealt corner. Right (columns 7 to 12): a rating line in text (a score and review count) only if the client gives real ones; a title at the sub step; two lines of body-step text; a quantity stepper (minus, 1, plus) in the dealt button's shape; two option rows, full width, 64px tall, in the dealt corner, 8px apart (the chosen one filled ink with ground-coloured letters, the other on the surface tone); and the dealt button full width as the checkout, its label at the left and the price at its right end. Hover: option rows lighten and the checkout arrow moves 6px. Phone: the pack panel on top at the width inside the margins by 320px, then the buy box in one column.
phone: Pack panel on top at the width inside the margins by 320px, buy box in one column below.
houseRuleCheck: Selection is shown by fill (ink against surface), never by an outline. The pack stands flat on its panel with no floor effect; ratings are text, not emoji or stars, and only if real.

name: Page shreds under a sweeping bar
description: A pinned scene about 200vh long on the ink field. A full-width 3D metal bar (a rendered bar 120px tall, 100vw wide) sweeps down the screen over about 60vh of scroll; as it passes, the previous section (captured as a texture or as a stack of slices of its own image) falls apart below it into 24 to 32 twisted vertical strips in the page's own ground and ink tones that tumble and drift down 80 to 200px with 20 to 60 degree rotations, then clear. The screen then holds a centred two-line h2 at the display step in plain ink and one lead-step line. Phone: 16 strips, bar 80px, the h2 at the head step.
phone: 16 strips, bar 80px, the h2 at the head step.
houseRuleCheck: The headline is plain two-line ink with no effect on the letters. Every frame stays a finished composition: the strips clear before the headline lands. The pin is about 200vh.

name: Photo with copy, handing over to a panel
description: A two-part scene. Part one: a wide art-directed sky or landscape photograph (100vw x 100vh) slides in from the right (translateX 100% to 0 over 80vh of scroll) with an h2 at the head step over two lines centred at the top and one lead-step line of 12 words at most in a 395px column at the lower left, in one tone on the photograph's calm part. Part two: it hands over to a surface-tone panel: a 640x650 photograph in the dealt corner at the right, one page margin from the edge, and at the left from the page margin, centred on the photograph, an h2 at the head step over two lines above three short items (a title at the lead step over one body-step line each). Phone: the photograph 100svh with its headline and line, the panel photograph the width inside the margins by 360px, columns stacked.
phone: Photograph 100svh with headline and line, panel photograph the width inside the margins by 360px, columns stacked.
houseRuleCheck: The headline is plain throughout, no styled word. No icons. The text sits at the left of the panel photograph so the panel's left half is never empty. Words on the first photograph sit on its calm part in one tone.

name: Photo pair with split captions below
description: Two near-square photographs in columns 1 to 6 and 7 to 12 of the content width, a 24px gutter, each about 644x640 in the dealt corner with a 6% inner parallax. Under each photograph, 16px down, a two-column caption: a title at the lead step over two lines starting at the photograph's left edge and a body-step line or two starting at its midline. The photographs arrive with the dealt entrance. Hover: the photograph zooms 1.03 inside its crop. Phone: the photographs stack at 4:5 and each caption becomes a title over its paragraph.
phone: Photographs stack at 4:5, each caption becomes a title over its paragraph.
houseRuleCheck: Captions sit under the photographs, never on them. Photographs are art-directed, never documentary.

name: Photo stepping over a text panel's edge
description: A text panel with a photograph that steps out over its edge. A surface-tone panel starting at the page margin, 656 wide and about 640 tall, in the dealt corner, with 120px padding on the left and 180px on the right so the text stays clear of the photograph: an h2 at the head step, a three-line body-step paragraph and the dealt button. A 762x600 photograph in the dealt corner stands over the panel's right edge, overlapping it by 140px, and drifts at 0.9x scroll so it slides slowly against the panel. Phone: the panel at full width inside the margins, the photograph overlapping its bottom by 40px.
phone: Panel at full width inside the margins, photograph overlapping its bottom by 40px.
houseRuleCheck: No heading underbar and no label. No offset colour block behind the photograph (it reads as a hard drop). The panel starts on the page margin and no text sits under the photograph.

name: Photo-text-photo triptych
description: Three equal tiles in one row at 1440, about 400x600 each with 24px gaps, inside the page margins, with the dealt section gap above and below. The left and right tiles are full-bleed pictures (product, lifestyle or rendered, studio-lit, never archive-style) in the dealt corner and the page's one grade. The centre tile is a card on the surface tone in the dealt corner with 40px padding: a two-line title at the sub step at its top-left and, low at the bottom, a two-line paragraph at the body step and one dealt button, so the empty middle carries the weight. Nothing sits on the photographs. It has no entrance of its own: it arrives with the dealt entrance. On hover a photo eases to scale 1.04 over 500ms. Phone: the tiles stack inside the margins in the order photo, text, photo, each 4:5, 16px apart.
phone: Stack the three tiles inside the page margins in the order photo, text, photo; 4:5 each, 16px gaps; the dealt button keeps its dealt height.
houseRuleCheck: No tag pill or eyebrow: the text tile opens with its title. Nothing is laid on the photographs. One surface fill, the dealt corner and the dealt button, no outline, no shadow, no entrance of its own.

name: Photo trio, split captions under
description: Three cards in a row on a 12-column grid, four columns each (about 416 wide at 1440) with 24px gutters inside the page margins. Each card is one fill (the surface tone, the dealt corner): a 416x252 landscape picture flush at the top, then a caption plate with 20px padding that holds a title at the lead step in a left column (about 140px wide) and a paragraph of one to three lines at the body step in muted ink in a right column (about 220px wide). The caption sits inside the card fill, never floating loose. It has no entrance of its own: it arrives with the dealt entrance. On hover the picture scales to 1.03 and the title column shifts 4px. Phone: one column of cards 16px apart, the caption plate stacks the title above the text, picture 16:10.
phone: One column of cards, 16px apart; the title stacks above the paragraph inside the plate.
houseRuleCheck: Captions live in the filled plate, so the card carries the hierarchy. The colour-block wipe is dropped (accent spread over three pictures, and its own entrance); the 15px paragraph is at the body step. No outline, no shadow.

name: Mini-game picks next content
description: A section as tall as its content on the page ground. A two-line lead line at the sub step sits top-left over a headline of one or two words at the display step. Below, a flat floor holds a small physics sandbox made of real HTML elements moved by a 2D physics engine: one ball (a solid circle in the accent, 56px) and four open bins, each a card on the surface tone in the dealt corner (about 260x150) carrying a topic word at the lead step. Press and hold anywhere on the stage to charge the throw (the ball swells slightly while held, no meter), release to throw; the bin the ball settles in lifts 12px and its topic opens as two or three cards below it. A one-line hint at the body step in sentence case and the dealt second-action link "Skip" sit under the floor. Keyboard route: arrow keys pick a bin, Enter drops the ball. The engine pauses when the section is off screen. Phone: bins in a 2x2 at about 150x100, press-and-hold works anywhere on the stage, Skip stays 44px tall.
phone: Bins in a 2x2 at about 150x100 under the headline; press-and-hold anywhere throws; the Skip link stays 44px tall.
houseRuleCheck: The hint is a sentence-case line, never a tiny label. Game objects are plain filled cards on one surface tone and one ball, nothing drawn as decoration; no canvas drawing, no gradient. Always give a skip and a keyboard route. The opened topic cards sit below the bin, not inside it.

name: Physics stat heap
description: A panel on the page ground, pinned for about 1.5 screens. A headline at the display step on two lines top-left, a two-line paragraph at the lead step and a plain dealt text link under it. From mid-height down, a heap of 8 to 10 stat chips falls and piles up across the centre and right: pills, rounded squares and circles, 120 to 220px, each real HTML moved by a 2D physics engine and holding one line that says a figure and what it counts (a number at the sub step and its noun at the body step). Chips are on the surface tone; the one decisive figure takes the accent. They spawn above the panel with a 60ms stagger when the panel pins, settle in about 2.5 seconds, and the pointer acts as a soft pusher. Reduced motion: the heap is already settled. Phone: headline at the head step, a one-line paragraph, then 6 to 8 smaller chips filling the lower 55% of the screen.
phone: Headline at the head step, one-line paragraph, then 6 to 8 smaller chips fall into the lower 55%; no device tilt.
houseRuleCheck: No mono label, no eyebrow. Chips are filled and each carries a real figure with its noun in one line (never a stats band of one-word labels); one surface fill plus one accent chip, no colour sprawl, no hexagons or decorative shapes; chips are HTML moved by an engine, not a canvas drawing.

name: 3D act with narrated slides
description: A pinned act of about 2.5 screens in all. First a full-screen 3D scene: a lit 3D object at the centre and a two-line act title in the head step at the upper left, inside the page margins. Then a slide layer plays four pictures (portrait, 4:3 and 16:9 mixed) in turn, each with one subtitle line of eight words at most in the lead step, in the palette's light tone on a calm part of the picture (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), and ends on an end card: a headline in the head step and one dealt button that returns to the start. No voice track.
phone: The object static and cropped on top at 40vh; slides at full width; subtitle at the bottom inside the page margins.
houseRuleCheck: No chapter numerals and no hairlines round the object. Pictures are designed or generated, never documentary.

name: Walking figure, side caption
description: A pinned canvas of two screens on one flat palette colour. One 3D model of a figure, 520 tall, walks in place left of centre in the accent colour, never a drawn or cartoon illustration. In the right third (x 960 to 1340) a caption: a 40px two-line headline and a three-line 18px paragraph, 320 wide. Halfway through the pin the caption swaps for a second one, the figure crosses to the right of centre and the caption moves to the left third; the figure keeps its one colour. No numeral and no label. Phone: figure 260 tall at the top, the two captions below one after another, no mirroring.
phone: Figure 260 tall at the top, captions below one after another, no mirroring.
houseRuleCheck: The numeral and label are dropped. The figure is a 3D model, never a drawn SVG; the colour swap between scenes is dropped (one accent hue); the tilted, blurred line entrance is the dealt entrance; the pin is cut from three screens to two.

name: Card deck flying off
description: A pinned stage on the ground of three scenes, about 60vh of scroll each (under three screens in all), with the section heading in the sub step fixed at top centre. One large card, about 785x432, on the surface tone with the dealt corner and padding, sits at the centre: a title in the sub step (two lines at most), a one-line paragraph in the body step, one text link, and at its right a 220x330 portrait picture. On scroll each card scales to 1.15, tilts 8 degrees and flies off the top while the next rises into the same slot from below (700ms ease in-out). All three cards take the same fill, so only their content differs. No drifting icons, no index.
phone: Card at 88vw by 70svh, the picture on top at 16:9, the text below; the fly-off stays.
houseRuleCheck: No drifting icons and no card index; one card fill, so no colour sprawl. Pictures are designed or generated.

name: Pinned centred statement, character reveal
description: A pinned stage of about 1.5 screens of scroll: a statement of 12 to 20 words in the sub step (36px at most), three lines at most, centred and 640-760px wide, in ink on the ground. Its characters climb from the muted tone to ink in order as you scroll. No label above. Reduced motion shows the full text at once.
phone: Statement in the lead step inside the page margins; the reveal goes word by word; pinned for about one screen.
houseRuleCheck: A statement is a paragraph: 36px or less on three lines (a longer sentence at display size would be a long headline). The optional small grey label is dropped.

name: Colour panels wiping in sideways
description: Pinned for about 2 screens of scroll. Three full-viewport panels wipe in from the right one after another (about 600px of scroll each). A constant one-word title at the display step stays at the left (its ink flips with each panel as the panel fill changes), and a row of the three panel names at the lead step sits at the bottom, the active one in full ink and the others in the muted tone. The panels use the page ground, the surface tone and the field tone in turn, never a new hue per panel. Each panel carries a subtitle at the sub step, three short lines of body text (plain lines, no drawn bullets), one dealt button and, at the right, one picture of about 420px that scales from 0.9 to 1 as the panel lands. Phone: no pin; the three panels become full-height sheets stacked sticky over each other, title at the head step at the top, the picture at 70% width.
phone: Drop the pin; three sticky sheets slide over each other at 100svh, title at the head step, one picture at 70% width.
houseRuleCheck: The numbered index is a row of names; no tiny caps label; the outlined pill is the dealt button; five rainbow panels are three panels in the ground, surface and field tones; the trio of overlapping pictures is one picture so the picture budget holds. Pin cut from four screens to two.

name: Pinned depth arc of portrait cards
description: Pinned for about 2 screens on the surface tone. A header band uses space only: a two-line heading at the head step on the left and a two-line paragraph at the body step at the right, inside the page margins, no rules, no index. Below it, 5 portrait picture cards (4:5, the dealt corner) sit on a 3D arc under a CSS perspective of about 1400px: the centre card (about 280x350) faces front and each neighbour steps back 140px in depth, shrinks to 0.85 and turns 35 degrees. Scroll slides the outer cards out in depth and the whole arc turns edge-on into the next scene; the centre card's title appears under it at the lead step, straight at rest. Phone: still pinned, three cards only inside the margins (centre 55vw wide, the neighbours turned behind it), scroll slides the arc sideways.
phone: Still pinned: three cards inside the margins (centre 55vw wide, neighbours turned behind it), scroll drives the arc sideways.
houseRuleCheck: The ruled header band, index number, caps label and triangle markers are gone; the band is two text blocks on open space. Cards are plain pictures with nothing laid on them, in the dealt corner (cut corners dropped), with no peeking at the screen edge. Eleven cards are five so the picture budget holds.

name: Pinned display word sequence
description: A pinned stage of three words, about 60vh of scroll each (under three screens in all). One word in the display step in the dealt display face, ink, sits centred with a one-line sentence-case line in the lead step 40px under it saying what the word means for this client; the next word replaces it as the scroll advances, the whole word rolling on a 3D drum (rotateX), 500ms in and 400ms out. Behind it a full-screen field that steps between the ground, the surface tone and the ink as the words change (a flat colour change, never noise or a gradient). No monogram, no icons.
phone: The word fits the width (two lines at most), the field and drum stay.
houseRuleCheck: The word stays at the dealt display size; the field uses the palette's flat tones, never colours of its own. Every word carries its line, so no screen holds a heading alone.

name: Full-bleed photos wiping up
description: A pinned stage of three scenes, about 80vh of scroll each (under three screens in all). Every scene is a full-bleed photograph with its words on the picture's calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only): a text block starting about a quarter of the way across and inside the page margins, with a headline of two lines at most in the head step in the palette's light tone and, on the last scene only, the dealt button. The next photograph wipes up from the bottom over the last (clip-path inset from 100% to 0 over about 700ms, ease in-out) and its headline replaces the old one in the same move. No tag pills, rules, index or small card on the photographs.
phone: Text block pinned at the bottom inside the page margins, headline in the head step, the button at full width on the last scene; the wipe stays.
houseRuleCheck: One headline per scene and one button in all; no tag pill, hairline, index or small card on the photographs (no boxes on photographs). Photographs are designed or generated, never documentary.

name: Pinned growing window over alternating grounds
description: Two pinned scenes, about 1.2 screens of scroll each (about 2.5 in all), one per project, on a flat ground that alternates between the ground and the surface tone. A picture window (a looping clip only when the page has footage) starts small, about 520x300, near the bottom, rises and widens to about 1270px inside the page margins in the dealt corner, then grows to full-bleed as a closing state while the next ground rises from below. A title of one to three words in the display step, two lines at most, is centred over the middle of the window in the palette's light tone on the picture's calm part, with a caption in the body step under it. The title arrives with the dealt entrance. The window keeps the page margin until the final growth.
phone: Window at 90vw rising, title inside the page margins; same alternating grounds.
houseRuleCheck: No index numbering. The picture or footage is designed or generated, never documentary. One growing window on the page: if the sheet deals the rounded-tile move, build this as that move.

name: Pinned headline beside a swapping product
description: Pinned for about 200svh on the palette ground. Left (columns 1-6): a two-line headline at the display step in ink, centred vertically in its column; it stays put. Right (columns 7-12): a product cut-out about 465x372 standing straight on the ground with no frame, and under it the product name at the sub step in the display face and its price at the lead step, centred. Scroll steps through three or four products (scroll-linked): the cut-out slides 40px and fades while the next rises in, name and price swap through a 240ms mask. No buy controls, no tag, no pill, no colour change on the swap; the accent is not used. Phone: the same pin, the headline on top at the head step, the product at 80% of the width below with its name and price.
phone: Same pin: headline on top, product at 80% width below with name and price.
houseRuleCheck: No outlined or drawn shape round the cut-out and no tag or pill: the name and price are plain type; no buy controls; the accent is not used.

name: Pinned horizontal collage track
description: A pinned stage over about 1800px of scroll, framed by 24px of ground on every side and keeping the page margins. Inside it a window in the dealt corner with clipped overflow holds a track about 3200px wide that moves about 1800px to the left. On it 6 pictures of mixed sizes (240x240 to 560x500) sit at staggered heights, each drifting 20 to 40px faster than the track; three carry a one-line caption at the body step set under the picture. Two short text blocks at the lead step sit between pictures, one of them the section's heading. The collage is clipped by the window, so nothing runs into the screen edge. Phone: no pin; a two-column offset collage with a light vertical parallax, three captions, 20px gutters.
phone: Drop the pin; a two-column staggered collage with a slight vertical parallax, 3 captions, 20px gutters.
houseRuleCheck: The track bled off both screen edges; it now moves inside a clipped, inset window. Captions are sentence case at the body step. Pin cut from four screens to two; thirteen pictures are six. Imagery must be made, rendered or product imagery, never archive photographs.

name: Pinned landing card pile
description: A stage about one screen tall pinned for about 1.5 screens of scroll on the page ground. Four cards of about 460x494 on two fills in turn (the surface tone and the field tone), in the dealt corner, no outlines, no icons, fly in one by one alternately from the left and the right, rotated about 6 degrees, and land level at the centre 80px lower than the one before, so the older cards show only their top strip with its title at the lead step (the strip is the card's own top edge, not a separate box). The last card shows a centred two-line statement at the sub step, which is the section's heading. Two or three cut-out product objects (transparent photographs of real items) drift upward around the pile at 1.4x scroll speed. Phone: cards 80vw by 320 tall with a 56px step, two cut-outs, same fly-in order.
phone: Cards 80vw by 320 tall, stacked 56px apart and level at rest, two cut-outs only; same fly-in order.
houseRuleCheck: Outlined cards and line icons are gone; cards are solid fills in two tones and the tab is the card's visible top strip, so no boxes in boxes. Cards land level so no text is tilted at rest (they fly in rotated). Cut-outs must be transparent photographs, not drawn.

name: Pinned name stack with small image swap
description: A stage on the page ground pinned for about 1.5 screens of scroll. A stack of five names at the display step on the left, starting a third of the way down the stage: the active name in full ink, the others in the muted tone. Right of centre, a 216x216 square picture of the active item (the dealt corner) crossfades in 300ms. Every 270px of scroll moves the list up one line and swaps the picture. No labels; at most one body-size sentence-case line may sit by the picture. Hover on the active name nudges it 8px right. On a fine pointer, hover can drive the list instead of scroll: the pointed name takes full ink, the others the muted tone, and a 218x273 picture window glides vertically to the hovered line (950ms ease-out). Phone: names at the head step; the picture is 40% of the width and sits under the active line; the list moves one line per 90px of scroll.
phone: Names at the head step, left aligned; a picture at 40% of the width sits under the active line; the list moves one line per 90px of scroll.
houseRuleCheck: No labels. The list is left aligned from the page margin, so no row is empty on the left. Idle names use the muted tone (not 18% ink) to hold contrast; five names so the picture budget holds.

name: Pinned offset card strip with heading below
description: Pinned for about one screen on the page ground. A row of cards sits near the top, starting at the left page margin: each card about 420 wide on the surface tone in the dealt corner, a 420x236 picture flush at the top and a caption plate under it holding a title at the lead step and two lines of body text in muted ink. Three cards sit fully inside the page margins at rest; scroll moves the row sideways about 600px inside a clipped window so the first card leaves and a fourth arrives, the text travelling with its card. Below the row, a two-line heading at the head step sits at the left and a title at the lead step with two lines of text at the far right. Phone: no pin; the heading comes first and the cards stack in one column, 16px apart.
phone: No pin or sideways row: heading first, then the cards in one column with a 16px gap.
houseRuleCheck: The third card is no longer cut by the screen edge: the row lives in a clipped window inside the page margins and shows whole cards at rest. Phone uses stacking, not a drag rail. The grey 15px text is at the body step. No outline, no shadow.

name: Pinned centre stage recoloured per feature
description: A pinned section of three features, each owning about 70vh of scroll (under three screens in all). One stage, 640-700px wide at 1440, in the dealt corner, stays fixed at one side: a crop of the product's interface that runs to the stage's edges (no window frame, no title bar) and changes state per feature with a 400ms crossfade. The page ground steps between the ground and the surface tone as the feature changes (a flat colour change, never a new hue). On the other side a filled card in whichever of the two tones the ground is not (about 420px wide, the dealt padding and corner) scrolls past with a card title in the sub step, a blurb of at most ten words in the body step and one text link, so the words read as one group. Ink on card, the accent only on the link. Everything stays inside the page margins.
phone: The stage at full width inside the page margins, pinned in the upper half; the card under it at full width swaps per feature. If the pin is unreliable, stack stage and card per feature.
houseRuleCheck: No progress ring, no tick marks, no thin rules, no meta lines or small labels: the stage is a plain crop of the interface, not a framed window, so do not deal it on a page that has the product replay. The idea (one stage reused per feature) stays.

name: Pinned pan of colour panels
description: A pinned stage with 24px of ground on every side, inside the page margins, pans a strip of three full-height panels to the left (about 1900px over 1800px of scroll). Each panel is a card about 880 wide in the dealt corner, filled in turn with the surface tone and the field tone. Inside: a 16:9 picture flush at the top that scales from 0.4 to 1 as the panel lands, a plain-text detail row at the body step (client and year), a centred one-word name at the display step that arrives with its panel, and the dealt button at the bottom right. No next panel peeks at the edge. Phone: no pin; three sticky full-height cards stack over each other, picture 4:3, name at the head step.
phone: No pin; three sticky cards at 88svh slide over each other, picture 4:3, name at the head step, the dealt button.
houseRuleCheck: Edge-to-edge panels sit inside a stage margin with no peek of the next one; tiny caps details are a body-size sentence-case row; five pastels are two tones; the letter stagger is dropped (no flying letters); the pin is under two screens.

name: Pan to headline and still mosaic
description: A two-panel pinned track that pans left by one viewport (scrubbed, ease-in-out) over about 1 screen of scroll. Panel 1 is a full-bleed picture or product scene with one short line at the lead step. Panel 2 has a headline at the display step on two lines at the left (plain type, no pictures inside it), a two-line paragraph at the lead step and one dealt button under it, all in a 560px column from the left page margin. At the right, inside the page margins, a 2 by 2 mosaic of four pictures (about 280px square, 12px gaps, the dealt corner), each picture used once. Phone: no pan; panel 1 then panel 2, headline at the head step, the four pictures in 2 columns by 2 rows with 8px gaps.
phone: No pan: panel 1 then panel 2 stacked; headline at the head step, the four pictures in 2 columns by 2 rows with 8px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: The inline image tiles in the headline are dropped (no picture inside a headline); the mosaic keeps the page margins; eyebrow and caps labels are removed; sixteen stills cropped from eight pictures are four pictures used once, and they do not pop in (the dealt entrance decides).

name: Pinned photo with blend-mode display word
description: A pinned full-bleed picture taller than the viewport (1440x1080) that drifts up about 200px while pinned, for about 1.5 screens of scroll. A two-line statement at the sub step sits at the half-width line near the top and a two-word headline at the display step sits at the bottom left, 84px above the screen edge and on the left page margin. Both are set in near-white with a difference blend, so their colour shifts as they cross light and dark parts of the picture. The next scene then slides over the pinned picture. Pick a picture with strong light and dark zones and a calm dark lower area (studio or rendered, never an archive photograph), and keep the type legible at 3:1 at 1440, 768 and 390. Phone: statement at the lead step at the top, headline at the display step in two lines at the bottom, picture at 100svh.
phone: Statement at the lead step at the top, headline at the display step on two lines bottom-left, picture 100svh, same drift at half amount.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: no box on the picture, no gradient (the difference blend is a blend mode on type, not a fill). The headline sits on the picture's calm lower zone so it passes the text-on-photo check; the size is capped at the display step and the word is never the page name.

name: Pinned picture pairs with names
description: Two or three pinned beats on the page ground, about one screen each (three screens at most in all). Each beat shows two portraits or artworks side by side, 400 by 520 each with the dealt corner, 120px apart, centred, standing directly on the ground with no mat or frame. A 28px name sits above each picture and one 16px caption line below. As scroll advances the next beat's names and pictures take over from the previous ones in a plain swap scrubbed by scroll. A two-line headline at the head step opens the section before the first beat. After the last beat one picture scales up to fill the screen (about 2.4x over 0.8s of scroll, from a picture at least 2000px wide) and the next section follows it. Phone: one picture per beat at 80% width, name above and caption below, the zoom replaced by a cut.
phone: One picture per beat at 80% width, name above, caption below, a cut instead of the zoom.
houseRuleCheck: Mats and frames are dropped (a box round a picture, framed-elements); the pin is cut from five-plus screens to three; the opening and closing sentences at 40px became one two-line headline; one caption line each, no credit wall; pictures must be designed or studio images, never archive photographs.

name: Pinned service index driving big counter and planes
description: A panel on the surface tone, inside the page margins and in the dealt corner, pinned for about 2.5 screens with one step per item (four or five items). Left: the service names at the body step, the active one marked by a long arrow glyph and set in full ink, the others in the muted tone. Centre: a two-line figure at the display step (a number plus a noun, for example a count and what it counts) that changes with the item, with a two-line paragraph at the lead step and one dealt button under it. Right: a plane showing a fragment of the product's interface in the page's own tokens (perspective about 1200px, rotateY about 20 degrees) that tilts in, settles flat while the step holds and tilts out again. The figure is a stat, never a 01, 02 counter. Phone: only the active service line is shown, figure at the head step, the plane below it, paragraph hidden.
phone: Show only the active service name, a figure at the head step and the plane beneath it, flat; the list collapses; steps at 70vh each.
houseRuleCheck: The small label above the paragraph is dropped. The big figure is a real stat per item, never an ordinal counter. The panel keeps the page margins and has no grain texture. The plane is a data-ui fragment, never a device frame, and rests flat so no text is tilted while read. Pin cut from 4300px to about 2.5 screens; eight services are four or five.

name: Sideways track of stacked tiles
description: A pinned stage about one screen tall, pinned for about 2 screens of scroll, with 24px of ground on all sides and the page margins kept. Two full-width ribbons (56px tall, both on the surface tone, each repeating a short word at the lead step) sit at the top and bottom and drift in opposite directions. Between them a five-column track pans sideways inside a clipped window: columns about 340 wide with 22px gaps in the dealt corner. Each column stacks a picture over a tile or the reverse; a tile is on the surface tone and holds a title at the lead step and two short lines at the body step separated by space only (no rules). The first column is one tall picture. Phone: no pin; the columns become a two-column staggered grid, one ribbon on top.
phone: No pin; two-column staggered tile grid, one ribbon above it, tiles 16px apart.
houseRuleCheck: Ruled rows are spaced lines; the illustration tile is a picture tile; one colour per tile is one surface tone, so there is no wall of tiles in several fills; the track runs inside a clipped, inset window so nothing touches the screen edge; tiles are stacks, not boxes in boxes. Pin kept to two screens.

name: Media panel with word roller
description: A pinned stage on the ground with three steps of about 60vh of scroll each (under two screens in all). On one side a media panel of about 543x641 in the dealt corner, inside the page margin; on the other a two-line headline in the display step, ink on ground. Line one is fixed; line two is a word roller that slides one line height per step through three words, set in the same face, size and colour as line one (no highlight box, no numerals, no rules). Under it a paragraph of at most twelve words in the lead step, three lines at most, whose letters darken from the muted tone to ink in a stagger of about 12ms per letter as each step settles. The media cross-blurs (12px to 0 over 500ms) at every step. The next instance mirrors the sides.
phone: Media panel on top at 70vw, headline and paragraph below; steps stay pinned.
houseRuleCheck: The rolling word is styled exactly like its line (only its motion differs), so it is not a styled accent word. No numerals, no thin rules, no highlight box.

name: Canvas shrinks to portrait triptych
description: On the ground. A full-screen picture shrinks over about 60vh of scroll to a centred portrait window of 331x630 in the dealt corner. At the left, inside the page margins, sits the section heading in the head step, two lines at most. At the right, lower, a paragraph of three lines at most in the body step. Three scenes of about 60vh of scroll each (under three screens in all) swap the heading and paragraph. Ink on ground.
phone: The window at 70vw centred, the heading above, the text under it, swapped per scene.
houseRuleCheck: The small glyph, label and big number are dropped: one heading and one paragraph per scene.

name: Pinned vertical poster stack
description: A pinned stage (100svh) held for three screens of scroll on the ink field (the ground on a dark page). Six poster pictures, each 85svh tall and about 1300 wide at 1440 (the dealt corner, inside the page margins), stand in a vertical stack; native scroll lifts the stack one poster per half screen, the next rising into place as the current one leaves. No loop and no wheel capture, so the page always scrolls on. A line of text inside each poster (a 36px title) moves at 1.2x the poster for depth and sits on the poster's calm part. A slim project list runs down the left margin (16px sentence case, the current name in ink and the others in the muted ink). Phone: posters full width inside the 24px margins on the same scroll, list hidden.
phone: Posters full width inside the 24px margins on the same scroll, list hidden.
houseRuleCheck: The pin is cut from seven screens to three. Wheel capture, the endless loop, motion blur, pointer drag, the round Continue button (an own button) and the 28px thumbnails (small pictures filling a gap) are dropped; native scroll steps the posters, so there is always an exit.

name: Pinned video with left headline
description: A dark video pinned at about 0.9 of the screen height for about one screen of scroll, inset by the page margins in the dealt corner. A headline of two short left-aligned lines at the display step sits at the left margin at mid-height, in the lighter of the ground and the ink on the footage's calm part. A two-line sub at the sub step sits bottom-left and the dealt button sits bottom-right, both 56px from the video's edges. It has no entrance of its own: it arrives with the dealt entrance. Phone: headline at the display step on two lines, sub at the lead step, the dealt button full width at the bottom, video inset to the page margins.
phone: Headline at the display step on two lines, sub at the lead step, the dealt button full width near the bottom, video inset to the page margins.
houseRuleCheck: The uppercase headline is in the dealt display case and two lines, not three; the white pill is the dealt button; the headline lines no longer rise out of masks; the video keeps the page margins. Words sit on the footage's calm part in one tone. Keep it one scene below the hero, never the hero itself.

name: Pinned video panels under a fixed title
description: A sticky 100vh layer with about 60vh of scroll per clip, three clips in all (under three screens). A full-bleed muted looping video changes with each panel (a 500ms crossfade, no wipe). One title of one to three words in the display step, two lines at most, left or right aligned and inside the page margin, stays fixed over the video in the palette's light tone on a calm part of the picture (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), with nothing under it. On the last panel the video scrolls away while the title holds, then releases. No growing window and no alternating grounds.
phone: The title in the display step, two lines at most, pinned at the bottom; video cropped vertical.
houseRuleCheck: No coloured rule under the title. Video is designed or generated, never documentary clips.

name: Polygon video to letterbox band
description: Pinned for about 900px of scroll. A showreel video starts as a small five-point polygon clip (about 220px) at the lower right, grows toward the centre as you scroll, and then opens into a letterbox band about 1296x352 inside the page margins as the clip eases into a rectangle in the dealt corner. A two-line heading at the head step and a one-line note at the body step at the left scroll away with the dealt button; a caption at the lead step sits under the band. The polygon is a mask on real footage, used once. Phone: the clip grows from a 120px polygon to a band of the screen width minus the margins by 220px tall; heading and button stay above it.
phone: Polygon grows from 120px to a band of the screen width minus the margins by 220px tall; heading and button stay above it.
houseRuleCheck: The polygon button is the dealt button. The polygon is a crop of real footage, not a drawn decorative shape, and appears once; no other shapes on the page. A heading is added so the section has one; words and caption sit off the footage.

name: Portrait panel triptych
description: A section about one screen tall on the page ground. A two-line headline at the head step above the row says what the three panels are. Three equal portrait panels at 1:2 (about 416x832 at 1440), 24px apart, centred in the 1296px container; together they fit the width. Each panel is a background photograph with a studio cut-out on top; the two layers move at different speeds with the scroll (the cut-out 12% faster) for depth, transform only. Hovering a panel widens it 12% and narrows its neighbours (the row keeps its width). Phone: panels stack at full width with 4:5 crops, layers keep a small parallax.
phone: Panels stacked at 4:5, small parallax between layers.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The trio fits inside the margins. The front layer is a studio cut-out, never a drawn figure or a letterform. Panels are photographs, styled and modern.

name: Answer card row, then results
description: An interactive section as tall as its content, no pin. A question as a heading at the head step sits above a centred row of four tall answer cards (about 241x362 each, 40px apart) on the surface tone in the dealt corner, each with an answer word at the sub step and one line at the body step. Choosing one (click, tap or arrow keys plus Enter) lifts it 12px and fills it with the accent while the others dim, then the row swaps in place for a results view: one line at the lead step stating the figure that follows from the answer, and a row of three result cards (about 306px wide) each with a title at the lead step, one line and the dealt button. Selected state is shown by fill and lift, never by an outline. Phone: answers 2x2 at 160x210, results stacked.
phone: Answers in a 2x2 at 160x210, results as stacked cards under one stated figure.
houseRuleCheck: No outlines for selection; the bar graph is gone (a chart outside a product fragment) for one stated figure; no pin; cards are single filled cards, not nested; one surface fill, the accent only on the chosen card.

name: Full-screen scene with phase pill and next button
description: One stage 100svh tall, no pin, no scroll stepping. Each of three phases fills the stage with a rendered scene (a still, in the page's one grade). A phase title at the display step on two lines sits at the left at mid-height in the lighter of the ground and the ink on the scene's calm part.
