The dealt button at the bottom right invites the next phase (its label names it) with a plain text link beside it. Pressing it crossfades to the next scene over 700ms and swaps the title; after the last phase it returns to the first. No list, no spine, no second navigation pill, no menu glyph. Phone: title at the head step at the bottom left, the dealt button full width.
phone: Title at the head step bottom-left, the dealt button full width and at least 44px tall.
houseRuleCheck: The phase pill (a second navigation) and the numbered chip are dropped; the next action is the dealt button, not a white pill; the title stays on the scene's calm part. The stage is one screen, so nothing is held or dead. Needs rendered scenes: not dealt without them.

name: Full-width title over stacking step rows
description: The section stands on the ink used as its ground (the palette's field). A two-word title at the display step, left aligned on that ground as live text. Below it three sticky step rows on the surface tone in the dealt corner, each about 1296x386 at 1440 and as tall as its content, stacked with a 12px offset. Each row holds a title at the sub step and a two-line paragraph at the lead step in a 340px column at the left (32px padding) and, at the right half, a crop of the product's interface running to the card's right and bottom edges (the card clips it; no frame of its own). Each new row slides up over the one before while the earlier row sinks 24px and darkens 15% under it. No rules and no step numbers. Phone: rows full width, sticky with 12px offsets, the interface crop on top at 16:9 and the text under it.
phone: Rows at full width, sticky with 12px offsets; the interface crop 16:9 on top, title and paragraph underneath.
houseRuleCheck: Top rules and the step tag with its number are gone; each row is one filled card on one tone (not three tints of ink), so layering comes from the overlap; the media is an interface crop running to the card edges, not a framed video in a card; the title is live text at the display step, not condensed uppercase.

name: Steps on a rotating wheel
description: A pinned stage on a flat palette colour, one step per screen of scroll, three steps (three screens in all). Each step is centred: a 280 by 200 picture (the dealt corner), then a one-word step name at the display step, then a two-line 20px paragraph 360 wide. The steps sit on the rim of one huge invisible wheel (a wrapper about 8000px wide, rotated 90 degrees per step with its transform-origin far below the screen), so the next step slides in from the right while the current one tilts out to the left. Step name and paragraph are in the ink colour, no accent on the word. Phone: no wheel; each step is a full-width card in the dealt card style (picture on top, name at 44px) that arrives with the dealt entrance.
phone: No wheel; each step is a full-width card (picture on top, name at 44px) in the dealt card style.
houseRuleCheck: The 300px stroke numeral became a one-word step name and nothing counts the steps. The leaning cartoon figure became a picture (no drawn illustration). The accent on the word is dropped (one headline colour); the pin is cut to three screens.

name: List with cursor image trail
description: Page ground. A project list of six rows in the 1296px container: each row 96px high, a name at the head step in sentence case at the left and the discipline and year at the right in body size, separated by space and a tint step on hover, not by rules. As the pointer moves over a row, that row's own photograph (240x160, the dealt corner) follows the pointer, fading in and out over 300ms; one at a time. On touch there is no follower: tapping a row opens it and shows a 100px thumbnail beside the name. Phone: rows 80px high, thumbnails 100px on the right.
phone: No follower; 100px thumbnail beside each name, tap to open.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Rows are separated by space and a tint step, not hairlines; no index numbers; no monospace type. Each photograph shows only in its own row, once, styled and never documentary.

name: Centred quote over parallax photo
description: A full-bleed band about one screen tall (1440x900). A picture 1170px tall with a calm middle band glides plus and minus 135px with scroll behind a centred quote, in the lighter of the ground and the ink, of one short sentence at the sub step (three lines at most, about 840px wide) at mid-height, with two lines of attribution (name, role) at the body step in weight 600 below. The quote is the section's heading. The band follows a plain flat section edge above and below. Phone: quote at the lead step in an 80% column, band 90svh, same glide at half range.
phone: Quote at the lead step in an 80% column, band 90svh, parallax at half range.
houseRuleCheck: The notched sheets are dropped. The picture is never darkened as a whole and never under a gradient (failing a calm band, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the quote only). No card or box sits on the picture; the quote sits on the picture's calm part in one tone. The picture is rendered or lifestyle, never documentary; the quote and the name must be real.

name: Cycling serif quote with corner arrows
description: A band on the surface tone, as tall as its content. A column of about 966px from the grid line holds a quote of three or four lines at the sub step in the display face, then the speaker's name and role on two lines at the body step. Two text links with typeset arrows (Previous, Next; 44px targets) sit at the bottom right. About 5 quotes cycle in place: a quote leaves with a 400ms crossfade and the next arrives the same way, every 7 seconds, paused on hover and focus and off for reduced motion; the links step by hand. No counter, no avatar, no big quote glyph. Phone: quote at the lead step in a full-width column, the two links at the left under the credit, swipe works too.
phone: Quote at the lead step in a full-width column, the two links at the left below the credit, swipe works too.
houseRuleCheck: No counter, avatar or large quote glyph; the serif is the dealt display face; the arrows are text links, never a second button shape; quotes crossfade; the quote is at most 36px and four lines.

name: Offset quote band
description: A band on the surface tone, about 300-380px tall, with half the dealt section gap above and below: a quote of 12 to 20 words in the sub step, two or three lines, set from about a third of the way across and 788px wide at most, with an opening quote mark in the accent hanging in the margin to its left, and an attribution in the body step in the muted tone 24px under it at the same x. It may recur once between projects. No media, no controls. Ink on the band.
phone: Quote in the lead step from the page margin in four lines at most, the mark above it, the attribution below.
houseRuleCheck: The attribution stays at 16px, not 13px, and the quote short. The quote is the client's own words with its real attribution.

name: Receding perspective cover deck
description: A pinned scroll of about 2.5 screens over a full-screen ground that takes the front item's tone (always one of three dealt tones: the ground, the surface tone and the field tone). Five square cover pictures are stacked in perspective on the centre axis. The front cover is about 700px wide and sits low on the stage with its lower edge 80px above the bottom; each cover behind it is 56px higher and 72px narrower, so a strip of each shows above the one in front. Scroll brings the next cover forward and the ground tone eases over 600ms. A caption row (a title at the sub step and an arrow glyph) sits 20px under the front cover. Phone: covers 85vw wide inside the margins, the front one fully in view, one step per 80svh, caption at the lead step.
phone: Covers 85vw wide inside the margins, the front cover fully in view, one step per 80svh, caption at the lead step.
houseRuleCheck: Per-item recolouring is limited to three dealt tones so it never sprawls; the label above the title is dropped; the front cover is fully visible (not mostly below the fold); pin about two and a half screens; five covers, each used once.

name: Reel frame rising faster than canvas
description: One wide frame (933x525 at 1440, 16:9, the dealt corner) sits centred horizontally under a heading at the head step on one or two lines, and rises through the fixed canvas faster than the scroll (about 1.5x) and leaves through the top. Inside it, five fragments of the product's own interface (in the page's tokens, running to the frame's edges) swap hard every 150px of scroll. The ground is flat with the dealt section gap above and below. Phone: the frame is the screen width minus the margins at 4:5, the same swapping and a 1.3x speed.
phone: Frame width is the screen width minus the margins at 4:5, hard swaps every 100px of scroll, 1.3x speed.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: one framed montage, no overlays, no outline, no shadow. The frame counts as the page's one framed window, so it is not dealt with a replay or another window; a heading is added so the section has one; nine previews are five.

name: Sharp video tile on a flat ground
description: A section on the page ground. One sharp square tile about 640 by 640 with the dealt corner plays one looping clip, centred. A one-word title at the display step in the light ink stands on the tile's calm part, and the dealt button (a play button) sits under the word. No blurred copy of the clip behind it and no duotone: the clip keeps its colour and the page's one picture grade. The tile is the picture itself, not a text box: no labels or edge row. Hover grows it to 680; a click opens the clip full screen. Phone: the tile 80% of the width, the word 44px.
phone: Tile 80% of the width, word 44px.
houseRuleCheck: The blurred copy of the clip (a second use of one picture) and the duotone grade are dropped; the play glyph is the dealt button; the row of tiny labels is dropped; the sharp tile must be media, never a text card laid over the photograph.

name: Room stations with corner switches
description: A one-screen stage (100svh, not pinned) showing a rendered room (pre-rendered stills crossfaded, or a live scene) reached by a baked camera move. A centred overlay: a headline of two lines at most in the display step, in the palette's light tone on a calm part of the picture (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), and the dealt button about 70% of the way down. Two plain text switches in the bottom corners, the names of the other rooms in the lead step in sentence case, inside the page margins, loop through three rooms (the camera moves in 1.2s). No small tag above the headline, no counters. The accent on the button.
phone: Headline in the display step; the two switches at the bottom as two text buttons side by side.
houseRuleCheck: One face (the dealt display face) on both headline lines; no tag, no numerals. Rooms are designed or rendered, never documentary.

name: Thumbnail field, stepped heading
description: A section about one screen tall on the page ground, with 6 pictures (140 to 260px, the dealt corner) scattered around the heading with no grid, none overlapping any text and each at least a page margin from the screen edge, rising at different speeds (0.6x to 1.6x scroll). In the middle, a four-word heading at the display step in two stair-stepped lines, the second indented 160px further right than the first, with the dealt button centred below it. Phone: 5 pictures of 80 to 140px, heading at the head step in two lines with a 24px indent, the dealt button at least 44px tall.
phone: 5 pictures at 80 to 140px, heading at the head step on two stepped lines (24px indent), the dealt button at least 44px tall.
houseRuleCheck: Heading cut from six words on three lines to four words on two; 32 thumbnails are six larger pictures, each used once; pictures sit beside the type and never under or inside the letters; the button is the dealt button.

name: Rotating object sheds plates
description: A pinned stage for about 2.5 screens of scroll on a flat ground (the field tone or the page ground). A large machined 3D object (about 900px long) stands upright, then tilts and turns over the scroll until it lies horizontal across the centre, while 12 curved plates lift off its sides and fly outward in a staggered burst. A two-line heading at the head step top-left and one short sentence at the lead step stay on the stage's calm side. Scroll alone drives it, with no progress card or bar. Phone: the object is 80vw long, 6 plates instead of 12, the stage 100svh, the heading above the object.
phone: Object 80vw long, 6 plates instead of 12, stage 100svh, same scroll length scaled to 250svh, heading above the object.
houseRuleCheck: The small progress card at the bottom right is dropped (no progress devices); a heading is added so the section has one; the pin is cut from three screens to two and a half. The object needs a real 3D model that comes apart; no drawn shapes.

name: Rotating sphere cluster
description: A pinned WebGL canvas for about 2 screens of scroll. Nine spheres of 120 to 220px with a bright rim light and clean reflections gather into one cluster about 460x570 that turns slowly at the centre (one rotation in about 30 seconds). Five spheres carry a picture, each used once; the other four are plain in the surface tone and the accent. The material is satin or ceramic, never frosted or see-through UI glass. A two-word headline at the display step sits in the bottom 260px of the screen, behind the cluster so the spheres overlap it slightly but never cover a letter. Pointer movement tilts the cluster by up to 8 degrees. Phone: 6 spheres, cluster 70vw wide, headline at the head step.
phone: 6 spheres, cluster 70vw wide, headline at the head step; gyro tilt off.
houseRuleCheck: The blurred echo headline is solid; the material is satin or ceramic, so it does not read as the banned glass effect; the corner chips are dropped (no badges or chips); 22 spheres with pictures or footage are 9 with 5 pictures. Needs a real 3D scene.

name: Rounded colour panel with centred CTA
description: A flat colour panel (the palette's field colour or the ink, its letters at 7:1 or better), as tall as its content (about one screen), with its bottom corners in the dealt corner and the dealt section gap as its top padding. It holds a centred two-line headline at the display step about 780px wide, a centred two-line paragraph at the lead step about 520px wide below it, and the dealt button under that. A bottom row of three short facts (a city, an hour, a promise) at the body step spreads across the container. Nothing is laid on a photograph. Phone: headline at the head step, the facts stacked in one column (two shown), the button full width.
phone: Headline at the head step, the facts in one column (two shown), the button full width.
houseRuleCheck: The panel is the field colour or the ink, never the accent; the paragraph is two lines; the corners are the dealt corner; nothing tucks under its edge and nothing is laid on a photograph; content height; no shadow, no gradient.

name: Rounded dark panel rising with tile grid
description: A solid panel on the field tone or the ink (the dealt corner, about one screen, content height) is pulled up so it rises over the previous section while that section holds. Inside, with page-margin padding: a two-line headline at the display step, centred (plain type, one style), two 446px text columns of two short lines each at the body step, then six project pictures in a grid of three columns by two rows (each at least 280px wide, 16px gaps, the dealt corner) with the project title at the body step under each picture, always visible. Phone: headline at the head step, the text columns stack, pictures in a 2x3 grid, 12px gaps.
phone: Headline at the head step, text columns stacked, pictures in a 2x3 grid, 12px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: The struck-through word and the plain word at the ends of the headline are dropped (no styled word); the uppercase thin headline is the dealt display face; hover-only titles are always-visible captions; tiles are larger so none is a thumbnail. No outlines or shadows.

name: Rounded video, then clip card row
description: On the ground. One video across the page margins (about 765px tall at 1440, in the dealt corner) with a centred one-line headline in the display step across its middle, in the palette's light tone on a calm part of the picture (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), and one 44px pause control in the dealt corner at the bottom right. 16px under it, a row of three equal filled cards in the dealt corner: one text card (a sentence of at most twelve words in the sub step at the top left and a one-line caption in the body step at the bottom left, on the surface tone) and two clip tiles (4:3, with a plain play glyph, no chips). The cards carry a fill and no outline. Ink on the ground; one accent on the pause and play.
phone: The video 4:5 with a headline in the sub step; the three cards stack with 16px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: No chips on the clip tiles (boxes on a photograph); cards filled, never outlined. Footage is designed or generated.

name: Running paragraph of names
description: A section on the page ground. A heading of two to five words at the head step, then one statement at the sub step across the 1296px container (two lines at most) made of 6 to 8 real client or partner names separated by slashes, all set as text (no logos or pictures in the line). The words start in the muted tone and brighten to full ink one by one as the statement passes mid-screen (scrubbed); the finished and the reduced-motion state are all full ink. Nothing else in the section, with the dealt section gap above and below. Phone: type at the lead step in 4 or 5 lines, 24px margins.
phone: Statement at the lead step in 4 or 5 lines, 24px margins, same scrubbed brighten.
houseRuleCheck: The tiny label is dropped; the statement is two lines at most (not a three-line paragraph at display size); about 16 names are 6 to 8, so it is not a credit wall; names are text only, since logos in a display-size line would be pictures inside a headline; idle words use the muted tone (not 20% ink) to hold contrast.

name: Chapter title around a floating picture
description: A chapter opener about 1.5 screens tall, on the surface tone. The title is two words on two lines at the display step, set apart across the width inside the page margins: the first word at the left, the second at the right one line lower. One cut-out object (a photographed or rendered subject with a transparent background) floats between the two words at 1.3x scroll, never set inline within a line of type. A caption in the body step sits at top centre. Ink on the panel.
phone: The two words stack at the display step, the cut-out layered between them with the same speed.
houseRuleCheck: A cut-out photograph or render, never a drawing; the title is two words on two lines at the dealt display size, in one tone; the object never sits inside a line of type.

name: Scattered tiles around centred heading
description: One screen on the plain page ground. A centred two-line heading at the head step with one short line at the lead step under it. Four picture tiles of about 240x300 in the dealt corner are scattered around it: top left, top right, lower left and middle right, each at least a page margin from the screen edge and none overlapping the text. Tiles float with a slow vertical drift (plus and minus 12px) and shift 14px opposite to the pointer; where the page has video, a tile may be a silent loop. Phone: four tiles of 120x150 above and below the heading, heading at the head step, no pointer shift.
phone: Four 120x150 tiles above and below the heading (head step), no pointer shift.
houseRuleCheck: The bracket-corner chip around the heading, the pause chips and the overlap with the first letter are dropped; the right tile keeps the page margin; tiles are pictures, loops only where the page has video.

name: Scene on a matching black ground
description: On the darkest tone of the palette, as tall as its content. A scene 1180x770 (a render, a product shot or a photograph produced on a plain background identical to the ground, so its edges merge into the ground with no CSS mask or gradient) sits at the top, centred inside the page margins. A title block at the head step, two lines in sentence case, no raised label, sits 60px under it. Scroll: the scene slides down 120px against the title (scrubbed, transform only). Phone: the scene full width less the margins, the title at the sub step.
phone: Scene full width less the margins, title at the sub step.
houseRuleCheck: The feathered mask is replaced by a picture whose own background is the ground colour; the label is out; the scene no longer fades to nothing, so no heading is left alone on an empty screen.

name: Scroll-scrubbed full-bleed video
description: A section holding a full-bleed video, pinned for about 2 screens of scroll (the section is the pin plus one screen). A heading at the head step on two lines sits on the ground above the video and scrolls away before the pin begins. The video then fills the pinned screen with no text on it, and its playback is scrubbed by scroll position over about 1800px; playback rewinds when scrolling up. Encode all-intra or as a frame sequence for smooth scrubbing. Phone: use a portrait cut of the footage, section 250svh. Variant: the video plays in a centred frame (16:10, the dealt corner) inside the page margins on the ground, no mat, no shadow.
phone: Portrait cut of the footage, section 250svh, scrub length 1500px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: one full-bleed video with no text on it. A heading is added above so the section has one; the dead 200px pauses at both ends and the four-screen height are gone; the footage is rendered or produced, never documentary; the matted variant is a plain frame (a frame in a frame is dropped).

name: Wheel-spun card fan on an arc
description: A stage held with position: sticky for about two screens of scroll. A two-line headline at the head step at the top on the page ground; below it six portrait picture cards (about 240x340, the dealt corner) in a fan along a wide arc, turned tangent to it, built with CSS 3D. Native scroll turns the whole fan around the arc through half a turn (scrubbed, transform only), so each card in turn comes to the middle: the middle card is full size and the others 0.8. No captions. Reduced motion: the fan stands still. Phone: cards at 60% scale, the same scroll turn.
phone: Smaller cards, the same scroll turn.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Native scroll turns the fan: no wheel capture, no sound, no counter or numbering. Pictures are styled, never documentary. One headline, so the stage is never wordless.

name: Two-column sheet lifting off fixed video
description: A full-width sheet on the surface tone, as tall as its content (about 0.6 screen), with its bottom corners in the dealt corner, lying over a fixed video. At the left a two-line headline at the head step from the left page margin. At the right, from the half-width line, a three-line paragraph at the lead step (about 400px wide) and the dealt button. As the sheet scrolls away it uncovers the next full-screen scene underneath: the fixed video with a short heading at the head step on the footage's calm part. Phone: the columns stack, headline at the head step, the sheet 70svh at most.
phone: Columns stack; headline at the head step, paragraph and the dealt button under it, sheet 70svh at most.
houseRuleCheck: Paragraph is at the lead step and three lines; the soft grey pill is the dealt button; the sheet is a filled section edge, not a card over footage; no outline, no shadow; words on the footage sit on its calm part.

name: Shrinking panel, rising cut-out
description: A flat panel in the field tone (one colour, no gradient), full-bleed at first, shrinks to a card inside the page margins (the dealt corner, one screen tall) as it slides up, while a centred one-line headline at the display step sits on it in ink. A large cut-out photograph (a hand and arm, a product, a figure) rises from the bottom to fill the lower part of the panel without covering the headline. Under the panel, a centred two-line caption at the lead step. Phone: the panel shrinks to the page margins, headline at the head step on two lines, cut-out 85vw.
phone: Panel shrinks to the page margins, headline at the head step on two lines, cut-out 85vw rising.
houseRuleCheck: The soft gradient is one flat tint; the video tile under the panel is dropped (a second window); one screen tall, not 1260px; the cut-out must be a lit, produced photograph, not documentary; the headline is ink on the panel.

name: Shrunk image column beside title and names
description: A pinned split stage over about 2.5 screens of scroll. The full-bleed picture scene shrinks from the top left to a column of about 480px inset by the page margin (the dealt corner), leaving a stack of four 480x270 pictures that scrolls up inside it, each drifting inside its frame. On the plain ground at the right: a one-word title at the display step, a list of four short names at the lead step (the active one in full ink, the others in the muted tone, no rules, no numbers) near the far right, and a two-line paragraph at the lead step near the bottom. Phone: no pin; the title above, then the four pictures stacked at full width inside the margins, the names listed once under the paragraph.
phone: No pin: title at the head step above, then the pictures stacked at full width inside the margins, names listed once under the paragraph.
houseRuleCheck: The picture column is inset by the page margin instead of flush to the edge; the ruled numbered index is four names with active and idle ink; the caps label and numbers are gone; the pin is cut from 4800px to about 2.5 screens; idle names use the muted tone.

name: Side drawer leaving an edge sliver
description: A dialog opened by the page's one action: a panel on the surface tone, full height, slides in over the page and leaves a 60px strip of the page visible at one side; clicking the strip or pressing Escape closes it, and focus stays inside while it is open. Its content block sits about 195px from the top on a 12-column grid with 24px gutters: a heading at the head step with a hanging opening quote mark on the left, and an info column of short paragraphs at the lead step and text links in the accent. The slide takes 600ms with an ease-out; the page behind dims by 30% flat. Phone: the panel becomes a sheet rising from the bottom, 92svh tall, with the dealt corner on top.
phone: A bottom sheet 92svh tall with the dealt corner on top; a tap on the visible strip above closes it.
houseRuleCheck: Info text is at the lead step; one flat dim, no shadow on the resting page (only the open panel may carry one). The sliver means the panel never runs flush to both edges. A dialog, not a scroll scene: the page needs a real trigger for it.

name: Rounded photo scene in sideways strip
description: A pinned horizontal strip, pinned for about 2 screens, that moves about 1.5px per px of scroll. A short statement scene (a statement at the sub step on two lines) is followed by a near-full-viewport picture panel (about 1392x864, inside the page margins, the dealt corner) that slides in from the right. Over the picture, in the lighter of the ground and the ink on its calm part (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only): a two-line headline at the head step at its lower left, and three benefit columns along its lower right (a title at the lead step in weight 600 and a one-line text at the body step each, no icons). The picture is lifestyle or rendered. Phone: no pin; the panel is a 4:5 card at the screen width minus the margins with the headline and the three benefits stacked on its calm part.
phone: No pin; a 4:5 card at the screen width minus the margins, headline at the sub step and the three benefits stacked on its calm part.
houseRuleCheck: No accent word and no line icons; no layer over the picture and no gradient (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only); benefits are plain type, not boxes on the picture; words sit on the picture's calm part at 1440, 768 and 390; the pin is two screens.

name: One 3D object per screen with side tags
description: A pinned full-screen stage, about 2.5 screens of scroll in all (one screen per object, 3 objects), on a flat soft ground. A two-line heading at the head step sits top-left. One faceted 3D object (about 320x440) at a time drifts and turns at the centre. At its left a card on the surface tone in the dealt corner of two lines (a name at the lead step and a short note at the body step) and at its lower right a three-line data block at the body step, both in sentence case. Each object links to its detail with a plain text link. Phone: object 70vw wide, the card above it, the data block below, one object per 100svh.
phone: Object 70vw wide, the card above it, the data block below, one object per 100svh.
houseRuleCheck: Leader lines (hairlines), mono labels and numbering are removed; the ghost words (8% ink giant type) and the fog gradient are dropped for a flat ground; the filled pill tag is a card beside the object, not a box on a photograph; four objects are three, so the pin stays under three screens.

name: Single centred image column with variable spans
description: A column of five or six pictures, centred on a 24-column grid inside the page margins with 14px gutters and 24-40px between pictures. Each picture spans 12, 14, 16 or 24 columns by its aspect: landscapes take 24, portraits 12 to 18 and sit centred, never flush to one side. The pictures take the dealt corner and carry no caption, border or text beside them. One centred heading in the head step, one line, sits above. The page ground eases between the ground and the surface tone as each picture crosses mid-screen (a flat colour change over 600ms, never a gradient), and the ink stays legible on both. The pictures arrive with the dealt entrance. The dealt section gap lies before and after the column.
phone: Every picture spans the full width inside the page margins with a 20px gap; the ground change stays.
houseRuleCheck: Five or six pictures, not ten. Pictures must be designed or generated (not archive snapshots), and one image-only column is a single section, not the whole page.

name: Single wide card carousel
description: A section on the page ground. One big card per slide (about 1296x640 at 1440, the surface tone, the dealt corner) inside the page margins; slides change by two text links with typeset arrows (Previous, Next; 44px targets, under the card on the right) and by a 7 second auto-advance that pauses on hover and focus and is off for reduced motion, with a 500ms crossfade. Left half of the card: a title at the sub step in the display face, a two-line paragraph at the lead step, two figures each in its own line (a number at the sub step with what it counts in the same line) and one dealt button. The right half is the card's own fill holding a crop of the product's interface running to the card's right, top and bottom edges, no frame. Phone: the card is the screen width minus the margins, the interface crop above the text, the two links below.
phone: Card at the screen width minus the margins, the interface crop above the text, the two links below the card.
houseRuleCheck: Nested stat tiles are plain lines, the grey side panel is part of the same card, and the peeking card is gone, so nothing runs into the screen edge and there is no drag rail; the fan of framed phone screens is an interface crop (never a device frame); the serif is the dealt display face; slides advance by buttons and a pausable timer.

name: Small-wide pair then three-up grid
description: A band on the ground. A centred heading in the head step, one short line, sits 52px above a 12-column grid inside the page margins with 16px gutters. Row one pairs a small card (4 columns: a 440x300 picture on top, then a card title of at most three words and one line of at most eight words on the surface tone, in the dealt corner) with a wide card (8 columns: a 900x600 picture), tops aligned; the sides swap on a repeat. Below, one row of three equal cards in the same style, 128px apart vertically. Hover: the picture scales to 1.03. Ink on card, the accent unused or on one link.
phone: One column, the wide card first, 20px between cards.
houseRuleCheck: Use it as one section among others, never a page made only of boxes. Cards are one fill with the dealt corner, no outline, no shadow; the heading is a plain heading, not a label.

name: Sparse tall tile with scattered labels
description: A sheet on the page ground slides up over the fixed previous scene. Twelve-column grid inside the page margins. One tall tile (about 440x615, in the field tone or ink, the dealt corner) holds a rendered picture at column 5. A two-line heading at the head step sits at columns 1 to 3 near the top so the left is not empty; a right-aligned line at the lead step (a real fact, one short phrase) sits left of the tile lower down; a second fact at the lead step sits at mid-height on the right, and at the foot a text link with a thin arrow. Nothing else, with the dealt section gap around it all. Phone: the tile at 70vw, the lines stacked above and below, the link at the foot.
phone: The tile at 70vw, the lines in a single column above and below it, the link at the foot.
houseRuleCheck: The 2px rule above the link row is dropped (a plain text link with an arrow); the heading sits at columns 1 to 3 so the left of the grid is not empty; the scattered lines are real facts, not tiny labels; margins are the page margins.

name: Split card, photo half and text half
description: One card (about 1296x640 at 1440, on the field tone or the surface tone, the dealt corner) inside the page margins. Its left half is a picture flush to the card's edge. Its right half, with 40px padding, has a two-line title at the sub step at the top and, at the bottom, a two-line paragraph at the lead step and the dealt button. No inner tile, no tag, no label. It has no entrance of its own: it arrives with the dealt entrance; on hover the picture scales from 1 to 1.04 inside the card. Phone: the picture on top at 4:3, the text part under it, the dealt button full width.
phone: Picture on top at 4:3, text part below, the dealt button full width.
houseRuleCheck: The nested dark link tile, the tag and the mono and caps labels are dropped; the link is the dealt button, so there is no box in a box; the 56px title is a card title at the sub step (no headline in a card); the picture reveal and the mask rise are gone (the dealt entrance decides).

name: Split display word crossed by a band
description: A section on the field tone or the ink, content height (about one screen). One word, not the page's name, is split diagonally across the section at the display step: the first half sits top-left a page margin in from the edges and the second half lower right. A full-width band 42px tall (a flat accent strip repeating a short word at the body step, no drawn shapes) drifts sideways between the two halves at mid-height, never over a letter. Two small heading-and-paragraph pairs (a title at the lead step and two lines at the body step) sit in the opposite corners. Phone: the word halves at the display step stacked diagonally, the band 36px, the two pairs stacked under the word.
phone: Word halves at the display step stacked diagonally, the band 36px, the two pairs stacked under the word.
houseRuleCheck: The three uppercase tags at the top are dropped; the strip of repeated drawn shapes is a repeating word; the word is capped at the display step and is never the page name; the band passes between the halves, so no word is cut by it; the section is content height.

name: Split modal: picture and scroll pane
description: A centred dialog (up to 1040x620, at most the viewport minus 120px each way, the dealt corner) opened by a button over the page, with a 250ms scale-and-fade, focus kept inside and Escape closing it; the page behind dims by 30% flat. The dialog sits on the ink; two panes with no gap: the left half is a cover-fit picture flush to the dialog edge; the right half scrolls on the surface tone with a title at the head step in the display face, body text at the lead step and two actions (the dealt button and the dealt second-action link). A row of 3 text tabs hangs at the top of the right pane. Phone: the dialog becomes a full-screen sheet with the picture above (35vh) and the text below, the tabs under the picture.
phone: Full-screen sheet: 35vh picture on top and the text pane scrolling below; tabs under the picture.
houseRuleCheck: The inset 1px frame, the radial gradient fill, the progress bars and the icon tabs are dropped; flat fills, and the picture is flush to the dialog edge, so no box in a box; the title is in the dealt display face; the two actions are the dealt button and the dealt second action.

name: Split poster with a circular photo crop
description: A split section about 80svh tall, divided at x 720. Left half: one flat saturated palette colour; in its middle a circular photo crop about 640 across (a clip-path circle holding one picture, so the circle is a crop of a real image, never a flat drawn disc). Right half: the ink field (the ground on a dark page), a two-line headline at the display step in the light ink (6 to 9 characters per line) centred, and one 21px bold sentence low down, 560 wide. Each half centres its own content; the circle is there from the first frame (the dealt entrance decides arrival). Used once on the page, never mirrored. Phone: stack the halves, a colour half about 60vh with a 300px circle, then the dark half with a 44px headline.
phone: Halves stacked, 300px circle in a 60vh colour half, dark half with a 44px headline.
houseRuleCheck: The 32px line grid (hairlines) is dropped; the black disc became a photo crop so it is not a drawn shape; the headline is two lines at the display step (it was three lines at 104px); the rise on entering is the dealt entrance; the mirrored repeat is dropped.

name: Split square tile pair
description: Two near-square tiles side by side inside the page margins, 16px apart, each about 688 by 680 with the dealt corner. One tile is filled in the surface tone and the other in one flat palette field colour (the accent where the palette allows it), never a third fill. Each holds one product cut-out centred at about 60% of the tile, a 28px name at the top left (20px inset) and a 16px arrow glyph at the bottom right; the whole tile is one link. No header strip, label, swatch dots or round button. Hover scales the object 1.06 with a 3 degree turn. The tiles arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: tiles stack at full width, 16px between.
phone: Tiles stack at full width, 16px between.
houseRuleCheck: The header strip with a label and line and the swatch dots (colour sprawl) are dropped; the two fills are the surface tone and one palette colour; the round arrow button is a plain glyph; the tile rise is the dealt entrance and the hover fill change is dropped.

name: Split title closing on growing media
description: A band on the ink field (the ground on a dark page), two screens tall, with a sticky 100svh stage. At the start two heavy words in the display face at the display step sit far left (x 60) and far right on one baseline (3 to 7 letters each), with a small picture between them, 360 by 225 (the dealt corner), centred. While pinned for about 900px of scroll the words close in toward the centre from opposite sides while the picture grows to about 1200 by 750. At the end the words meet on the picture's lower part in the light ink; that part must be calm and of one tone (no tint laid over it; if the picture has no calm part the words stop either side of it). When the pin releases, a two-line centred 22px paragraph sits under the picture. No label above. Phone: words 64px on one row above and below the picture; the picture grows from 70% to 100% width.
phone: Words 64px above and below the picture; the picture grows from 70% to 100% width.
houseRuleCheck: The small label is dropped. The flat 25% tint under the words is dropped (nothing laid over a picture), so the picture's lower part must be calm. Sizes are the dealt display step. The variant with five hard-cut pictures, a difference blend and uppercase is not built; the ids in merged stay for the record.

name: Spread title over staggered portrait cards
description: A section on the page ground. One title line at the display step is spread across the full 1296px container in three pieces in one style (a word at the left, a word at the centre, a word right-aligned) with a two-line sub at the lead step under it. Below, three loose columns of portrait cards on the surface tone in the dealt corner: the outer two (324x406) level, the smaller middle card (210x236) dropped 216px. Each card has the picture flush at the top and the name at the lead step and a one-line note at the body step in the plate under it. The dealt section gap follows the section. Phone: cards 78vw wide stacked with a 20px stagger left and right inside the margins, title at the head step on two lines.
phone: Cards 78vw wide stacked with a 20px left and right stagger inside the margins, title at the head step on two lines.
houseRuleCheck: The italic phrase and the small arrow in the title are dropped (no styled accent words); the cards carry their own filled plates; the next row no longer peeks in, so there is real space after the section; plate text is at the body step or larger.

name: Square video over filled accordion rows
description: Ground = the palette ground, ink in contrast. A centred square looping muted video, about 38% of the container width (543px at 1440), in the dealt corner. 120px below it a stack of three filled bars (surface tone, the dealt corner, up to 1056px wide, centred, 12px apart), each holding one centred word at the display step in the display face; no rules, no brand row, no button above them. The first bar is open at rest, the others closed. Click or tap on a closed bar: its word lifts up and out over 320ms while the bar grows into a panel (about 830px wide) holding a lead line of 6 words at most and one body-step sentence of 14 words at most; one panel open at a time, the others slide down. Hover on a closed bar moves its fill one step in tone and nudges the word up 6px. Phone: the video full container width at 1:1, bars full width with the word at the head step, a panel opens in place and pushes the bars below down, 20px padding.
phone: Square video full width, bars full width, the panel opens in place.
houseRuleCheck: Rows are filled bars separated by gaps, never rules or an outlined box; one panel open at a time; the video is muted and loops.

name: Ink panel over a card row
description: One inset panel on the ground (the ink field, flat, the dealt corner, 1344px wide at 1440, about 80svh tall, a page margin in from the sides). Inside it a top-centred stack: a two-line headline at the head step in the ground colour (6-9 words), one line at the lead step, and the dealt button with the dealt second action beside it. A crop of the product's own interface (data-ui, no window frame of its own, no second panel) rises from the panel's bottom edge and is cut off by the panel, never by the screen. 24px below the panel a row of three filled cards (surface tone, the dealt corner, 24px gaps) stands straight on the page ground, each with a title at the sub step and one body-step line at the foot, no picture, no icon. The cards sit still; hover lifts one 6px. No scrolling strip, no peeking card, no drag. Phone: the panel full container width with the crop under the text at 4:3, the cards stacked with 16px gaps.
phone: Panel full width with the crop under the text; cards stacked.
houseRuleCheck: One flat panel with no shadow; the interface crop is cut by the panel, never by the screen; the cards stand on the ground, never inside the panel (no box in a box); no scrolling strip, peek or drag.

name: Staggered four-column cut-out cards
description: Ground = the palette ground, ink in contrast. A two-line headline at the head step across columns 1-5 and a one-line paragraph at the body step across columns 8-12. Below, a four-column grid in the container with 24px gutters and eight filled cards about 318x330, all in the one surface tone (the dealt corner, no outline, no chip, no second fill); columns 2 and 4 are dropped 180px so the grid zigzags. Each card holds one cut-out object (a product or render on a transparent ground) centred at about 70% of the card, and under it at the left the name at the lead step and the year at the body step as plain text on the card. Hover tilts the object 4 degrees and lifts it 8px; nothing else moves and the cards arrive with the dealt entrance. A centred one-line closing statement at the sub step follows 160px lower. Phone: two columns with a 100px drop kept, cards 4:5, text at the body step.
phone: Two columns, 100px drop kept, 4:5 cards.
houseRuleCheck: Filled cards in the one surface tone, no outline, chip or second fill; the name and year are plain text on the card.

name: Stair-step headline into map card
description: Ground = the palette ground, ink in contrast; the accent is used for the button only. A headline of three short words at the display step in the display face on two lines, set in two steps inside the container: line one flush left at the margin, line two starting at column 5 and running to the right margin; it arrives with the dealt entrance. 120px below, a row split 7/5: left a map card (a real map render, the dealt corner, 4:3, about 760x570) with three ink dots as places that show the place name in a filled label (16px, surface tone) on hover or tap; right a filled address card (surface tone, the dealt corner, 32px padding) with the address at the lead step in three short lines, one body-step opening-hours line and the dealt button. Phone: the headline keeps its two steps (line two indented 18%), the map 4:3 full width with the address card under it.
phone: Two steps kept (second line indented 18%), map then address card full width.
houseRuleCheck: A real map of the place, never line art; place labels 16px sentence case on a filled label; both headline steps stay inside the margins; the accent only on the button.

name: Statement beside a news column
description: Ground = the palette ground. An 8/4 split in the container with a 48px gutter and the section gap above and below. Left (about 900px): a two-line statement of 8-10 words at the sub step in the display face, ink, with no picture set into it, and one body-step line under it. Right (about 400px): two filled article cards side by side (surface tone, the dealt corner, about 190x360 each), each a 4:5 picture running to the card's top and side edges with a two-line title at the lead step below it in 16px padding. Hover lifts a card 6px; the cards arrive with the dealt entrance. No rules and no labels over the columns. Phone: the statement first at the sub step, then the two cards as a 2-up row, each a 4:5 picture over a two-line title at the body step.
phone: Statement first, then two cards as a 2-up row.
houseRuleCheck: No picture inside the statement; the cards carry the pictures; no rules and no labels over the columns.

name: Centred headline with corner bios
description: Ground = the palette ground, ink in contrast. A centred two-line headline of 4-6 words at the display step in the dealt display face, widest line about 900px, with the section gap above. 96px under it a row with two bio blocks at the container's left and right edges (a page margin in): each a name and two short role lines at the lead step, the left one left-aligned and the right one right-aligned, and the dealt button centred between them. Real names and roles only. Everything arrives with the dealt entrance. Phone: the headline in the same two lines at the head step, the two bio blocks side by side under it, the dealt button full width at the end.
phone: Two-line headline, bios side by side under it, full-width button.
houseRuleCheck: The bio blocks are lead-step sentence case, never tiny labels; real names and roles only; one button, the dealt one.

name: Centred display with picture-reveal words
description: Ground = the palette's field colour or the ground, ink in contrast. Content is centred in columns 4-9 (about 670px). A two-line headline of 3-5 words at the display step. 32px under it a centred row of three or four plain words at the lead step, 40px apart, naming the subject's own things (underline on hover; no chips, no fills, no button shape). On hover, focus or tap of a word a 360x277 picture card (the dealt corner) rises 24px above the headline block and fades in over 160ms, then goes on release; on touch a tap toggles it, one open at a time. 54px below, one body-step line about 390px wide and the dealt button, centred. Pictures are cut-outs or toned photographs of the subject's world. Phone: the picture card opens above the block at full container width 4:3, the line and button stacked and centred.
phone: Tap toggles the picture card above the headline at full width 4:3.
houseRuleCheck: The words are plain type under the headline, never chips, fills or a button shape; the picture opens as a card above the block, never inside the headline; a press or hover, never a drag.

name: Display over an opening perspective frame
description: Ground = one palette colour, about 250svh tall. Section-gap padding, then a two-line headline at the display step in the display face, centred, ink in contrast, nothing above it. Below it a sticky stage (100svh, held for about 150svh of scroll) holds one picture (on a software page a crop of the product interface): it starts as a tilted quad (CSS rotateX 55deg, scale 0.55, perspective 1200px) and, driven by scroll and smoothed (lerp 0.1), opens to a flat 1200x680 frame in the dealt corner, centred inside the margins. When it is flat a 504px description at the body step in muted ink sits low under it. Plain CSS transform, no WebGL. Phone: the frame opens from rotateX 40deg to flat at full container width 4:5, the pin shortens to 150svh.
phone: Frame opens from a 40 degree tilt to flat, 4:5, pin 150svh.
houseRuleCheck: Nothing above the headline; plain CSS transform, no WebGL; the frame stays inside the margins; the hold is about 150svh.

name: Centred statement with line drift
description: A centred column 696 wide on the page ground with the dealt section gap above and below. A two-line centred headline at the head step (8 to 12 words), each line in its own wrapper and drifting at its own rate as the section scrolls (line 1 up to 36px, line 2 up to 20px), so the block shears gently without breaking reading order; both lines stay in the full ink at every point. No label above and no paragraph under it. Phone: headline 28px, 24px margins, drift capped at 12px.
phone: Headline 28px at 24px margins, drift capped at 12px.
houseRuleCheck: The small label and its own parallax layer are dropped (eyebrow). The 44px, four-line statement is a two-line headline at the head step (a paragraph over 36px fails); the fade from 40% ink is dropped (low contrast and an entrance of its own); only the per-line drift stays.

name: Paragraph on a shader screen
description: A shader field (WebGL canvas, about 80svh and at least 560px tall) behind one paragraph: a noise-driven flowing texture quantised into 3-4 flat tones from the palette, no smooth colour gradient, slow time. One paragraph of about 25 words at the sub step in the display face, about 880px wide starting at column 3, left-aligned, in the ink or ground colour that holds 4.5:1 against every tone; nothing above it, no label. It arrives with the dealt entrance; pointer movement nudges the flow slightly. Phone: the paragraph at the lead step inside the container, the shader at half resolution and capped at 30fps, with a flat single-tone fallback.
phone: Paragraph at the lead step, half-resolution shader capped at 30fps.

name: Centred two-line statement
description: Ground = the flat palette ground, ink in contrast; no media. One block centred in the container: a statement of two lines at the display step in the display face, an opening line of 4-6 words and a closing line of 1-3 words, the block up to about 1000px wide. It arrives with the dealt entrance. The section is as tall as its content with the section gap above and below; the accent colour is not used. Phone: the same two lines at the head step, centred. Variant: the same two lines on a full-width field in the palette's field colour with the dealt corner on its top corners, ink on it at 7:1 or better.
phone: Two lines at the head step, centred.
houseRuleCheck: Two lines at the display step in one ink, no accent; the field variant is one flat field colour with ink at 7:1 or better.

name: Centred word-tumble paragraph
description: Ground = the palette ground, ink in contrast. A centred two-line statement of 5-8 words at the display step in the display face, in a column about 930px wide; nothing else in the section, the section gap above and below. Every word is visible from the first frame (nothing hides): each sits 16px low and rotated by -20 to +20 degrees, and as the block travels from the lower third to the middle of the screen (scroll-linked, native scroll) the words turn upright and settle one after another in reading order, the last with a small overshoot. Reduced motion shows the upright statement. No icons or pictures in the lines. Phone: two lines at the head step, the same settle.
phone: Two lines at the head step, same scroll-linked settle.
houseRuleCheck: No icons or pictures in the lines; every word is visible from the first frame and whole at every step; upright for reduced motion.

name: Colour-block poster with crossing date
description: A poster block inside the container (1344px wide at 1440, about 720px tall), a page margin in from the sides, made of four flat blocks with 12px gaps in the dealt corner and in three fills only: the ground, the one surface tone and the ink (the ink on one block, its letters in the ground colour). Top: a wide block in the surface tone holding a three-line paragraph at the body step at its left. Right: a tall block (about 460x650) on the ink carrying a two-line date or key figure at the display step; the figure's first line starts on the top block and runs across the split onto the ink block, its letters changing colour exactly at the split (drawn twice, each copy clipped to its block, the extra copy hidden from screen readers). Lower left: one picture in the dealt grade (about 380x300). Bottom: a wide block (about 688x116) in the surface tone with one line at the sub step. Hover shifts a block's fill one step; the blocks arrive with the dealt entrance. No outline, no shadow, no label. Phone: the blocks restack into a two-column mosaic, the date at the head step on two lines, the top block full width, the picture 4:3, the strip last.
phone: Two-column mosaic, date at the head step, top block full width.
houseRuleCheck: Three palette fills only (the ground, the surface tone, the ink), never the accent as a ground; inside the 48px margins; no label; the paragraph is three lines at most.

name: Display word behind a rising 3D figure
description: A pinned canvas on one flat tone, about 1.5 screens of scroll: one centred word, the section's heading, in the display step in the dealt display face, ink. A large 3D figure (an abstract or product-like model in neutral materials) rises from below in front of the word and stops at about 70% of the screen height; under it one line in the lead step says what the figure is. The word arrives with the dealt entrance and fades out at the end.

name: Footage with top title and hung prints
description: A full-width looping muted video fills 100svh and is scrubbed by scroll, moving 8% vertically inside its frame. A centred two-line question at the display step in the display face sits in the upper third (top about 140px), its colour picked against the footage by measured contrast on a calm part; no overlay, no tint, no gradient. Two small prints (about 180x225, the dealt corner, plain pictures with no border) hang tilted 4-6 degrees at the top right and the lower left and drift at a different rate from the footage (scroll-linked). At the foot, bottom centre, one sentence at the body step and the dealt button with the dealt second action beside it, 24px apart; never two buttons to the same place. Phone: footage in 100svh, headline at the head step, prints 96px at top right and bottom left, the button full width.
phone: Footage 100svh, 96px prints, full-width button.
houseRuleCheck: No overlay, tint or gradient on the footage: the question sits on its calm part; the prints are plain pictures with no border or card fill; the sentence is 16px or more.

name: Video statement with corner testimonials
description: A looping muted video fills the section edge to edge at 100svh and shifts 6% inside its frame as the page scrolls (scroll-linked). A centred two-line statement at the display step in the display face sits at mid-height in the ink or ground colour that reads at 4.5:1 on a calm part of the footage; no tint, no gradient, no overlay over the picture. In the bottom corners, a page margin in from the sides, two testimonial blocks about 320px wide with no box: a plain rating figure (a number and a short word) at the body step, a three-line quote at the body step and a credit at 16px or more. Real quotes only. Phone: the video 100svh, the statement at the head step, one testimonial only (left) above the bottom edge.
phone: One testimonial only, statement at the head step over a 100svh video.
houseRuleCheck: No overlay, tint or gradient on the footage: the statement sits on its calm part; ratings are a plain figure, never stars; real quotes only, at 16px or more.

name: Justified display statement
description: Ground = the palette ground, ink in contrast. A two-line statement of 8-10 words in the dealt display face at the display step, justified across the container with the last line justified too (text-align-last: justify, hyphenation off). Set the line breaks by hand and tune the tracking per line by plus or minus 0.02em so the word gaps stay even; no rule or glyph fills any gap. It arrives with the dealt entrance; the section is as tall as its content with the section gap above and below. Phone: the statement cut to 5-6 words in two lines at the head step, left-aligned.
phone: Cut to 5-6 words, two lines at the head step, left-aligned.

name: Headline among cut-out objects
description: Ground = the palette ground. A centred two-line headline at the display step in the display face, in ink (one colour, no accent word, no outline, no badge), about 780px wide. Four cut-out pictures (230-320px, transparent backgrounds, real objects or people) sit in the four corners around the headline block, clear of every letter and overlapping the block by 15% at most; they drift on scroll (scroll-linked) at 0.2x-0.5x in opposite directions and tilt 3-6 degrees. No picture sits inside the headline. Phone: the headline at the head step in two lines, the cut-outs 90-120px at the corners, drift halved.
phone: Two-line headline at the head step, 90-120px cut-outs at the corners.
houseRuleCheck: The cut-outs sit at the block's corners, clear of every letter and overlapping the block by 15% at most, so no picture sits inside the headline; no outline or badge; one ink colour.

name: Statement leading into a product window
description: Ground = the palette ground. A centred two-line statement at the sub step (about 1100px wide) with the section gap above; no label above and no icon tiles in the line. 122px lower a product window 1114x685 at 1440 sits centred in the dealt corner, a flat frame in the surface tone with a 56px header bar that carries the product's own title only (no dots), holding a gapless mosaic of six tiles of the product's own content (stills or interface crops that run to the tile edges) on a three-column track with tiles 1x1, 2x1 and 1x2. It is the only window on the page and keeps a page margin on both sides. On scroll the window rises 60px and scales from 0.92 to 1 (scroll-linked); hovering a tile lifts it 4px. Phone: the statement at the lead step, the window full container width with a two-column mosaic of four tiles and a 40px header bar.
phone: Full-width window, two-column mosaic of four tiles.
houseRuleCheck: No label above the statement and no icon tiles in it; the window is the only one on the page, carries the product's own title and no dots, and keeps the page margins.

name: Left column held over a long canvas scroll
description: A 200svh section with a sticky 100svh stage and a WebGL scene behind: one slow 3D object (a model turning with the scroll and changing one thing across the hold, its colour or its scale) in the palette's tones. A column starts at column 2 (about x 100 at 1440), up to 60% of the width wide, with a two-line headline at the display step and a paragraph at the body step (line-height 1.6, 500px wide at most) held at mid-screen; it stays still while the scene changes behind it. Keep the scene's tones quiet behind the column (value range within 25%) and pick the ink or ground-colour type that holds 4.5:1. No particles, no drawn graphics. Phone: no pin, the scene above and the text under it.
phone: No pin, scene above, text under it.
houseRuleCheck: The scene stays quiet behind the column (value range within 25%) so the type holds 4.5:1; no particles, no drawn graphics; no pin on a phone.

name: Left headline with a 3D object bleeding off the bottom
description: A pinned stage (100svh, held for about 150svh of scroll) on one flat dark stage (the ink field on a light page, the page ground on a dark one); no texture, no glow. At the left, 7% in, a two-line headline at the display step in the colour that reads on that stage and a two-line sub-line at the lead step low down, 48px above the stage end, about 700px wide. At the right a 3D object (a WebGL model or a rendered transparent video, about 700px) bleeds off the stage's bottom edge only, turning about 60 degrees with the scroll and bobbing 8px. No toast bar, no card over it. Phone: no pin; the headline top-left at the head step, the object below at 80% width cropped by the bottom, the sub-line at the body step between them.
phone: Headline top-left, object at 80% width cropped by the bottom, no pin.
