name: Left-offset thin title with hanging caption
description: Ground = the palette ground. A two-line headline at the display step in the dealt display weight, offset to column 2 (about x 173 at 1440) and about 1094px wide, ink in contrast; a two-line caption at the body step in sentence case hangs near the right at x 1100, aligned with the headline's top line. The section keeps the section gap above and below and never overlaps the section above. It arrives with the dealt entrance. Phone: the headline at the head step in two lines, the caption under it at the body step, left-aligned. Mirrored variant: the headline right-aligned in a 1080px column, with a sub line at the sub step dropped 86px lower at the column's left.
phone: Two-line headline at the head step, caption under it.
houseRuleCheck: Captions are 16px sentence case, never tiny labels; the section keeps the section gap and never overlaps the one above.

name: Narrow justified statement
description: The palette ground or the surface tone, flat, no gradient. A statement of about 20 words at the sub step in the body or display face in the dealt case, justified over three lines in an 864px column (60% of the width) centred in the container; ink in contrast to the ground, one colour. Line breaks are set by hand and the tracking is tuned per line so the word gaps stay even. The section keeps the section gap above and below and no more, and arrives with the dealt entrance. No caption and no pictograms in the lines. Phone: the lead step, four lines, left-aligned with a ragged right edge.
phone: Lead step, four lines, left-aligned with a ragged right edge.
houseRuleCheck: No caption and no pictograms in the lines; one flat ground, no gradient; line breaks and tracking set by hand.

name: Object unwraps behind a sliding headline
description: A pinned stage (100svh, about 250svh of scroll) on one flat palette colour. Stage 1: a two-word headline at the display step in the display face enters from the right and slides to centre, passing behind a product cut-out centred at about 520px tall (the headline sits under the object). Stage 2: the product's wrapping, two or four transparent cut-out halves of the packaging, slides apart by 40% of the width, rotates 8-14 degrees and fades so the product comes clear. Stage 3: one portrait picture (about 420x560, the dealt corner) fades in at centre while the headline slides to the top left and shrinks to a one-line headline at the sub step a page margin from the left. Scroll scrubs 1:1 with smoothing (lerp 0.08). Phone: headline at the head step, product 60% wide, portrait 70% wide, the same three stages in 200svh.
phone: Headline at the head step, 60% product, 70% portrait, three stages in 200svh.
houseRuleCheck: The packaging halves are real cut-outs, never drawn; the headline passes behind the object and is never broken; the portrait is a modern picture, never documentary.

name: Panning picture under rising cell text
description: A pinned stage (100svh over about 200svh of scroll) holding one large full-bleed picture (a painting, a render or a toned photograph with quiet, even tones, never a drawn illustration) oversized to 130% that pans diagonally with the scroll. Three short statements, each a headline of two lines at most at the display step (h2 or h3), land in different cells of an invisible 3x3 grid in turn: first top-left, then centre, last bottom-right; each holds, then lifts out as the next lands (scroll-linked). Ink or ground-colour type that holds 4.5:1 on the part of the picture beneath it (picture value range within 25%); no lines, no figure, no boxes, no overlay. Phone: a single column of cells (top, middle, bottom) at the head step, the picture at 150% height.
phone: Single column of cells at the head step, picture at 150% height.
houseRuleCheck: No grid lines, figure, boxes or overlay; the grid is invisible; each statement is two lines at most at the display step and holds 4.5:1 on the part of the picture beneath it.

name: 3D scene stage, text trading places
description: A pinned 3D stage of three scenes, about 2.5 screens of scroll in all. In each, an abstract 3D object (a rendered sphere, ring or knot, 330-860px, in one hue) and a headline of two lines at most in the display step with a one-line sub in the lead step trade places: text left with the object at the upper right; text bottom-left under the object; text right beside it. The swap takes 700ms and the two never overlap at rest. No tag or label above the headline. Ink or the palette's light tone on the ground by contrast; one accent hue in the object.
phone: The object on top at 45vh, the text under it; the swap becomes a 400ms crossfade.
houseRuleCheck: The object is a rendered 3D form, not particles, drawn icons or hearts. No tag above the statement.

name: Headline swap beside the product interface
description: A pinned stage of about 200svh on one flat dark stage (the ink field on a light page, the page ground on a dark one). The product's own interface (a crop of it, data-ui, about 520x640, no device frame, no bezel, no browser dots) stands at the right, its rows changing as the headline swaps. Beside it, in a 496px column at the left: a first two-line headline at the head step in the colour that reads on that stage with one line at the lead step; as the scroll runs it fades out (opacity only, no blur, no echo copy) while a row of the interface slides up and out, and a second two-line headline with its own line fades in and stays. Scroll scrubbing is smoothed. Phone: no pin, the interface at 80% width on top, the two headlines one after the other under it.
phone: No pin: interface on top, the two headlines under it.
houseRuleCheck: The product's own interface (data-ui), never a device frame, bezel or browser dots; the headlines swap by opacity only, with no blur or echo copy.

name: Pinned video, paragraph visiting corners
description: A pinned stage over a full-bleed muted looping video, three scenes of about 70vh of scroll each (about 2 screens in all). A paragraph of at most 14 words in the lead step, three lines at most and 448px wide, visits a different cell of a 3-column grid in each scene (bottom right, top left, top right), inside the page margins. It crossfades out before it moves and in after. In the palette's light tone; no accent. The paragraph sits straight on the video's calm part with no box (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only).
phone: The paragraph pinned at the bottom inside the page margins; the video cropped vertical; no corner moves, only a crossfade.
houseRuleCheck: The footage is designed or generated, never documentary.

name: Quote beside a character-fill statement
description: A panel across the container (the surface tone or the ink field, flat, the dealt corner) as the section's ground, the section gap above and below. Two columns at 4/8 with a 48px gutter. Left: one short testimonial, a three-line quote at the lead step with the name and role under it at the body step; no avatar, no arrows, no counter, no rotation. Right: one statement of 8-10 words, two lines at the display step in the colour that reads on the panel, whose characters fill from 20% to full strength as it scrolls through the viewport (scroll-linked; full ink for reduced motion). Phone: the statement first at the head step, the quote under it.
phone: Statement first at the head step, the quote under it.
houseRuleCheck: One quote, no avatar, arrows, counter or progress line; the statement is at full strength at rest and with reduced motion.

name: Right-aligned statement with a flying figure
description: A pinned stage (100svh over about 200svh of scroll) on one flat palette colour (the surface tone or a field colour). A 3D figure (a rendered model, a WebGL model or an alpha video) sweeps through the left and centre of the stage in an arc over the scroll. Three statements, each a headline of two lines at the head step in one face and one colour, are right-aligned at the right margin and step in turn with the figure's pass: each blurs in (8px to 0) as the scroll reaches it, holds, and blurs out as the next arrives (scroll-linked). Phone: still pinned, the statement at the head step right-aligned in the lower half, the figure passing in the upper half at 60% scale.
phone: Statement in the lower half, figure in the upper half at 60%.
houseRuleCheck: One face and one colour, no accent word; each statement two lines at most; the figure is rendered, never drawn.

name: Scattered words converging
description: Pinned for about 150svh on the palette ground. A three-word headline at the display step in the display face, ink: the words start on a descending staircase (each 120px lower and 120px further right than the one before) and, scrubbed by scroll, converge into one centred line about 1000px wide, settling with a 6px overshoot. 120px under it a centred two-line paragraph at the lead step, 760px wide, is there from the first frame. Phone: the three words converge from a stack into two lines at the head step, the paragraph at the body step.
phone: Three words converge from a stack into two lines, paragraph at the body step.
houseRuleCheck: Three words that end on one line; the paragraph is two lines and there from the first frame.

name: Scroll-lit statement over pinned video
description: A muted looping video held behind (100svh, about 200svh of scroll); choose footage that is dark and even in tone (value range within 25%) so light type holds 4.5:1 with no overlay. Two statements of 6-8 words each, set as headlines of two lines at the display step in light ink, scroll over it in a 900px column at columns 3-10, 120px apart. Word colour follows scroll: unread words at 35% opacity, read words at full light ink; at the end every word is full ink. No accent colour on the words. Phone: statements at full container width at the head step, two lines each, the same word fill.
phone: Two lines each at the head step, same word fill.
houseRuleCheck: No overlay: the footage is dark and even where the words sit; unread words are dimmed, never accented; every word is at full colour at rest.

name: Serif statement with an overflowing image stack
description: A one-screen box on the ink field (letters in the ground colour; flat, at least 720px tall, the dealt corner) with a two-line statement at the display step in the dealt display face in the box's letter colour, starting at column 2. On the right a stack of two pictures: a tall 331x693 one at x 976 and a larger one (about 300x420) at x 648 layered behind it, overflowing the box's top and bottom by about 20% (the box does not clip them); the pictures drift at 0.15x and 0.3x (scroll-linked). The section gap above and below makes room for the overflow; no text sits on the pictures. Phone: the statement on top at the head step, the pictures as an overlapped pair at 4:5 under it, overflow 12%.
phone: Statement on top, an overlapped pair of pictures under it.
houseRuleCheck: No text on the pictures; the box is one flat fill; the pictures overflow it on purpose and drift slowly.

name: Small centred statement in a painted sky
description: A pinned scene of about two screens. A soft sky picture fills the screen (a photograph or a rendered plate, not a CSS gradient) with one cut-out figure or object, 400 tall, crossing slowly from left to right over 1.5 screens of scroll. In the middle, a two-line centred headline at 40px in one typeface and one weight, with no italic or colour on any single word, 10 to 14 words, on the picture's calm part; it stands there once the figure has passed the centre (the dealt entrance decides arrival, no per-letter blur or scale), holds, then the pin releases. No glyph above. Phone: figure 240 tall, headline 28px.
phone: Figure 240 tall, headline 28px.
houseRuleCheck: The italic serif word and the small glyph are dropped (accent word). Any sun ring lives inside the sky picture, never a drawn shape. The per-character blur-in is dropped (no word split into flying letters; dealt entrance). The figure is a cut-out photograph, never a drawn illustration.

name: Heading left, paragraph and button right
description: Ground = the palette ground. A 12-column grid in the container: a two-line heading at the sub step in the display face at columns 1-4 (ink); at columns 6-10 a paragraph of two to three lines at the lead step in the body face at 80% ink and, 32px below it, the dealt button. The section gap above and below. A quiet connective section between two loud ones: it arrives with the dealt entrance and nothing else moves. Phone: the heading, then the paragraph, then the dealt button full width, 20px gaps.
phone: Heading, paragraph, full-width dealt button, 20px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: A paragraph of three lines at most and the dealt button; nothing else moves.

name: Stacked headline with the last word rising right
description: Ground = the palette ground, ink in contrast. A four-word headline at the display step in the dealt display weight on two lines: line one holds words 1-2 flush left at the margin; line two holds word 3 flush left and word 4 right-aligned to the container's right margin. Word 4 rises about 120px into place over about 80svh of scroll (scroll-linked, translateY 120 to 0) so it arrives last. Under word 3 at the left, 32px below the headline, a paragraph at the lead step 360px wide in three or four lines and, 32px under it, the dealt button, so no row is empty at the left. Phone: the headline in two lines at the head step with the last word right-aligned, the paragraph and the full-width dealt button under it.
phone: Two-line headline, last word right-aligned, full-width button under the paragraph.
houseRuleCheck: The words stay inside the page margins; the last word is the same style as the rest, never an accent word; the paragraph fills the left of the second row, so no row is empty on the left.

name: Tall picture beside a centred statement
description: Ground = the palette ground; as tall as its content (about 110svh). Left half: a tall picture 639x1040 at 1440 (ratio 0.61) in the dealt corner, a page margin in, with parallax inside its frame (the picture is 115% and travels about 8% over the scroll). Right half: a centred two-line statement of 8-10 words at the sub step in the display face, ink, at the vertical middle of the column, with one body-step sentence under it; nothing above it. It arrives with the dealt entrance. Phone: the picture at 4:5 full width on top, the statement under it centred at the lead step.
phone: Picture 4:5 full width on top, centred statement under it.
houseRuleCheck: No caption on the picture; the picture keeps the page margin and the dealt corner.

name: Two-line display over exit row
description: A page-ground section inside the page margins with the dealt section gap above. A two-line display statement at the display step (6 to 9 words), set from the left margin and spanning 60 to 94% of the width, in the ink with tight tracking. 48px below it, one exit row on the 12-column grid: a three-line 18px paragraph at column 5 (about 400 wide) and the dealt button at columns 8 to 9. No rule between statement and row; the gap is the separation. Phone: statement 40px, the paragraph and the button stacked below at 24px margins.
phone: Statement 40px, paragraph and button stacked at 24px margins.
houseRuleCheck: The full-width rule under the statement is dropped (thin rule). The 18px paragraph stays; the pill link is the dealt button; the statement is two lines at the display step (it was 112px); the line rise is the dealt entrance.

name: Wide statement over a text-and-clip card
description: Ground = the palette ground. A two-line statement at the head step left-aligned in the container, ink. 126px below, a centred filled card about 932x270 (surface tone, the dealt corner) split in half: on one side a three-line paragraph at the body step in 32px padding and the dealt second action that opens the clip large in a modal, on the other a landscape clip about 440x250 (muted autoplay loop) that runs to the card's edges with no frame of its own and opens the same modal on click. The card is the only box in the section. Phone: the statement at the sub step; the card full width with the clip on top at 16:9 and the paragraph under it.
phone: Clip on top at 16:9, paragraph under it.
houseRuleCheck: The card is the only box in the section; the clip runs to the card's edges with no frame of its own; the paragraph is 16px or more.

name: Colour card with value rows and a rising cut-out
description: Ground = the palette ground. A two-line headline at the head step left-aligned above the card on the ground (never inside it). Below, one card about 1344x600 (the ink field with letters in the ground colour, or the surface tone; the dealt corner) centred. Inside it three stat rows, each a full-sentence label at the lead step at the left and the figure with its unit at the display step in the display face right-aligned, rows 120px apart with no lines between; each figure stands in the line that says what it counts. A cut-out figure about 330px (a person or object on a transparent ground) rises from below over the card's bottom edge to overlap it by 80px (scroll-linked, about 120px of travel). Phone: the card full container width, rows stacked label over value (value at the head step), the cut-out at the bottom right at 40% width overlapping the edge by 40px.
phone: Rows stacked label over value, cut-out bottom right.
houseRuleCheck: Each figure stands in the line that says what it counts, never over a one-word label; the headline stands on the ground, never in the card; the card keeps the page margins.

name: Figure rows with copy at right
description: Ground = the ink field with letters in the ground colour (on a dark page the page ground with ink letters), flat, no gradient. Three rows 200px apart, each a figure with the noun it counts on one line at the display step in the display face, starting at the page margin; at the right (about x 1035, 330px wide) one paragraph of about 12 words at the lead step aligned to the top of the row. No lines between rows. The rows are there at once (the dealt entrance decides any arrival). Phone: the figure line at the head step, the paragraph under it at the body step, rows 140px apart.
phone: Figure line at the head step, paragraph under it, rows 140px apart.
houseRuleCheck: No lines between rows and no gradient; each figure stands in the line with the noun it counts.

name: Four numerals over a landscape
description: Ground = the palette ground, the section gap above. Four equal columns in the container (336px pitch at 1440): each a figure at the display step in the dealt display face, centred (figure plus unit), over a two-line sentence-case caption at the body step that says what the figure counts. 120px lower a picture (a landscape or a place tied to the subject, in the dealt grade, not a documentary photograph) fills the rest of the section as an inset band 1344px wide and 560px tall in the dealt corner, a page margin in from each side, with a 6% parallax inside the frame. Phone: two columns of two figures at the head step with body-step captions, the picture 4:3 under them.
phone: Two columns of figures at the head step, 4:3 picture under them.
houseRuleCheck: Each figure has a sentence-case caption that says what it counts; the picture sits inside the margins with the dealt corner and is never documentary.

name: Marquee of stat chips
description: A single marquee row on the ground, the section gap above and below, no rule and no label over it. The row is 88px tall, masked a page margin in from the container ends, moving left at 40px/s on a loop and pausing on hover. Each unit is a filled chip (the one surface tone, the dealt corner, 14px 28px padding) holding a figure at the sub step in the display face and a short phrase at the body step saying what it counts, with a 40px gap between chips; six to eight real stats, duplicated for a seamless loop. All chips in the one fill, none in the accent. Reduced motion: the row stops and wraps to two lines. Phone: the same row at 30px/s, the figure at the lead step.
phone: Same loop at 30px/s, figure at the lead step.

name: Rotated numeral beside image panels
description: No pin. Ground = the palette ground, ink in contrast. Left: a three-character figure turned -90 degrees (reading bottom to top), about 184x547, in the dealt display face (a measured number from the content, with a unit if there is one), in ink. Centre: a 618x600 portrait picture panel in the dealt corner. Right column about 330px wide split in two: a short sentence at the lead step at the top and under it a 324x306 close-up picture panel in the dealt corner. The centre picture slowly scales from 1.05 to 1 over the scroll (scroll-linked, inside its frame); everything else is there at once. No ruled lines, ticks or notches. Phone: the figure horizontal at the head step on top, then the centre picture at 4:5, the close-up, and the sentence last.
phone: Numeral horizontal on top, then pictures, sentence last.
houseRuleCheck: No ruled lines, ticks or notches; the numeral is a measured figure from the content, never numbering.

name: Text left, offset number tile columns
description: Page ground. Left, a narrow text block at the page margin, top-aligned with the tile field: a body-size paragraph about 280px wide, three lines at most, and one text link under it. Right, four filled tiles 288x360 in two columns of two (columns at x 640 and 944, 16px gaps, the dealt corner), all in the dealt card style on the surface tone, with no border and no second fill. Each tile holds one figure at the display step in the ink at top-left and, at bottom-left, a body-size line saying what the figure counts, as a phrase of four to eight words (never a one-word label). The second column starts 26px lower and drifts about 40px upward against the scroll, so the two columns slip past each other (transform only; still for reduced motion). Hover is the dealt card hover. Phone: text first, tiles in one column at full width, 200px tall, no drift.
phone: Single column of full-width tiles, text block above, no drift.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Tiles are solid fills, never outlined, with no shadow at rest. Figures are real statistics set with the line that says what they count: not 01/02/03 numbering and not a band of one-word labels.

name: Ticker strip over three-column data
description: Page ground. Top: a 76px-high strip on the surface tone (no rules above or below) where a title in the display face at the sub step repeats with 80px of space between repeats (no glyph) and glides sideways (about 40s per loop, slower on hover; still for reduced motion). 120px below, three columns in the 1296px container. Left: a body-size sentence-case label in muted ink, a two-line figure or date at the display step, a body-size subhead and two data rows (56px high, 16px text, label left, value right, on the surface tone). Centre: a 420x520 photograph in the dealt corner, in the page's one grade. Right: four label-over-value pairs (a 16px muted label over a value at the sub step) 32px apart, then two data rows like the left. Rows are separated by space, never by lines. Phone: the strip stays at 56px high with the title at the lead step; columns stack, the photograph second at 4:5.
phone: Strip kept at 56px high; the three columns stack with the photograph between the date and the data pairs.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The strip is a tone change and rows are tinted bars separated by space: no rules. Labels are sentence case at 16px, never tiny capitals. The picture is a real photograph in the one grade, never a halftone or dithered render.

name: Tilting stat cards beside pinned heading
description: Page ground, about two screens tall (as tall as the cards need). Left column held at the page margin with position: sticky: a headline at the head step on two lines (plain, no underline or highlight on any word) and a body-size paragraph 300px wide. Right, from x 908, three 424x550 cards stacked down the column 24px apart, in the dealt card style on the surface tone (the dealt corner), each with one figure at the display step in the ink and, under it, a body-size line saying what the figure counts, as a phrase of four to ten words; no pill, label or icon. The cards are in place from the first frame, each tilted about 6 degrees to alternate sides; as each crosses the middle of the screen it straightens to flat (scrubbed with scroll, transform only; still for reduced motion). Phone: heading not held; cards stack at full width with 16px gaps and a 3 degree tilt that straightens as each crosses the middle.
phone: Heading not held; cards stacked, a small tilt straightens as each passes the middle.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No wavy underline or highlighted word in the headline; no pill on the cards; figures are statistics set with the line that says what they count, not counters or numbering. The hold is the section only, two screens at most.

name: Two-pane price board
description: Ground = the palette ground. One row about 520px tall of two filled panes with a 12px gap and no rules, both in the one surface tone and the dealt corner. Left pane (5 columns): 40px padding, a two-line title at the sub step at the top and the dealt button at the bottom. Right pane (7 columns): a top row (name at the left, type at the right, at the lead step), a centred price at the display step in the display face with its unit at the lead step, and along the bottom a row of four label-over-value pairs (label at the body step in muted ink, value at the lead step). The price is shown at once (the dealt entrance decides any arrival). Phone: the panes stack with the left pane first, the price at the display step, the four pairs as a 2x2 grid.
phone: Panes stacked, price at the display step, pairs as a 2x2 grid.
houseRuleCheck: Two filled panes with a gap, never hairlines; the button is the dealt button; real prices.

name: Wheel-stepped chapter slider
description: Three chapters in one sticky stage of about 2.5 screens, each stepped by native scroll (never a hijacked wheel; arrow keys and a swipe also step). A chapter fills the stage in the ground or the surface tone and the ground turns between the two over 600ms. On one side, inside the page margins: a sentence-case line in the lead step, a one-line title in the display step and the dealt button. On the other a large crop of a photograph or an object, about 40% of the width, in the dealt corner, so neither half stands empty. The content slides 80px and fades while the ground turns. A step advances at most about every 2.6s.
phone: One chapter per screen, a swipe steps, the crop on top at 70vw and the title under it in the display step.
houseRuleCheck: No caps label or numerals, no ring or stroke round the crop, nothing runs off the screen edge. Two tones only, so no colour sprawl.

name: Stepped headline over photo, with proof row
description: Two parts. First, a full-bleed photograph (touching both side edges, 100svh tall, the image 120% tall) that drifts up to 100px against the scroll. On its calm part, in one tone, a two-line headline at the display step in the heavy weight, sentence case: the second line starts 20% of the width to the right of the first and slides about 120px sideways with the scroll (transform only; still for reduced motion). The dealt button sits under the headline. No box, fade or tint over the photograph. Second, on the page ground and never on the picture, a proof row: three filled stat cards in the dealt card style (300px wide, a figure at the sub step over a body-size line saying what it counts) and, under them, a centred quote at the sub step on three lines at most, with a plain name. Phone: headline at the head step, stat cards stacked, parallax halved.
phone: Headline at the head step, proof cards stacked, parallax halved.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Two lines, in the dealt face and sentence case: no condensed capitals. The photograph is art-directed, never an archive or documentary picture. No award badges or credit wall in the proof row; no boxes on the photograph.

name: Sticky chapter cover under inset panels
description: One chapter. A full-screen photograph is held sticky for about 2.5 screens of scroll. It grows from scale 0.9 to 1 as it arrives while the previous section dims (brightness 0.6). Two short lines in the lead step sit at mid-height, one 140px in from each side, in the palette's light tone on the picture's calm part. Two panels then scroll up over the cover one after another: each is a full-width section on the ground with a straight top edge and the page-margin padding, holding a title in the head step (two lines at most), a paragraph of three lines at most in the body step and one picture in the dealt corner on a 12-column grid, set straight on the panel with no box inside it. The cover is visible only above the first panel and in the gap between them, and releases after the last.
phone: Cover at 100svh stays sticky; panels at the page margins; the two lines move to the bottom of the cover.
houseRuleCheck: The panels are page sections that scroll over the cover, not cards laid on a photograph, and the cover carries no box. No bracketed labels. Photographs are designed, not archive material.

name: Sticky heading with list and offer cards
description: On the dealt ground, no photograph. Two columns inside the page margins. Left (500px): a headline at the head step (two lines) and a three-line paragraph at the body step, sticky 96px from the top so it stays beside the list while the right side passes. Right (700px): three item cards 700x220 on the surface tone with the dealt corner, each with a title at the sub step (two lines) and two lines of text at the body step; then two offer cards 700x96 on the surface tone, each with a title at the lead step and the dealt button. The section is as tall as the right column. Cards are there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: the heading on top and static, items and offers stacked.
phone: Heading on top, static; items and offers stacked.
houseRuleCheck: The drifting parallax column is now sticky; the second 52px heading above the list is dropped (restated heading); offer cards sit on the surface tone with the dealt button instead of accent fills; the serif face is out; no cards over a painted photograph.

name: Sticky notched media beside text steps
description: On the ground, a media frame (a picture or a product screen) of about 695x830 in the dealt corner sits at the right and stays sticky for three steps of about 60vh. In the left column (about 426px) three text items sit 555px apart: a title in the sub step over a paragraph of three lines at most in the body step. Unread text is in the muted tone and darkens to ink as it crosses mid-screen, and the frame crossfades to each item's picture. Everything stays inside the page margins. Variants: the text swaps in place while the picture wipes upward to the next (clip-path 100% to 0 over 700ms) under a centred heading in the head step; or a sticky picture fills the right half (inset by the page margin) while three one-line steps dim to the muted tone when inactive. No line, notch, marker or progress of any kind.
phone: The frame becomes a sticky 16:10 strip at the top at full width inside the page margins; the text scrolls under it.
houseRuleCheck: Every edge of the frame is straight: no notch cut. No line, marker or progress.

name: Sticky name bar over tall bent photo
description: A product photograph across the page margins, ratio about 0.9 (about 1296x1440 at 1440), drawn as a segmented WebGL plane that bends with scroll speed (it skews up to 6 degrees with the scroll direction and eases back; a flat image is the fallback). Its top edge carries a bar in the ink, tall enough for one line, holding the product name centred in the head step in the ground colour; the bar sticks at the viewport top while the photograph passes under it. The dealt button sits centred on the bottom edge of the photograph, half over and half under. The product's three facts go as one plain centred line in the body step under the photograph, never as chips on it. The dealt section gap follows.
phone: Photo at full width inside the page margins (4:5), the bar 48px, the button at full width.
houseRuleCheck: No tag chips on the photograph (boxes on a photograph). The name bar is a header strip belonging to the section, not a card laid on the picture. Name in sentence case.

name: Sticky notched panel stack with alternating tilt
description: Three wide panels, about 1240px wide inside the page margins, on the surface tone in the dealt corner with the dealt padding. Each holds a 518x575 photograph at the left and, at the right, a title in the head step (two lines at most) and a paragraph of two lines at most in the body step, set straight on the panel with no box inside it. The panels stack sticky, each offset 68px sideways; when the next arrives the earlier panel sinks, dims and tilts about 2 degrees, alternately left and right, and the panel being read is always flat. Three panels of about 60vh each (under three screens in all).
phone: Panels at the page margins without tilt, the photograph on top, the text below; they still stack.
houseRuleCheck: Every panel edge is straight: no notches. A stack of panels is a page of boxes if nothing else sits around it, so use it as one section only. No icons and no bullet list.

name: Sticky stage with expanding list and round video
description: A stage held with position: sticky for about two screens of scroll on the page ground, with page-margin padding, laid out as a space-between column 100svh tall. Top: a two-line title at the head step in sentence case and the dealt button. Bottom left: three list items; inactive ones sit in the muted ink, the active one grows into a sub-step title plus a body-size description at full ink, and the active item advances with scroll. At right a 600x700 media tile in the dealt corner, fully inside the page margins, cross-fades per item (a picture each, 0.5s). No fill bar or rule beside the list: the active state is shown by ink and growth only. Phone: media full width above the list, title at the sub step, items stacked, one expanded at a time.
phone: Media full width above a stacked list, one item expanded at a time.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The media is a rectangle in the dealt corner, not a disc, and sits inside both margins. No fill bar, rule or counter beside the list. Hold of two screens at most.

name: Sticky tabs over a heading
description: Page ground. A row of three tabs held at the top of the viewport (below the navigation if that is fixed there): 16px sentence-case labels, 56px high, in one filled segment in the dealt button's corner, the active one a solid ink fill with ground-coloured text. Under it, for each tab, a centred two-line heading at the display step in the heavy weight (sentence case, leading 0.9), then an asymmetric spread: a tall 664x890 photograph in columns 1 to 6, a body-size paragraph in columns 10 to 12 and, lower in 10 to 12, a 320x400 photograph. Switching tabs swaps the heading lines with a 0.5s clip reveal and cross-fades both photographs. The tabs hold views of one thing (collections, seasons), never the page's key facts. Phone: the tabs become a full-width segmented control held at the top, heading at the head step, photographs stacked full width, paragraph beneath.
phone: Tabs as a full-width segmented control held on top; heading and photographs stacked.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The active tab is a filled segment, never an underline; no numbering on tabs; the heading is two lines in the dealt face, no condensed capitals. Photographs are styled and modern, never documentary.

name: Tabbed panel beside a 3D object
description: Page ground. Centred near the top, a headline at the sub step on two lines. Right, a 3D object about 520px tall on a canvas (a slow turn and a gentle tilt that follows the pointer; CSS 3D or a small WebGL scene from a real model). Left of centre, a solid 600x300 card on the surface tone in the dealt corner: a row of four tabs (16px sentence case, the active one a solid ink fill), a body-size text and a small-size caption below, and the dealt button full width under the card. Switching tabs fades the text in 0.3s and turns the object to a matching angle or material. Nothing sits behind the card but the ground. Phone: headline, 280px object, then the card and the button at full width, tabs wrapping to two rows.
phone: Object on top at 280px, card and button full width beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The card is a solid fill: no blur, no hairline, no photograph behind it, no tag above it, no card inside the card. Tabs are plain sentence case at 16px. The object is a real model, never a drawn one.

name: Tabbed chip row beside text over a scene
description: Page ground. Left, at the page margin: a headline at the head step on two lines, a body-size paragraph of three lines at most and the dealt button. Right column from x 780: three tabs (16px sentence case, in the dealt button's corner, the active one a solid ink fill), a body-size intro line, then a wrap of five to seven chips on the surface tone (48px tall, a body-size name in each, 12px apart), each chip a real link or filter. No glyph in a chip. Switching tabs swaps the chips with a short fade (200ms). Phone: heading and paragraph first, tabs as a full-width segmented control, chips wrapping in rows.
phone: Heading first, tabs as a segmented control, chips wrapping in rows.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No outlined icon circles and no underlined tabs; chips are named fills with no glyph and each does something (a link or a filter). The button is the dealt one, not a round button of its own. Nothing sits behind it but the page ground.

name: Tabbed expanding card row
description: Page ground. A centred headline at the head step on two lines over a body-size paragraph of three lines at most (no label above). Then a card row 640px tall in the 1296px container with nothing cut by an edge: the active card about 678px wide holds a photograph over its top 65% and, on its card fill below, a sub-step title, a body-size two-line paragraph and the dealt button at bottom-left. Three collapsed cards about 190px wide stand beside it on the surface tone, each with a small photograph and a body-size title; gaps 16px. The collapsed cards are the controls (click, tap or keyboard focus): the chosen one takes the active width (0.6s ease) and its paragraph fades in at the end. No separate tab row and no arrows. Phone: only the active card at full width (4:5); the other three become a row of small titles above it.
phone: One full-width card at a time, the other three as a row of titles above it.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The row sits inside the container with nothing cut by an edge. Words sit on the card fill beneath the photograph, never on it, so nothing is laid over a picture. One card style, filled, no outline.

name: Tall colour panel beside a wide photo
description: A section on the page ground. A centred 56px two-line headline, then 72px below two panels 20px apart, both 640 tall inside the page margins: at the left a 380-wide panel in one flat palette colour (ink on it at 4.5:1 or better) with the dealt corner, holding a 28px two-line caption near the top and the dealt button at its foot; at the right an 880-wide photograph with the dealt corner. No icon in the panel. Heading, panel and photograph are simply there (the dealt entrance decides arrival). Phone: the colour panel full width (360 tall), the photograph 4:5 under it.
phone: Colour panel full width 360 tall, photograph 4:5 under it.
houseRuleCheck: The arch shape (a second corner radius) became the dealt corner; the icon is dropped (no icon-topped card); the headline is two lines; the filled pill is the dealt button; the scroll rise and the photo scale are the dealt entrance.

name: Tall photo beside tile pair with void
description: Two equal halves inside the page margins, about 1.1 screens tall. The left half is one portrait picture 696 by 880 (the dealt corner) with a 40px title, one 17px line and the dealt button over its lower part in the light ink; that part must be a calm, dark part of the photograph (no tint, no gradient, no box); no label. The right half holds two product tiles 340 by 430 (the dealt corner), 16px apart, in its top row only, and the area under them, about 360 tall, is left empty on purpose. The picture is always on the left and the void always lower right; a second instance does not mirror. The tiles are pictures on the ground and arrive with the dealt entrance. Phone: picture 4:5 with its text, tiles in two columns below at 12px gap, void dropped.
phone: Picture 4:5 with its text, tiles in two columns below, void dropped.
houseRuleCheck: The picture is inset by the page margin instead of flush with the edge. The 25% tint is dropped (nothing laid over a picture), so the title needs a calm part. The void is cut from 440 to 360 (a blank stretch over half a screen fails) and is never on the left. The tile rise is the dealt entrance and corners are the dealt corner.

name: Tall index rows without images
description: Page ground. A body-size bold title at the left margin, then four wide filled cards in the 1296px container (each as tall as its content, about 200px, 16px apart, the dealt corner), all in the dealt card style on the surface tone, no rules, no index numbers, no pictures. Each card has two lines of content. Top line: a body-size label at left and a right-aligned two-line list at 16px. Bottom line: a project name at the head step at left and a right-aligned two-line list at 16px. Hover is the dealt card hover. Phone: cards 260px tall at most, the lists collapse to two lines beneath the name.
phone: Cards 260px tall at most, lists shortened under the name.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Cards are one fill separated by space, never ruled rows; no index numbers; the name stands at the left of each card so no row is empty on the left. Keep to four cards so the page is not only boxes.

name: Centred headline over portrait row
description: Page ground. A centred two-line headline at the head step, 860px wide, about 120px below the section top. 100px below it, a row of five 240x340 portrait tiles (studio portraits on one plain ground, the dealt corner), centred in the 1296px container, 24px apart, nothing cropped by an edge. Under each tile the name in body size and the role at the small step. A hovered tile lifts 8px (no shadow). Phone: portraits in two columns with the name under each.
phone: Two columns of portraits with names beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. All five tiles sit inside the margins and nothing is draggable or scrolls sideways. Portraits are staged studio pictures in the one grade, never documentary. No custom cursor: names sit under the tiles.

name: Photo band, centred headline, three columns
description: Page ground. A full-bleed staged group photograph across the top 568px, touching both side edges. 120px below it, a centred two-line headline at the head step, then three text columns (body size, two lines each, 380px wide, 48px apart) inside the page margins. The section ends at the last line plus the section gap: no band and no figure behind the columns. Phone: photograph 320px tall, headline at the sub step, columns stacked.
phone: Photograph 320px tall, columns stacked.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The group photograph is staged and modern, never documentary. No cut-out is laid over the text, no accent band closes the section and nothing scales on entry (the dealt entrance decides). Column text stays at two lines.

name: Two offset flip cards in tall scene
description: A section about 200vh tall on the page ground. A left column held with position: sticky at the page margin, 380px wide: a headline at the head step on two lines and a body-size paragraph of two lines. Two 320x440 cards in the dealt corner at x 560 and x 1000, the second 80px lower. Each front, on the surface tone, holds a portrait photograph across its top 60% (running to the card's edges), a sub-step name under it, a body-size line and two text links. As the section scrolls both cards flip in 3D (rotateY 0 to 180 degrees, scrubbed with scroll, back faces hidden) to a back on the ink field with a short two-line bio and the dealt button. Phone: the cards stack and each flips when it reaches the middle of the screen. Reduced motion: both fronts shown, backs below them.
phone: Cards stacked, each flips at the middle of the screen.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Faces carry a real portrait photograph, never a drawn figure; the name is plain text, not a pill; links are text, not emoji. The cards are the only boxes: the headline stays on the page ground. Hold of two screens at most.

name: Centred header, landscape tile pager
description: Page ground. A centred header: a headline at the sub step on two lines, a body-size two-line subline 280px wide, and two text links with typeset arrows (Previous, Next; 44px targets) centred beneath. Below, a pager of landscape cards 636x424 (the dealt corner), two visible at a time inside the 1296px container with a 24px gap. Each card is filled in the dealt card style: a portrait photograph across its upper 65%, running to the card's edges, and on the fill beneath it a body-size two-line quote and a name. The links move one card (0.6s ease) and the keyboard arrows work; no dragging, no counter and no card cut by an edge. Phone: One card at a time at 4:3 with the two links under it.
phone: One card at a time at 4:3 with the two links under it.
houseRuleCheck: Paging by two text links (no second button shape) with two whole cards visible. The quote sits on the card fill, never on the photograph. One card style, filled, no outline; real quotes and names.

name: Quote cards passing over pinned split heading
description: Page ground, about two screens tall. A two-line headline at the display step is held at the top of the screen with position: sticky on an opaque band of the page ground: line one at the left margin, line two indented to about 60% of the width, so it reads as a diagonal split. Three quote cards 549px wide (the dealt card style on the surface tone, the dealt corner) rise past beneath the band, a little faster than the scroll (1.2x), at staggered x positions alternating left and right, and pass under the band so they never cover the headline. Each card holds a quote of 20 words or fewer at the lead step and, below it, a name and a role in body size; no photograph and no second card. Phone: headline at the head step on two lines, not held, cards stacked at full width.
phone: Not held; heading above, quote cards stacked.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No avatars and no ring: the author is a line inside the quote card, not a second card. Cards pass under an opaque band so the headline is always readable. Each quote 20 words or fewer.

name: Portrait row, big quote, photo right
description: A full-bleed panel about 600px tall on the surface tone (or the ink field with ground-coloured text), all its text in one colour. Left, inside the page margin: a quote at the head step on two lines at most (14 words or fewer), the speaker's name and role in body size under it, a body-size line of about 20 words, and a text link with an arrow. Right, a 559x583 photograph in the dealt corner, inside the page margin, with a caption under it on the panel colour only if it says something the visitor needs. Phone: the quote at the sub step first, then the name, the line and the photograph at full width.
phone: Single column: quote, name and line, then the photograph.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The panel is one solid colour, with no accent ground under text. The paragraph is held to about 20 words and any caption sits on the panel, never on the photograph.

name: Title over three quote cards
description: Page ground. A headline of two or three words at the display step at the left margin, in sentence case. 64px below it, three equal cards 424px wide with 16px gutters in the dealt card style (the surface tone, the dealt corner), each with a quote of 14 to 22 words at the lead step and, 32px lower inside the card, the name and role in body size. All three are visible at once. Phone: headline at the head step, cards stacked at full width.
phone: Cards stacked at full width under the headline.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Open ruled columns become filled cards of one tone; no curly-quote marks drawn as ornaments; nothing moves on entry (the dealt entrance decides).

name: Text beside a spot visual, alternating rows
description: Three rows, 530-720px tall, in a centred container of about 988px. On one side a text block 440-480px wide, vertically centred: a headline of one or two short lines in the head step in ink, a paragraph of two lines at most in the body step and, on the last row only, the dealt button. On the other side a 330px visual: a crop of the product's interface that fills a tile on the surface tone in the dealt corner and runs to the tile's edges with no frame of its own. The sides alternate from row to row. No dividers; 120px of space between rows.
phone: The visual first at 80vw, the text under it left aligned; rows 80px apart.
houseRuleCheck: The visuals are crops of the product, never drawn illustrations or drawn shapes; a crop in a tile is one box, not a box in a box. Headlines in ink, not a second colour.

name: Input left, cut-out product on the right
description: Page ground, as tall as its content plus the section gap. A 420px text block at x 256, vertically centred: a headline at the sub step on two lines, a body-size three-line paragraph, a small-size note, and one filled email field 54px high (the surface tone, the dealt corner, no outline) with the dealt button beside it, or under it where the dealt button is wide; the form works. No card or panel around the form. On the right a studio cut-out product group about 420px tall starts at x 750 and ends at least 72px from the right edge. Phone: text first, the product 260px beneath, the field full width.
phone: Text and field first, the product 260px beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The cut-out stays inside the margin; the field is a fill, not an outlined box; no strip closes the bottom edge and nothing eases in on entry. It is the page's one email form.

name: Text-photo pair then scroll-driven strip
description: A heading at the head step with a short body-size paragraph at the left and a 560x373 photograph at the right (the dealt corner). Below it, a full-width strip of five photographs (560x320, 30px apart, the dealt corner) that slides sideways with the scroll position as a band crossing both side edges; no captions, no arrows, no dragging, no sideways scrollbar. Scroll maps vertical travel to a 1200px horizontal shift while the strip stays unpinned. Phone: the pair stacks; the strip becomes 280x180 photographs moving at half the shift.
phone: Pair stacked; strip of smaller photographs with a shorter shift.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The strip is scroll-driven only and crosses both edges as a symmetric band: never a drag rail, never a row cut at one edge only. Photographs are styled and modern, each used once, never documentary.

name: Three-row tile marquee, alternating
description: A centred two-line h2 at the head step of up to eight words, then 48px below it three full-width rows, each 96px tall and 16px apart, of filled tiles (80px tall, surface tone, the dealt corner: a 32px real logo or a small crop of a picture at the left and a name at the body step, 20px between tiles). The rows run past both screen edges equally and move with scroll: row one drifts left, row two right, row three left, at about 0.4 of scroll speed; no drag. Use it for integrations, places, ingredients or skills, 24 distinct tiles, never for a client logo wall. Phone: rows 72px tall, speed halved.
phone: Rows 72px tall, names stay at body size, scroll speed halved.
houseRuleCheck: The rows are a deliberate full-bleed band cut equally at both edges and move by scroll, never by drag. Tiles are one surface tone and one shape; marks are the real ones, never drawn. They name integrations, places or topics, not credits.

name: Tile pair, caption inside
description: Two equal near-square picture tiles side by side inside the page margins, about 670px wide each at 1440, a 20px gutter, the dealt corner. Each tile is one photograph filling it; the words sit on the picture's calm part, and, failing a calm part, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only, never over the whole picture. The caption sits 32px in from the bottom left: a headline of two to four words in the head step in the palette's light tone and one plain text link under it (no box). No label, no chips, no pills, no button. Hover: the picture scales to 1.03 inside its crop over 500ms and the link underlines. The dealt section gap above and below the pair. Variant: one wide tile across the page margins, about 684px tall, with the same caption.
phone: Tiles stack at full width inside the page margins, each 4:5, 20px apart; caption 24px in from the bottom left.
houseRuleCheck: No label, chips or pills on the photographs, and the tint is flat, never a gradient. Pictures are designed or generated, never archive photographs.

name: Tilted 3D object row with spec table
description: A held stage 100svh tall that releases after the last step (about two screens of scroll in all): scroll steps a row of four square covers (album or product faces in the dealt corner) tilted about -30 degrees on two axes with CSS 3D and rising to the right. The active cover is about 520px and centred; neighbours sit at 0.8 scale on a 480px pitch, whole and fully inside the frame, none cut by the top edge. A 300px spec card in the dealt card style on the surface tone is fixed at the top left of the stage: a sub-step title in sentence case and four label/value rows as alternating tinted bars 40px high (the ground and the surface tone, 16px label and 16px value, no rules), which change with the active cover. Phone: one cover at 280px, stepped by scroll, the spec card under it.
phone: One cover centred, spec bars beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Spec rows are tinted bars, never ruled lines; labels are sentence case at 16px; every cover is whole inside the frame. Covers are real pictures, never drawn discs. Hold of two screens at most.

name: Tilted bending film strip
description: A rounded panel on the ink field (the dealt corner, inside the page margins) holds a centred title at the head step and a lead-size sub-line. Below, a reel of six photographs about 1296px wide, tilted 8 degrees up to the right and bent into a shallow S with CSS 3D (rounded frames, no sprocket drawing, no dots). The centre frame (556x470) is bright and sharp; neighbours are smaller and dimmer, all whole inside the panel. Two text links with typeset arrows (Previous, Next; 44px targets) at the sides step the reel one frame (0.7s ease). Phone: one centred frame with two neighbours peeking symmetrically at 70% scale, the two links under it.
phone: One central frame with smaller neighbours, the two links beneath.
houseRuleCheck: A solid ink-field ground with no tonal blend; plain rounded frames with no sprocket holes; two text links step it, no dots or counter. Frames are sharp modern photographs in the one grade, never greyed.

name: Tilted card drift over pinned headline
description: A section held for about two screens (four beats of about 500px of scroll) on the page ground. A centred two-line headline at the display step, in the display face, holds for the first beat. Then four portrait photograph cards (480x680, the dealt corner) pass one at a time, scrubbed with the scroll: each comes from the lower right tilted -3 to +10 degrees, crosses the headline diagonally and leaves to the upper left. Only one card is in view at a time: the previous one has gone before the next arrives, so no neighbour is cut by an edge and the headline reads between cards. Reduced motion: the headline above a plain row of the four cards, untilted. Phone: cards 70vw wide, travelling bottom to top with a smaller tilt.
phone: One card at a time rising vertically, smaller tilt.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Plain page ground, no halftone or texture behind it; no label above the headline; photographs are styled, never documentary. The pass is driven by the scroll, not an entrance.

name: Title over full-width row log
description: Page ground. A two-word title at the display step at the left margin and, beside it in column 5, a body-size three-line paragraph, no rule between. Then a log of eight rows (a show-more control reveals the rest) across the 1296px container; rows are zebra bands (the ground and the surface tone alternating, the dealt corner on the first and last), each 72px high, holding 16px text in three columns: a date at x 72, a short entry at x 400 and a longer entry at x 760 that wraps to two lines at most (never cut with an ellipsis). Hover fills a row with the ink and flips the text to the ground colour. Phone: rows 72px tall with the date and the short entry only, the long entry hidden.
phone: Two-column rows (date, entry), long text hidden.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Rows are separated by a tint step, never a rule under each row. Eight rows keep it light on text; the long entry wraps rather than being cut.

name: Tinted-sidebar statement with type switcher
description: Page ground. A left sidebar 340px wide on the surface tone runs the section height in place of any rule. Right of it, a statement at the sub step on three lines at most (about 886px wide, 20 words or fewer, sentence case in the display face) with a small-size caption under it, then a 568px photograph. Lower in the sidebar: a short list of unit types (16px rows, the chosen row a solid ink fill), a figure at the display step with its unit, and a body-size price line. The photograph (or render) swaps with the chosen type (0.5s cross-fade). Phone: the sidebar content moves above the statement, the picture last at full width.
phone: Selector first, statement, then the picture at full width.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. A tint step replaces the vertical rule; the chosen row is a filled pill, with no small label; the swapped picture is a photograph or render, never a drawn plan. The statement stays at 36px or less.

name: Cut-corner title card, sliding logo row, rising photo
description: Pinned for about 1.5 screens on the page ground. A three-word title at the head step sits at the left on the ground, with a card at the right (about 520 wide, the surface tone, the dealt corner) holding a three-line paragraph at the body step and the dealt button. Then a row of 6 partner logos (about 40px tall) slides in from the right inside a clipped window with the page margins. Below, a full-width picture in the page's one grade rises from the bottom and the next section slides over it. Phone: the title, then the card at full width, logos in two rows of three, the picture 4:5.
phone: Title, then the card at full width, logos in two rows of three, picture 4:5 rising.
houseRuleCheck: The cut corners are the dealt corner (one radius); the title is no longer inside the accent card (no headline in a card); the logo row shrinks from 13 to 6, so it is not a credit wall, and sits inside the margins; the duotone is the page's one grade, not a two-colour treatment; the card is the surface tone.

name: Title flies off as camera dives
description: A section held for about 720px of scroll on a 3D scene (CSS 3D layers or a small WebGL scene from a real model; never a drawn landscape): the camera moves forward and down past a peak and ends top-down on a valley. The title (two lines at the display step) rotates about 12 degrees, grows and slides off to the lower right, whole, as the camera moves; the tagline fades out. Optionally one small object crosses the foreground. The scene is the only thing on screen while it runs, and open space follows. Phone: the title slides off to the bottom, the camera path shortens to 500px.
phone: Shorter hold, title slides off downward.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The scene is the only thing on screen while it runs. Text fades rather than blurs. The title leaves the screen whole, never left cut by an edge.

name: Title parts around a centre opening
description: Over a camera flight above a landscape (a pre-rendered video), pinned for about 1.5 screens, a two-word title at the display step stands at the centre. As you scroll the two words part to the left and right as an opening of about 120px forms between them, with the landscape visible through it, holding a short line at the lead step, plain, with no shape drawn around it. A two-line paragraph at the lead step sits near the bottom; the letters fade as the view lifts. Words sit on the footage's calm part in one tone. Phone: the title on two lines at the display step, parting vertically, the paragraph near the bottom.
phone: Title on two lines at the display step, the words part up and down instead of left and right, paragraph near the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: The outline diamond (a drawn shape) is an empty opening in the type with a plain text line in it; the blur-to-sharp letter build is dropped (no flying letters; the dealt entrance decides); the thin weight is the dealt weight; the pin length is stated.

name: Title rows with pointer video preview
description: Four centred rows, each about 960x200 on a 240px pitch, on the page ground with no fill. Each row has a one-line title at the display step (leading 1, at most three words), under it one line at the body step (at most ten words) and a text link with an arrow. Hovering or focusing a row fades in a phone-shaped video (227x504, the dealt corner) that follows the pointer with spring easing (about 250ms lag), offset 24px from the cursor; leaving fades it out in 200ms. The rows neither dim nor move; only the video responds.
phone: Rows left-aligned with titles at the head step; tapping a row expands its video inline under the line (9:16, 60% width).
houseRuleCheck: Rows are bare text separated by space alone, acceptable as a list; titles stay to three words, five rows are cut to four and the description to one line (less text). The preview is a video, not a picture inside the headline, and it must also open on keyboard focus. Needs real clips.

name: Cut-corner title then drifting matted cards
description: A flat page ground. A three-word title at the head step with a two-line paragraph at the lead step and the dealt button offset below it. Then four project cards (about 452x318 at 1440, on the surface tone, the dealt corner) drift up in two staggered columns at different speeds (0.8x and 1.3x scroll), up to three on screen; each has a picture flush at the top and, in the plate under it, a title at the lead step and a client name at the body step. An underlined text link ends the scene. Phone: cards at full width inside the margins, drifting at the two speeds, two cards visible at a time.
phone: Cards at full width inside the margins, drifting at two speeds, two visible at a time.
houseRuleCheck: The cut-corner title card and the polygon button are plain type and the dealt button (no headline in a card, one corner radius); the grain texture is a flat ground; the white mat around each picture is gone (a frame in a card); eight cards are four, the picture budget.

name: Object held by rising hand
description: Page ground (or the ink field). A two-line title at the display step centred at the top, there from the first frame (no letter-by-letter build). A body-size sentence-case line sits under it. The product, a studio cut-out, scales down to about 280px at the centre of the section while a hand (a cut-out photograph, or a rendered 3D hand lit to match the product) rises from the bottom edge as the section scrolls in and holds it. A 16px sentence-case caption sits beside the hand. Scroll-linked, transform only; for reduced motion the hand already holds the product. Phone: title at the sub step, product 200px, the hand rises to 60% of the screen height.
phone: Smaller title and product, shorter hand rise.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The title is plain and there at once; the line and the caption are sentence case at 16px or more, no tiny uppercase labels. The hand is a real cut-out or render, never a drawn figure.

name: Twin columns of list-row cards
description: On the dealt ground. Two columns each 620px wide with a 40px gap inside the page margins. Each column: a centred title at the sub step (one line), then four row cards 620x90 on the surface tone with the dealt corner, 8px apart, each with a label at the lead step at the left and a short note at the body step at the right. The dealt button sits centred 60px beneath both. It suits a comparison: before and after, for teams and for solo, monthly and yearly. Hover: the row fills with the accent. Rows are there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: the columns stack, the title left-aligned, rows 72px, the button full width less the margins.
phone: Columns stacked, rows 72px, the button full width less the margins.
houseRuleCheck: The dotted frame, the dotted vertical and the dotted rules are out; rows are filled cards directly on the ground; the entrance from left and right is dropped (the dealt entrance).

name: Twin halves, two grounds
description: Two equal halves in the 1296px container, split by a change of fill instead of a rule: the left half on the surface tone, the right half on the ink field with ground-coloured text, 8px apart, the dealt corner. Each half is a card with a 342x303 picture running to the card's left, top and bottom edges and, beside it, a 276px text column: a sub-step title on two lines at most, a body-size two-line paragraph and the dealt button. Hover is the dealt card hover. Phone: halves stack, each with the picture above its text.
phone: Halves stacked, picture over text.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The split is a fill change: no slash label, no dashed rule, no rim round the pictures, no tag chips. Type is the dealt faces only. Nothing rises on entry.

name: Two-by-two filled cell grid
description: A headline at the display step on two lines at the left page margin. Below it a 2x2 grid of four cards (two columns of about 636px with 24px gutters, each about 290px tall at content height) on the surface tone in the dealt corner. Each card holds a lead phrase at the sub step at the top, a two-line paragraph at the lead step and, at the bottom left, a text link with an arrow (the dealt second-action link). On hover the card fill swaps to the accent, the text inverts and the arrow slides 8px; only one card is in the accent at a time. Phone: a single column of cards at least 240px tall, 16px gaps, headline at the head step.
phone: One column of four cards at least 240px tall, 16px gaps, headline at the head step.
houseRuleCheck: The rules, slash labels, mono prompt lines, superscript count and outline pills are all dropped; the cells are filled cards on one surface tone (not four tones); the pill button is the dealt second-action link, so there are not four buttons on one screen.

name: Two-column large square cards grid
description: Page ground. A one-line headline at the display step at the left. 100px below, a two-column grid of large cards in the 1296px container (632px wide, 32px gutter and row gap, the dealt corner), two rows deep (four cards). Each card is a solid fill in the dealt card style with a 632x520 photograph at its top, running to the card's top, left and right edges, and on the fill beneath it a 100px caption row: a bold body-size name at left and a text link with an arrow at right. Nothing over the photograph. Cards lift 8px on hover (no shadow) and the photograph scales 1.04. Phone: one column, photographs 4:3.
phone: One column, photographs 4:3, captions kept.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Captions sit on the card fill beneath the photograph: no scrim, no pill or box on the photograph, no tag chips. Photographs are styled, never documentary.

name: Two-column staggered UI windows
description: Page ground, two 684px columns with a 24px gutter inside the page margins. Top left: a headline at the display step on two lines in plain type, a body-size paragraph of two lines and a text link. Top right: a product interface fragment. Below, one fragment in each column at staggered heights (left starts about 550px down, right about 746px down), each a crop of a real interface state (a list, a form, a board) built in HTML with real labels, its root marked data-ui, on the surface tone in the dealt corner, running to the edges of its own tile: no title bar, no browser dots, no shadow, no cursors or name tags. Fragments sit in the page's own colours and inside both margins; never run one into a screen edge. Phone: one column, fragments full width inside the margins, 16px gap.
phone: One column of interface fragments inside the margins.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No inline icons or shapes in the headline. Fragments are interface crops, not framed windows: no chrome, no shadow, no cursors; a control inside one works or reads as static.

name: Two unequal tiles with empty gap
description: Page ground. A heading at the sub step on the left and one text link on the right above the tiles. Two product tiles on the surface tone in the dealt corner, tops aligned: a 670x763 tile from the left margin (columns 1 to 6) and a 440x501 tile ending at the right margin (columns 10 to 12), with columns 7 to 9 left empty on purpose. In each tile a product cut-out in the one grade. Under each tile a body-size caption row: name, a text action with an arrow, a price. Hover scales the product 1.04 inside its tile. Nothing follows in a 3-up grid. Phone: tiles stack at full width, the large one first, the empty gap becomes 48px of space.
phone: Tiles stacked, large first, 48px between.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The large tile holds the left, so no row is empty on the left. Prices are plain text, not badges. Images are there from the first frame (the dealt entrance decides).

name: Typed centred line over 3D model
description: Page ground, as tall as its content (about 70svh) plus the section gap. One centred two-line statement at the sub step (about 16 words) in the upper third, while the page's 3D model (the same model as the hero, turning slowly) rests low in the frame. A body-size caption on a solid surface-tone label sits at the bottom right. No typing effect: the text is there at once. Phone: statement at the lead step, the model 60% of the screen width, the caption centred beneath.
phone: Smaller statement and model, caption centred beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Plain static text: no typing effect and no scene that ends on a wheel notch; native scroll only. The caption is a solid label, not outlined.

name: Video rows, two then three
description: On the dealt ground. Header: one word at the display step on one line at the left and the dealt second action (a label with an arrow) at the right; no label or tag. Then muted looping videos inside the page margins with 16px gutters and the dealt corner: a row of two (about 674x380), then a row of three (about 445x250), 60px between rows. Under each video a caption at the body step (a title, then the type and duration in plain words). Hover: the video scales 1.03 inside its crop. Phone: one column of 16:9 videos with captions under them.
phone: One column of 16:9 videos with captions under them.
houseRuleCheck: The edge-to-edge run is now the page margin with 16px gutters; captions sit under the videos (no darkened overlay, no small type); the bracket tag, small label and count superscript are out; five videos.

name: Video window between side colour columns
description: A full-screen video section with two flat columns in the page ground colour, each about 250px wide, over its left and right sides. Their inner edges are straight, with the dealt corner on the inner corners, so the video reads as a window between them. On scroll the columns slide outward 80px and the video widens. The columns carry no words (the navigation is the dealt one). A two-line headline at the head step sits under the video once it has settled. Phone: columns shrink to 16vw side strips.
phone: Thin side strips, no words in them.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The columns are straight-edged with the dealt corner, never wave edges, and hold no words. The headline sits on the ground under the video, not on it.

name: Wave-offset three-column square grid
description: Page ground. A two-line heading at the head step at the left, then three columns of squares from the page margin, 20px apart, with 80px between rows (the dealt corner, about 413px each at 1440). The middle column is raised 124px, so each row reads as a shallow wave. Two rows (six photographs) make the grid. The columns drift 20px against each other on scroll (transform only; still for reduced motion). No captions. Phone: two columns, the right one lowered 60px, squares 170px.
phone: Two columns with a lowered right column.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Photographs are bare squares, so there is no box on any of them; they are styled and modern, never documentary. Nothing fades in on load (the dealt entrance decides).

name: Rendered room, centred product
description: A pinned stage of three rooms, about 70vh of scroll each (under three screens in all). Each room is a full-screen pre-rendered still: a back wall, a floor from about two thirds of the height and set dressing (a plant, a stool, a lamp) that changes per room. One small cut-out product (about 18% of the width) floats at dead centre and bobs 8px. A centred headline of two lines at most in the head step, in the palette's light tone, sits at about 73% of the height on a calm part of the picture (failing that, a flat black scrim at 40-55% under the words only), with a plain underlined text action in the lead step 24px under it. Rooms swap as you scroll (crossfade 600ms; the product stays, the set dressing changes). No dot rail or pagination.
phone: Room cropped to the centre, headline in the head step, action in the lead step.
houseRuleCheck: The headline is sentence case and nothing is tiny; there is no dot rail. Rooms are designed or rendered, never documentary photographs.

name: Wheel-panned picture row on flat ground
description: A pinned full-screen stage on the page ground for about three screens. One row of pictures (artworks or product shots) 300 by 400 (the dealt corner, no shadow) sits centred on the screen's middle line at a 450 pitch; three to five are visible, and pieces near the page margins fade out by position (opacity set per item, no mask gradient) instead of being cut by the edge. Scroll pans the row sideways. At 72% height one centred line shows the current piece's title (28px) and its year in the muted ink and crossfades as the centre piece changes. Colour roles: a flat ground, the pictures carry the colour, ink for the title. Phone: pieces 220 by 300, one centred with its neighbours at 60% opacity, scroll pans.
phone: Pieces 220 by 300, one centred, neighbours at 60%, scroll pans.
houseRuleCheck: Edge-cut pieces fade before the margin; the soft shadow is dropped (ground contrast does the work); the small-caps year row became a 28px title line under the row; the piece count is dropped; the mid-tone ground is the page ground; the pin is three screens at most.

name: Photo card plus text card
description: Page ground. A two-line heading at the head step above two cards 8px apart in the 1296px container (the dealt corner), 686px tall. The left card, 830px wide, is a photograph running to its edges. The right card, 458px wide, is on the surface tone: a lead-size paragraph of three or four lines at the top and a text link with an arrow at the bottom. Phone: the cards stack, photograph card 4:5, text card auto height.
phone: Cards stacked, photograph 4:5.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The photograph fills its card with nothing on it. The title is the section heading above the cards, not a headline in a card. Nothing scales on entry (the dealt entrance decides).

name: Wordless parallax photo
description: One edge-to-edge picture 1440 by 1100 (about 1.2 screens, full-bleed on both edges) with no text, in an overflow-hidden frame. The image inside is 130% of the frame height and travels from -15% to +15% against the scroll at about half scroll speed, so the frame reads as a window. No caption, chip or controls. The dealt section gap lies above and below. It is a breathing break between two sections, never a section of its own, so the neighbouring sections carry the headings. The picture is art-directed (a made image, a product world or a place), never documentary. Phone: frame 4:5 at full width, image 120%, parallax range halved.
phone: Frame 4:5 at full width, image 120%, parallax range halved.
houseRuleCheck: A tiny corner chip and a shaped top edge are not used; spacing follows the dealt section gap; it is a break, so it carries no heading and never replaces a section.
